source_doc: Use on smooth surfaces. I bought this in the hopes I could use as wallpaper in the rental i have. The only problem I had was not due to the product. If your walls are textured in any way, you will see every seam, exert bump, and very flaw. I tore it down and thought I could use to cover the window trim. It worked until the adhesion wouldn’t bond on the unfinished wood. I will say that I was impressed with it, still. It’s not super thin and I was able to man handle it more than I thought I could. The texture and color are exactly what I hoped for. I would recommend it to anyone that has a smooth surface.

source_doc: Nice Scent. I love my fur babies but I do not want my house to smell like a litter box.  I got these OdorTrap refills to use with my Litter Robot because they are much less expensive than what I was using.  I like that the scent is not overpowering because I have found that if I use anything that smells too strong, the cats avoid the litter box…definitely not something you want happening lol.  These refills are made to go in the pod that goes in the drawer of the Litter Robot but I think they could even be used without that near any type of litter box.  I have another litter box that is in an enclosure.  I put one of these packs behind it and it is helping to remove the odor quite well.  I definitely will be stocking up on these.  Great product.  Great price.

source_doc: great for cat hair and taking on the go. my uniform for work is 100% black and having 6 cats, yeah my clothes get covered in hair. now, using a lint roller isn't anything new to me, but the one i had ran out of paper and i had no clue it was out. so ofc i ran to amazon to buy one that would arrive quickly. this one came up and i was intrigued by the design, i've only ever had the straight ones. so i took a chance on this one and omg i'm never going back. the design of this one somehow makes it easier to roll. and i love the fact that it has a cover, because a lot of the time i forget to lint roll before i leave, so it's nice that i can just keep this in my bag and use it once i get to work.it was a little hard to figure out how to peel the paper off but once i did figure it out, it became easy.

source_doc: Overly sensitive - may need therapy! I love the individually programmable key light colors! Granted, the color/brightness varies a little across the keyboard, but most people would not likely notice. I like the volume control, contrary to other reviews. The keyboard is full-size but compact - like a Tardis! With light use, the battery has lasted well. The only thing I don't care for is that the keys are very sensitive - it is easy to mistype with a very light touch. I find myself making corrections or opening windows that I didn't intend. I could use the power cable to keep the backlight from sleeping, but that's not why I bought a wireless model. I wish I could extend the sleep timer. I don't think there is a competitive model with similar features for this price and I highly recommend this Red Dragon keyboard if you can train yourself to use the very sensitive keys.

source_doc: I can't deny, I love these bare limbed lighted trees. I have one the same height as this one but it is all white lights.  I still love it - it puts off more light that you would think and it's just really pretty when lit up at night.  This one, having colorful lights is just as pretty, but I do love that this one has several colors.  The only thing I might wish for is that this had a remote so that I could change the colors to a solid color, have it fade or pulse, or even have all the colors race.  See, I don't put up a Christmas tree and this would be sort of a substitute.  Other than that, I love this tree.  It was easy to put together and I used a smart plug so that I could turn it on with voice control through Alexa.  Love this tree!

source_doc: I like it! I had read that COQ10 is good for your heart, blood pressure and cholesterol so I decided to try it. I found the taste was not unpleasant although the consistency was a little thick. I found that after a couple of days I seemed to feel a little more energetic and I felt less anxiety.  I have never taken a COQ10 supplement in a form such as this, but since I hate to take pills, this works better for me. The only thing I dislike is that this has to be refrigerated after opening which makes it more difficult to remember to take.  The bottle is supposed to be used within 45 days of opening so if I miss a few days, the product will still be good.  I won’t know of course if consuming this supplement will help with my cholesterol levels until the next time it is checked so if there is a marked improvement, I will update this review.  In the meantime, I really like this supplement.

source_doc: Not a favorite. This is my second dock charger. I got it because it is designed for the headset to lay horizontal so there is no chance of the lenses getting damaged by light or scratched. Overall, I do not like this dock very much. I have a few aftermarket headset accessories that the dock doesn’t work well with. The controllers setting in the middle which means I have to adjust my strap piece to get my controllers in the charger.The biggest issue I had is my controllers don’t even charge. I thought there wasn’t an indicator light for the controllers, but it ends up they weren’t charging at all. I left my headset and controllers on the dock for a couple days thinking everything was charging but when I powered up the controllers were at 40% battery life. I even heard my controllers click into place. I never did get them to charge but the headset charges fine so I think my product may have been defective.

source_doc: Nearly useless. After receiving these, but prior to using them, I left a raving review, but now they are nearly useless. I followed the instructions for washing them, which I did, of course, before planning to use them. I placed the lids in the top rack of my dish washer, and when the cycle finished I TRIED to secure the lids onto the bowls. I was able to snap shut only one or two of the four sides in place. The only bowl that I was able to fully secure the lid onto was the smallest. Granted, I have arthritis in my hands, but never have I had this issue with a set like this from another manufacturer. So, here I am with bowls without the advantage of a proper lid. Again, this is the only set of bowls with snapping lids that has not worked out for me. I absolutely do NOT recommend this product. I left a previous glowing review, but that was prior to washing this set and attempting to secure the lids to the bowls.

source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.
hypos: Мне всё нравится в этом, кроме цены. Мне 32 года, кожа склонна к акне, комбинированный тип кожи (жирная Т-зона, но сухая вокруг подбородка). Я вообще не использую социальные сети, но я в Корее, и моя семья подарила мне немного этого. Я здесь уже месяц и только что закончила одну палочку (ну, там ещё немного осталось, но оно на дне, и я больше не могу провести им по лицу). Я не наносила его экономно, использовала его почти каждый день и вечер, так как забыла свой обычный увлажнитель. Я заметила, что иногда чувствовала, что выскакивает прыщик, и, думаю, это на самом деле помогло ему заживать гораздо быстрее. Я не наносила его экономно, использовала почти каждый день и вечер, так как забыла свой обычный увлажняющий крем. Иногда я чувствовала, как начинают появляться прыщики, и мне кажется, что это действительно помогло им зажить намного быстрее. Я не заметила уменьшения морщин, но моя кожа стала более здоровой и яркой. Я пробовала наносить поверх заживляющую мазь CeraVe, но это слишком тяжёлое сочетание и не нужно. Мне очень нравится аромат и упаковка, думаю, я куплю это снова, но если вы ищете средство для уменьшения морщин, микронедлинг и/или продукты с ретинолом будут более эффективными. Это был бы отличный продукт для чередования в дни, когда не используешь ретинол.

source_doc: Great office chair! This seems like a nicely made computer chair. I am not very good at putting things together, but I managed to get this chair together all by myself! It suggests having two people put it together, and I agree that two people would make things much easier! I didn't have an issue until I tried to put the back of the seat on. I just couldn't get it in the right spot because I needed two hands to screw the bolts in. It took awhile, but I got it!The chair is very sturdy and the seat is very comfortable! The neck support is nice. The only issues I noticed were some of the wheels wouldn't roll as I pushed it back to my office. I assume with use, these wheels will start working. Also, I had planned on using it for my bar-height desk, but it is a few inches too short, so I will have to find another use for it. I think I assumed it would adjust that high, but I should have looked at the measurements.

source_doc: A Practice Tool. I bought this transmitter specifically for practice.  I don't think I'd ever use a low-end wireless for a live performance.  There are too many cross signals that will cause signal drop.  I was surprised when I got some drop in my practice room.  To be fair, not long after it dropped a few times, the battery died about 10 minutes later. So that was probably the cause so kudos because it didn't drop more frequently.  The volume control is not linear, at least by my experience.  It went from to quite to booming with just a few touches.  I had to play with it a bit to get the level where I wanted it.  I also noticed the wireless is tonally different than the cord.  Actually, I like the sound a bit better.  I didn't notice that difference with my other wireless system.  I have only used this device in my practice room so, I don't know how it will react if practicing with a group, especially if there are other wireless devices in the room.  When I know, I'll update this review.

source_doc: Easy to swallow vitamin E. I have tried in the past various Vitamin E products. I was looking for one where I only had to take 1 a day. I came across a company Kala Health that has a Vitamin E Ultra Tocopherols 1000 IU and you only need to take 1 a day. So I decided to give it a try. Since I had never ordered from them, I was anxious to see how big the capsules were. To my suprise they were long & slender caps, which made swallowing easier. The main reason I wanted to take Vitamin E was for my skin. As I have gotten older, it did not matter how much lotion I used my skin was still dry. So far I have to say my skin seems to be some better. I am going to keep taking this product. The price I paid was very reasonable. I would recommend this product.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

source_doc: Comfy, cushy seat! We just got a stationary bike and it came with one of those skinny bike seats you use on cycling bicycles. It was so uncomfortable that I decided we needed a different seat so I came on Amazon, like I always do, and searched for one. When I came across this one I loved how it looked so I clicked it and read all about it. Even the reviews were mostly positive, and I see why. When we got the seat we put it on our stationary bike, as soon as I got on the bike I knew we made the right choice! It’s so soft and very cushy, it’s such a huge difference from the original seat! I can’t say anything about the durability quite yet since we just got it, but it feels very sturdy to me and seems to be very well made. I’m very happy with it and I definitely recommend this seat to anyone who needs a comfy bike seat.

I am not super experienced and was kind of apprehensive to get these but I wanted something to be able to more clearly narrate videos for use on various social media counts.  The set comes with a storage box which is nice, but I did find it a little hard to get the pieces in and out of the box as the lid does not open up all the way.  It was necessary to manipulate it a bit to get access.  Not a game changer for me but just something to note.  Overall, I found this set to be very user friendly and pretty self explanatory as far as getting them set up to use.  Right out of the box, I was able to figure out how to use them.  The sound quality is on point.  I am sure that there are others out there that are more professional, but I think better than using only the microphone on my iPhone and for an entry level priced product, I am very happy.  I didn’t use them at a distance so I cannot comment on how well they pick up sound from afar.  I think if you are looking for a something to get started with, this set would be a good place to start.

source_doc: Beautiful. I love this little bowl and lid!  Two things I wish the makers could change, though.  One is that there is a little crease around the lid underneath.  I wish that was not there due to the difficulty to clean it.  Second, I wish the knob was easier to grasp and hold on the lid.  When this bowl is hot, you have to use a potholder to remove the lid.  That lid knob is too small.  I dropped it once because it slipped out of my potholders.  It could have broken, and my heart would be broken too.  I have tried to figure out how I can get the bowl out of the microwave, burning hot, rather than using potholders on each side.  I love it for its looks, but I want to use it, too.OK, sad news.  I could not find any way to remove the lid when it was very hot.  I tried gloves, mit's, and little pinchers.  Nothing worked.  I sadly sent it back.

source_doc: Great aftermarket upgrade for you Sony Pulse headset. I decided to try these replacement earpads because I often found the factory pads getting too warm on my head, and they weren't exactly the most comfortable.  These new pads are noticeably cooler and are a decent improvement in comfort as well.  I really like them!I found the process of replacing the earpads to be a pain.  Taking the earpads off is simple, but for whatever reason I couldn't get two of the clips to snap into place, so there was a gap, which I knew wasn't right.  I didn't want to break anything either, as I thought I was pressing too hard already.  After failing to snap them in place I found the factory ones didn't want to go back on either.  So then I knew it wasn't the fault of these earpads, but the design of the headset.  Turns out you have to use more force than you are comfortable with to snap two of the clips of the earpads onto the headset.All turned out well, but man I really thought I was going to snap some plastic while installing the earpads.  Again, not the fault of these pads.  I love these and would recommend them to anyone.

source_doc: Awesome oil. I for years I used to use only the Subaru synthetic oil in my 2018 forester. After reading reviews and friends telling me about this oil I tried it out.It is a little more expensive that the Subaru oil but I wanted to try it and I was willing to pay the price 1x. So for a little background my forester with clean oem oil was getting 14-15mpg city and my oil temp was 210F. When I used the royal purple I immediately noticed that the engine was running smoother and I was now getting 20-21mpg city and the oil temp was at 190F.This oil definitely paid for itself through the savings at the pump and the smoothness of the engine. I took the averages on both oils after I put 1000mi on.I will update if there’s any changes. On a side note it does say it’s a once a year oil but that’s only if you drive freeway. I drive stop and go in the city so I still plan to change it out in 5 months. I’m also going to put it in our HRV.Thanks royal purple!!

source_doc: Love the scent. First thing I do on any new shampoo or conditioner is smell it to see if it smells nice.  Both the conditioner and shampoo passed with flying colors.Shampoo first.  I like a squeeze bottle over a pump.  I just feel that I can utilize the entire bottle over a pump bottle.  Shampoo did lather nice.  Again, I liked the smell of it as I was washing my hair.Rinsed off and left my hair feeling clean.  Not the dry squeaky type of clean.  A nice soft clean.I then put on the conditioner before I washed up so it would sit in my hair for a few minutes before rinsing.  Like the shampoo, I loved the scent.Nice thicker conditioner.Rinsed off and towel dried my hair.  It didn't get every tangle out but I could tell I had less tangling.  I have very long hair so it's close to impossible to not have a few tangles.My hair felt soft and smelled so nice.  Even after blowing it a little dry, it felt soft.Once I straightened it, my hair feels like silk.  I love it.Price is a little on the higher end.  But ,the bottles are large and with not having to use as much as some other hair products this should last quite awhile.  So price can be comparable.
hypos: Обожаю запах. Первое, что я делаю с новым шампунем или кондиционером, это понюхать его, чтобы узнать, приятно ли пахнет. И шампунь, и кондиционер прошли на ура. Сначала шампунь. Мне нравится убирать шампунь из тюбика, а не из помпы. Я просто чувствую, что могу использовать весь флакон, а не помповый. Шампунь хорошо пенился. Снова, мне понравился его запах, когда я мыла волосы. Смыла и волосы остались чистыми. Не сухой, скрипучей чистоты. Приятная мягкая чистота. Я потом нанесла кондиционер перед тем, как смывать, чтобы он подействовал на мои волосы несколько минут. Как и шампунь, я обожала запах. Приятный более густой кондиционер. Смыла и высушила волосы полотенцем. Он не распутал все запутанности, но я заметила, что стало меньше запутанности. У меня очень длинные волосы, поэтому почти невозможно избежать нескольких запутанностей. Мои волосы были мягкими и пахли так приятно. Даже после того, как я немного высушила их феном, они оставались мягкими. Как только я их выпрямила, мои волосы ощущаются как шелк. Мне это нравится. Цена немного на высоком уровне. source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.

Можно подумать, что после удаления такого количества шерсти он должен быть более редким, но каждую неделю шерсти становится все больше. source_doc: Not Enjoying All the Possibilities. In 2020 I bought this preorder from the manufacturer (before they were shipping). It came with no user manual. I found a manual on their internet site, but I wasn't able to find much that was helpful to me. My initial problem was that the app did not work on my i-phone 6 operating system. I set the amp aside until I recently bought an i-phone 14. I recently (2023) downloaded the App. First message was that I needed to download a firmware update for the Spark40. That required a computer. I tried a computer with Windows 11. Then I tried one with Windows 10 Pro. Neither computer recognizes the amplifier. After contacting customer service (very nice response), I connected to a different USB port on the Windows 11 computer and the update worked. This amp is supposed to do wonderful things, and many are happy with it. In my small amount of time using it, I found adjustments on the App difficult to make because of the small phone screen size. Maybe an i-pad would be easier, but that would cost a lot to gain that capability. I'm impressed by all the Spark40 is supposed to do, but not very pleased with the learning curve and the amount of supporting equipment needed (App capable phone or tablet, and a computer for updates of firmware). Make sure you have a phone with an operating system that can run the App.

source_doc: Absolute Garbage. These things are absolute garbage. I have had two now, one which I just threw in the trash last night, was a black HZ model. source_doc: They are OK. I've got a bunch of par lights, and I guess I was hoping for a little more with these. Most of my lights are about the same size. Their LEDs are in different patterns, but when I put them all on my truss, they look comparable. These guys are smaller. I guess you can call them compact. But they won't look right in-line with my other pars. They are bright... in fact, they are brighter than a name brand pair that I have. However, the blue had more purple in it. The red and green looked OK. The spread is wider when I tested these side-by-side with my name brand. The name brand gave me an even circle on my ceiling. This pair washed a larger area with a hot spot in the middle. What I do NOT like is the plug. It is ungrounded. If I use them inside, they will work OK. I will probably use them behind a scrim or façade since the brackets are extremely flimsy. I didn't expect name brand quality for sure. But I think I expected just a little bit better.

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS. A friend suggested I purchase this pair of hand warmers before a ski trip I had planned with my family. In the past, I would typically buy disposable single-use "pouch" style hand warmers but wanted something that was reusable and would last longer. Boy was I impressed with these. As I was putting on all my ski equipment, I fired these up and put them in my boots. When I was ready to put my boots on, they were already nice and toasty so I moved the warmers to my jacket pockets and zipped them closed. Once I went outside the lodge into the cold, I put my hands in my pockets and they were nice and warm. I had the warmers on the lowest setting and they kept my pockets warm all day. It was great to take my gloves off on the chair lift, stick my hands in my pockets before each run, and it made the day a much better experience overall. I highly recommend these if you're a skiier, hiker, go to an outdoor sporting event, etc.!

source_doc: THE MEASUREMENTS/SIZE GIVEN ARE NOT CORRECT but a nice cover for the price. I purchase alot of car covers.  I usually purchase Budge because they are economical for what I need them for.  This review is not against the seller but the mfg.  I followed directions and measure this car from front to back, I also went online to confirm the length....204" or 17'.  I ordered 2 covers that the mfg states are 228' or 19" for extra caveats to the car itself.  Mind you I know this is a universal fit, the fit overall for a sedan is fine, however, this cover is not 19' long so I am very disappointed.  I cannot return because it was such a tight fit a small corner ripped.  I also used this cover on another car of same dimensions, it did not fit.  This is a lightweight cover which I knew that is fine.  Not happy spending $64+ dollars for something that didn't cover 100%.  Again, not made at the seller, just the mfg and to let people know that Budge misrepresents the measurements.  This is the first time this has happened to me on their covers.

source_doc: Cover about 28 vents, and about its efficiency I will tell more when I know. I recently moved into an apartment complex that was supposed to be pest free and smoke free… Couple of days after moving in we started smelling a lot of cigarettes smoke and weed as well. We first thought it was coming from the door or windows, since people would go to the balconies to smoke, but nope… we learned that our next door neighbor smokes inside and the smoke smell comes from all the ac vents and the bathroom vent when the AC is not running. I got this “filter” to cover the AC vents. I sprayed the filter with odor ban to see if it helps. I will let you guys know more about its efficiency after couple of days.I decided to cover the vents from the inside, so I could still redirect the vent from the outside, and because of that I used a lot of the fabric. I live in a 1 bedroom apartment, so I only have 3 ac vents to cover. I covered all of them and have enough fabric to change all of them once more with a little bit to spare, but if you cover from the front I would say you should have enough for a good 28 vents.

source_doc: This does not do as it is advertised. I don't understand what people are raving about. I tried this and it did nothing. I tried this on my carpet, on my stairs, on my rugs and I didn't get any hair pulled up.  I have 2 100 pd dogs that shed profusely. I vacuum every 2 days to keep the hair up.  I know there is hair on my floors even after I vacuum because it comes up on my pants an d socks.  So this should be picking stuff up.Anyways, I am unhappy about the shipping. What happened to the shipping box?  I got my box today and it was crushed. I got several boxes today at the same time and THIS was the only box that was crushed. Like it had to be deliberately chosen to be crushed.  This is not the first time my deliveries have been crushed, ripped open, etc by Amazon or UPS. In fact, I had over $1000 in tile crushed on my last UPS order over the holiday. Which I watched UPS from my window as they threw each box of tile out of their truck and onto my pavement. So no wonder my tile was crushed. But what happened here?

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.

source_doc: Nice low glow color ring. I wanted an adjustable light in my bedroom but I didn't have a ceiling mount (where I wanted to put it) in place with the wires to the breaker box. Since the lamp itself was very lightweight, I wired with old lamp parts that plugged into a wall socket. It worked out perfectly for me. source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: Very strong. This thing is so much better than the mighty mule I mean I’ve only had it working for a couple weeks now, but it is so much stronger and quieter than the mighty mule. I have a 14 1/2 foot gate that I made myself out of 2 3/8  thin wall pipe no I don’t know the exact weight of the gate but I’m guessing 250 maybe 300 pounds and this thing swings it like it’s not even there I like the soft close feature. and the electric lock takes a lot of pressure off of the actuator on a windy day. I’ve had two of the mighty mules granted they were the smaller models.3500 I believe is what the model was but I burn two of them up in one year like I said I’ve only had this one going for a bout a month so it’s a little premature I will give a year end review but so far, I’m really liking it. It’s faster than the mighty mule as well. The only thing I don’t like is the cheap ass remote control the damn buttons. Get stuck it’s just cheaply made but other than that I love the gate opener I can’t say much about tech-support because I have not had to use them. It is pretty simple to install and I’ve had no problems with it. I highly recommend it if you have a heavy gate well worth the money.

source_doc: Perfect extension for my camper sink! I could not believe it when I found this faucet extender.  It is the perfect size and design for what I wanted it for.  My wife and I are avid campers.  We have a small, old popup camper and have the “kitchen” outside.  We have one of those folding sink tables and use a drop in faucet with it.  The problem is that my existing faucet, while being tall, it does not extend far over the sink area and washing things is a hassle.  This extension is exactly what I wanted.  It goes out just far enough, but also allows the multiple angles of adjustment.  Wow, if I made it myself it would not be this good.5 stars and thank you!Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. source_doc: Great purchase! First just want to state that I'm new to cloth diapering but I am on my third baby LOL! I took a chance on these because there wasn't a lot of reviews at the time so I felt like leaving one myself will definitely help. These diapers are great for the price point, and I actually prefer this shape of wet bag that it comes with; much larger than other brands I've purchased but I use it to store the clean ready to go diapers. The diapers themselves are great the snaps are strong and have a good size range, the lining is soft and haven't had any staining thus far. The liners I feel like are basic microfiber liners I did wash them about 4 times before use to help with absorbancy but I still wouldn't use just one alone for overnight or long car rides etc I would put the microfiber in the pocket and use a bamboo or something that can be close to the skin on the inside for those long periods of time. It looks like there is a snap in the pocket itself so if you have liners with snaps you are covered. I honestly have no complaints and I love the prints haven't seen any like it and I'm obsessed!

source_doc: Great product! I am very glad I ordered this product! I have lots of clear organizational types of jars and containers on my counter, which look very cute when displaying things like pasta and grains. I wanted smaller jars to display spices, such as peppercorns. These small jars are perfect for display. There are many jars to cover every spice I own, and additionally, they come with tons of labels. Some labels were pre-printed, and some were blank so I can write on them myself! They even included a pen for convenience. These glass containers will be easy to clean, easy to display, easy to stack, etc!When I opened the package, I was looking at the jars and noticed that the lids were off-center from the container. At first, I was irritated at the poor craftsmanship, but then I realized that the lids just needed to be adjusted to look right on the container. It was simply a matter of moving the lid around to make it look better. I thought I would include that note just in case anyone had the same thought!

source_doc: I’m very happy with these hammocks. The only reason I’m giving four stars is because we’re I live at it’s so cold that our windows are very cold so the suction won’t stay on the windows. That to me that would not be a product issue. It’s just where I live at. It’s very very cold! It does indeed hold two cats each on each hammock. I have three indoor cats but right now I’m babysitting my best friends cat so I’m up to four cats so I can say it does hold two cats a piece.Every time I try to take a picture of any of the cats on the hammock they see the camera and then they jump off! They were very easy to put together, and they are very sturdy because two of my cats are pretty big and pretty sturdy! If I get any of the cats to stay on the hammock, when I have my phone out, then I will indeed take a picture and add the picture at a later date! I’m very happy with this product and I do believe my three cats plus the one that I’m babysitting is very happy with these hammocks! I was very surprised when I open the box and seen that there was two hammocks. I just assumed that was only one. They’re fantastic and again I’m very pleased with them. Thank you for letting me review these hammocks.
hypos: Я очень рад/а этим гамаком. Единственная причина, по которой я ставлю четыре звезды, это то, что там, где я живу, так холодно, что наши окна очень холодные, и присоски не держатся на окнах. Для меня это не является проблемой продукта. Это просто связано с тем, где я живу. Здесь очень-очень холодно! Он действительно вмещает по две кошки на каждом гамаке. У меня три домашних кошки, но сейчас я присматриваю за кошкой моего лучшего друга, так что у меня четыре кошки, и я могу сказать, что он действительно вмещает по две кошки. Каждый раз, когда я пытаюсь сделать фото любой из кошек на гамаке, они видят камеру и сразу же прыгают вниз! source_doc: Excellent mid-size carrying case. The reason I got this case for my Steam Deck is I wasn't happy with the velcro on the JSAUX case and had a couple other issues with it where I didn't feel like my deck was properly secured. This fella however solves all those issues. First, this case is a LOT bigger than the JSAUX case, the top is as wide as the bottom. There's a massive top pocket that you could shove a small Nintendo Switch carrying case into but otherwise it's perfect for batteries, controllers, docks, etc. I really wasn't expecting it to be that spacious! The bottom compartment isn't quite as big as the JSAUX one but I was able to cut out a slot for my charging brick using a boxcutter so no big deal, the interior material cut very easily. The protection for this felt wayyy better than the JSAUX case. The straps are excellent and the velcro is very good. The interior is also a bit padded which feels nice. It has microsd storage slots as well as fullsize SD storage slots. I was worried about the microSD's falling out so I kept them in their SD adapters anyways. The only feature I couldn't quite get working was the kickstand strap so I just shoved that down in the bottom and put a different kickstand in the top storage so I have one if I ever need it.

source_doc: Fluffier than expected. It is hard to order something online and know if you will like it or not, even if you base your decision on the reviews. I must have spent a week almost daily searching for a comforter. So, I took a chance on this one because my old comforter was flat and faded. And hello, I like being spoiled by two day shipping with Prime!The comforter arrived in a vacuum sealed tight bag and looked pretty thin. No weird smells, either. It was late and I wanted to use it that night, so I overlooked the instructions and tossed it into the washing machine. (The instructions state to air it out over a 24 hour period outside, but it is winter here and I have nowhere to safely hang it or leave it.) I washed it on "warm" on the delicate cycle and the tag said to "line dry" but seriously, who does that anymore? Being the rebel that I am, I forego the instructions and shove it into my regular sized dryer on "medium" and waited. Well, it took about 2 hours to dry. When it was done, it smelled great and was very fluffy! I put it on the bed and loved the look and feel of it. I slept great that night snuggled up with this wonderful, and did I mention fluffy? new comforter. I'm very happy with my purchase.

source_doc: Good Soap; Very Fragrant. I got this dish soap specifically to take to the office. I work in a shared environment where dish soap is provided by the workers, not the organization, and I have seen a variety of soaps of varying quality run through. I have had good success with Amazon's store brands, so I had good expectations here. It's good soap that gets the job done. The most notable aspect of this soap is the fragrance.In use this soap works as well or better than the rest of the soaps I have seen in the kitchen. It clears grease and it gets dirty dishes clean, There's no mystery there. It rinses off well and I have not had problems with residue after using this soap.The fragrance is the most noticeable feature of this soap. It has a strong lemony smell to it that doesn't smell like fresh lemons, exactly, but it is much stronger than that of most soaps I have used. It's a pleasant fragrance and it actually makes the kitchen smell nice when I use it.This is fine dish soap that works well and smells nice. It's at least on par with name brand soaps I have used, and it is very fragrant. When it's gone, I will buy more.

source_doc: So disappointed. I am really disappointed. I contacted customer service because the vegan leather on my bag is pealing after just a few months of use. The best they can do is nothing? They said I must be rubbing it on rough surfaces. I am not rubbing or bumping it on rough surfaces. I have had another Itzy Ritzy bag and used it the exact same way and it has very little wear and tear on it after years of use. It was also vegan leather. The surface of the vegan leather is just peeling in places where there is not much friction. I am careful to take good care of my bags. I have really enjoyed being an Itzy Ritzy customer. As a mom of 7, I have carried their bags for years as well as used many other products including toys and pacifiers. I also recommend the brand because of the quality, however I have sadly learned that the customer care is lacking. For an item to peel like this is unacceptable and not normal wear and tear. I guess their quality standards have lowered as well, previous bags did not do this. If they will only stand by products purchased directly from their website and not other merchants such as Amazon, what is the point of selling there? I will no longer purchase or recommend Itzy Ritzy.

source_doc: VERY STRONG FRAGRANCE!!!! Smell is extraordinarily fragranced. I left this box on my bathroom counter for a half day while I did other things. Returning to my bathroom area, I could smell it out in the hallway. I ended up double bagging it in ziplocks.I don’t like scents and I can have allergic reactions but usually shampoo smells are okay. So, I kept it. Finally tried it this morning. The black shampoo + the green conditioner. Worked okay but again, the smell was EXTREMELY STRONG. I felt my lips tingling in the shower so I was definitely having a reaction.Anyways, an hour later I got migraine. I get them very infrequently - maybe once a year or less. This one was only visual but the strongest visual one I’ve ever had. Kinda suspicious I got it right after using a new product. No one to know for sure.Long story short, everything was double bagged and put into the trash.I really, really would like to be doing better and using and discarding less plastic but not at the expense of my health.Definitely not a good product if you are sensitive to fragrances.

source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs.  It was really difficult at first and to pop it off I had to ask my husband hoping that he wouldn't break it.  He got it off and we emptied the bin and it was a hard snap back in.  It kinda scared me at the amount of force that had to be used.  It did NOT break (phew) and I've been using it practically weekly.  Overall - I would agree with the reviews and the amount of people who have purchased this item.  It really gets the job done. Enjoy and I hope you don't become a fanatic about keeping your sweaters pristine like I have. (slight nervous laugh).

source_doc: Really Works to Prevent Color Bleeding. I usually separate my whites from darker clothing out of fear that the dye from the dark clothing will stain the white. So I was excited to try this product.Basically the sheets look like fabric softener sheets, only they're meant for "grabbing" the color shed by darker clothes and preventing them from bleeding onto the lighter ones. I dropped 2 sheets in my load of laundry, started the machine, and added detergent.To test the product, I threw in a pair of burgundy colored corduroy pants that explicitly said "Wash separate from light colors" and even stated "dye may bleed." I threw them into the same wash as my lighter colored shirts and socks.After the wash was done, I saw that the two "color grabber" sheets had turned gray (they were originally white). They had absorbed the color and when I checked my clothing, I saw no color "bleeds."Now, I haven't tested it with a hot water wash, but for the cold water wash, they definitely work. I love it. Usually I have to separate the whites from the other clothing and it wastes money because the all-white bundle is usually small and could easily fit with the rest of the clothing's washer. But I had always had to separate. Not anymore! I can toss one of these sheets in and it will prevent any color bleeding.Great product.

source_doc: Beautiful drawer handles! I was upset when I opened these because I had ordered the rose gold, and I was only going to give three stars for receiving the wrong color. However, after looking at these more closely and holding them up to my cabinets, I actually think I like these better. Not only are they gorgeous, they match all of my oil rubbed bronze fixtures throughout my house. My mailbox, house numbers, all faucets, towel racks, shower racks, and some decor are the rubbed bronze color, and these tie in perfectly with that theme. These handles have a nice weight to them, you can tell they are real metal. They feel so smooth and luxurious to the touch. The pictures really don’t do them justice, it’s so hard to tell from a photo but these really are extremely nice drawer handles. I’m waiting until I get my cabinets refinished to use them in the kitchen, but I tested out the screws and they fit seamlessly into the handles. Sometimes with screws they feel like they just don’t like up right and it’s a pain to get them in all the way but these fit in flawlessly. I like that the screws are cuttable too, depending on the thickness of your drawer front/cabinet. Overall these are what I would call deluxe drawer/cabinet handles, and I would highly recommend them.

source_doc: Auto headrest tablet and hat holder that works OK with an additional installation step. I had a bit of trouble installing this. Rotating the knob behind the tablet holder is not as easy as they make it sound in the instructions. I couldn't get it tight enough to keep my 11" iPad Pro from drooping, so I thought I had it cross threaded. Through my efforts to tighten it by hand, I broke the knob. I glued and tried again the next day, but this time I used a pipe wrench to grip the knob while hand turning the tablet holder, which worked well enough so that now the tablet does not droop so easily. It's probably best for use with cellphones or lighter tablets.I love the hat holder feature. I keep large brim hats in the van to protect against the sun when going out for walks. Before I installed this holder, I was constantly moving the hats around in the van because I didn't have a good permanent place for them. As seen in the photo, I have two hats in the hat holder, the one in the back is hanging by it's chin strap.I wish I could use the nicely collapsible tray AND the hat holder but one is forced to choose between them.Now that it's installed and working, I'm happy to have this auto tablet and hat holder.

source_doc: Excellent guitar for beginner intermediate, minimal setup was required. The guitars fit and finish was perfect.  The fret ends were polished and smooth, the action was fine, there were no blemishes.  Upon tuning the guitar, I noticed the intonation was slightly off. Upon further examination, I found the one “holiday” , the setup man went on.  The bridge was pulling up, when the guitar was tuned.  I took off the back plate, the tension screws were tensioned too loosely and unevenly.  Two minutes I had it sorted, and this fixed the intonation.  I have included a picture of my practice setup. It included a Pock Rock, headphone amp, and effects processor(approx 40 bucks on Amazon), an old Fire tablet I had lying around, hooked into the line in, on the Pock Rock, and a pair of Vintage Sansui head phones.  I have a behringer ppa200(also available on Amazon approx 350 on Amazon), that I also use for my karaoke/movie night, senior charity,when I want to Amp the setup(also through the Pock Rock).  I know quite a few chords, but haven’t played in years.  Even though my next door neighbor says I’m not loud, and don’t bother her, the majority of time, I play with the headphones.  This little setup, is loads of fun, and I’m really enjoying it.

source_doc: I LOVE This Pan. This pan is one of the most remarkable pans I have ever used in my life.  First, let's talk heat distribution, which is often a factor in cooking and also, often a problem with a lot of pans.  Whatever process they have for making this pan, they have figured out the best and truly, I need an entire set of them.  We have several, high-end expensive sets and I could replace them all with just a different plethora of these pans.  This pan, will sear, but not "burn" anything.  I have actually tried- it just won't do it.  I love that feature and it doesn't seem to matter which burner I put it on, the pan cooks evenly through it's entire surface.  The handle is not only a "stay cool" handle, it's comfortable to hold and the overall pan is just extremely well-balanced.  It's very easy to clean and this is one of, if not THE go-to pan I use for most things I am cooking unless I need a bigger pan.  Although, this pan is quite big.  This would make a good pan for any gift, and they would LOVE you for it.  I intend to buy several more in different sizes and I feel like this company has really figured it out, through and through.  I highly recommend this and you can thank me later!  I hope you find this review helpful!!

source_doc: Like the semi transparent ones better ---- Fits Acura Sedan & similar model -- Read review. I ordered these sun shades during Amazon prime day, but since it is winter time I didn't use them. Well, I recently got some moles and freckles removed from my face, so I am in complete vampire mode. That means I apply globs of sunscreen on face and hiss at the sight of sunlight, that is ......... until my skin heals.Yesterday, I pulled out these shades, happy that there was a dark option to help me stay in vampire mode, but both of the dark shades would not stick to my window. Only the two transparent ones worked. The transparent one is ok, but not nearly enough shade for those who need to be out of the sun. The darker ones are much better.  In fact, I would rather have bought 4 semi transparent ones instead of 2 transparent and 2 semi transparent.I guess I received a defective batch, but I still give them 5 stars because I sent them a message explaining the above situation, and they promptly responded stating they stand by their products and will ship me 2 working ones. 5 stars for the amazing customer service. I wish all companies were like them. Anyway, don't be like me and use this a month later. Check to make sure all shades work right when you receive them.Hope my review helps!

source_doc: Great option for a wireless lav mic without breaking the bank! I had middle of the road expectations for this wireless last mic, compared to some other brands that I am more familiar with. But I saw that there was an excellent Black Friday sale, and I was desperately in need of a new wireless microphone like this, And it was recommended on one tech YouTube channel I saw, so I decided to give it a shot. I’m really glad that I did! A lot of times I am filming in an area where I am away from my phone, and the way this plugs into the charging port on the bottom is super convenient. The sound quality is also very good for what it is, and is  impressive to me more than I thought it would be. I would definitely buy this again, and I would recommend it to others.

source_doc: Probably my favorite mouse of all time. I had a G502 Hero wired mouse before this one. The way I had my cables routed I was constantly dealing with drag issues. I would leave the mouse still and watch the cursor move as the cable sagged. It's a minor annoyance at best...and I could have fixed it...but I treated myself to a new mouse and I'm not disappointed in the slightest. I'm not really a huge gamer but I do IT work from home and am at the computer for 8 - 12 hours pretty much every day. A comfortable mouse is a must and this is it! The battery seems to last about 2 - 3 weeks between charges. If I ever have to go back to the office, the fact that this is the non-RGB version works in my favor and it won't attract too much attention.The software is a bit on the finicky side. I like to run mine at 6400dpi. The defaults are not great and when the software updates I'm stuck waiting for the speed to pick up again while watching the splash animation play out. source_doc: I have owned this now for just over 3 years. So, I kind of forgot where I bought this. I was going through my "buy it again" list to try to remember what something I bought was called, and discovered I bought this on February 23rd 2020.Now, due to the pandemic, I actually spent a lot of time both on the road in both truck and motorcycle. In that time I've used this countless times for both air variation at elevation and temperature due to changing of seasons as well as being high in the mountains. I also use it nearly 3 times a week simply to check my motorcycle tire pressure.I've also used this for various reasons like getting myself or others off the highway, mounting new tires on any of the 3 motorcycles I use and even for limping 200 miles down the highway on my Africa Twin until I got to a shop with the correct sized tire for my bike.Shockingly, this cheap feeling and clunky mess of a product never once let me down, nor did it ever give an inaccurate reading on the pressure I have selected.Honestly, I've recommended this to multiple other riders as well as bought them for several friends and family members, all who have had zero problems with them.10/10 would spend $60 again.

source_doc: Thin and lightweight. I first started sleeping on a memory foam pillow some 20+ years ago. It radically changed the way I sleep. Though I fell asleep on my side, I always woke on my back. It was so much more comfortable for me that I won't use anything else. I got this pillow so I would have a spare. I was a bit taken aback by how small, thin, and lightweight it is compared to standard bed pillows. Even so, it is pristine, with a very nice quilted zippered case that can be removed for cleaning. It is firmer than the pillow I am used t, and I had my doubts that I would like it. But I slept on it last night and it was great! It will take a few more nights to determine if this is my new pillow of choice, but at the very least it will be a close second and will certainly be the one I take along when traveling!

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. It's a good quality handle with various types of brush heads. Right out of the box I could use it because it was charged which I like. I put the large brush head on to tackle the tub and turned it on...well hold on because I wasn't ready for the brush to take off once it made contact. It's spinning so it kind of spun right along on it's own, I had to get used to it to hold the brush down to clean the area I wanted. The main thing is you have to hold it at the right angle for the brush to make solid contact because the tip of the handle where you attach the heads is at an angle. With the attachment I have been using it's a little difficult to keep it in full contact so I feel like I am missing areas while I'm cleaning. That's why I say it's good for quick cleaning, not necessarily a thorough cleaning. The power also lasted awhile for me, I've used it about 4 times and it still has a charge. I like having this tool but at $75 the price is high in my opinion.
hypos: Хорошо для быстрой уборки. Эта электрическая вращающаяся щетка действительно хороша для быстрой уборки. Я не фанат/ка мытья ванной, и это помогает ускорить процесс. У нее качественная ручка с различными типами насадок. Сразу из коробки я смог/ла воспользоваться ею, потому что она была заряжена, что мне нравится. Я поставил/а большую насадку, чтобы приступить к мытью ванны, и включил/а ее... подождите, потому что я не был/а готов/а к тому, чтобы щетка начала вращаться, как только соприкоснулась с поверхностью. Она вращалась, поэтому как будто сама по себе прокатывалась, мне пришлось привыкать, чтобы прижимать щетку для очистки нужного мне участка. Главное, что вы должны держать ее под нужным углом, чтобы щетка имела надежный контакт, потому что конец ручки, к которому прикрепляются насадки, находится под углом. С насадкой, которую я использую, немного трудно поддерживать полный контакт, так что у меня создается ощущение, что я пропускаю участки во время уборки. Поэтому я говорю, что это хорошо для быстрой уборки, но не обязательно для тщательной. Также зарядка держалась довольно долго, я использовал/а ее около 4 раз, и она все еще заряжена. Мне нравится этот инструмент, но за 75 долларов цена, на мой взгляд, высокая.

source_doc: Good wireless earbuds. These are nice wireless earbuds. They fit pretty good, I have had one fall out a few times at the gym (I may need to change to a different ear cushion, which are included). I think the sound is very good, I like the bass-heavy music while working out. They seem to hold a charge a long time. The controls are a bit sensitive and I’ve accidentally skipped the controls I wanted. I have not used this for phone calls, so I cannot comment on the quality of talking on the phone. When I first connected my phone to these, the Bluetooth for the ear buds came up twice, and I only could hear out of one speaker (depending which one I chose, the left or the right) and I couldn’t get them to sync. The way I resolved it was “forgetting” both and shutting my Bluetooth off, then after turning it back on, it was only listed once, and they’ve worked fine ever since.

source_doc: Excellent so far. The box came in good condition. There were not a whole lot of pieces to assemble. I put this together myself in about 30 minutes and only because I did not look at the directions as carefully as I should have. I always look at the pieces in the box compared to the directions of what is to be be sent in the box. What I didn’t notice was the fine print that said some of those pieces came pre-assembled. I scratched my head at some of the other directions, but if you think it through, it will make sense.This machine is smaller than a magnetic rower and the arm motions are like rowing on water as opposed to just pulling back and forth. I used it the first time last night after putting it together. I could only take the number 1 setting in the tension as I have gotten out of shape except for indoor biking. I ended up using my VR headset to play Holofit and lost track of the time. It ended up being about 40 minutes. Today, I am sore all over, but a good sore. This machine really works the arms, back, and legs. After a few months, if this machine is as good as it is now, I will give it 5 stars.

source_doc: A life saver. source_doc: I wish I had gotten the larger one. I'm a bigger girl and this smaller one...well, I was able to get into it, but it wasn't exactly the most comfortable fit for me. I used a telescoping seat so that my feet, knees and hips could lift me up without me feeling like I might slip or fall on the water-slick bottom.  I got this as a possible camping bath and it may work.  I'll have to try it out in the field - use it like a stand up shower.  My feet stay clean as I have a rubber mat that I can put down next to this shower tub.  Camping is fun except when you have to go to bed all sweaty from hiking or just being out on the lake on a hot day.  Having a shower available makes my camping experience more enjoyable and I'm hoping this tub will work well - I think it will!

source_doc: Not enough fragrance. I really wanted to like this product. When it came out of the package, the scent packets smelled amazing. I put it in its holder and stuck it to the side of my trash can, which has its own tall cabinetry drawer. I expected to come back and smell lemons the next time I opened the trash drawer. I just smelled trash. I took the trash out and put a new trash bag in and shut the door. When I came back, I still could not smell lemons. I finally leaned over towards the scent packet and had to practically press my nose against the plastic holder to smell the lemons. I revisited the trash several times over two days and it never improved. I won’t be ordering this product again. The convenience of the holder and the great scent doesn’t make a difference if you can only smell it when it is in your face.

source_doc: So awesome probably for everyone. I just started to learn how to play. I bought this back in august and it has been amazing. When I purchased it I thought it was the 100% cordless one. It was not so I just went ahead and bought that smaller one too. I hate cords, and with my wireless sender / receiver and the smaller spark it’s going to be so freeing to go anywhere. Now if you’re new like me you will love this I promise. I matter who you are. If you’re a pro I am not sure but I am sure you would probably enjoy this as well. Also for such a small amp it packs a hell of a sound. Must buy.

source_doc: Great tissue holder! I really like these tissue holders!  I put one on each of my family's drivers side visor.  I DO think that it should come with at least two of this manufacturers small tissue packets though.  It would not cost that much more to include them with the tissue holders.  I DID end up purchasing refill tissues to fill up these holders.  I AM VERY PUZZLED as to why this company does NOT make these tissue holders the 'standard' size of tissues!  What I did do, is I took a stack of regular sized tissues and I cut them to fit these holders.  That works and cutting regular size tissues will save me money in the future when I need to refill my tissue holders!  I am glad that I purchased these holders, as these holders will prevent us from searching for our tissue boxes that we normally have in the back seat.  That task can be distracting at times, and that is not good when you're driving!

source_doc: Don’t hold their shape. These diaper inserts are very nice when you take them out of the package. The material is soft and a really nice off-white color. I was thrilled to receive these because I took a chance buying them without reviews. I really thought these were going to be amazing, especially as my first hemp inserts (the rest of mine are bamboo). However, after the first wash these inserts just shriveled up and I cannot straighten them back out. Feels like they’re just going to rip if I tug on the sides. I attached a photo, from left to right - Nora’s Nursery (bamboo), these inserts (hemp, and super wrinkly), then Thirsties (hemp). I actually bought another pack of these right when I first received them because they seemed thick and amazing, but now I’ll be returning them. I can still use the ones I’ve already washed, but I double them with a bamboo insert to make sure the wavy edges don’t bother baby. The wavy edges are also pretty rigid and not ideal. I’m a little disappointed, I really thought these were a hidden gem.

source_doc: This battery delivers its rated capacity of 100Ah. I have a Bluetti AC200P connected to a 6 circuit manual transfer panel and this works well.  I was looking for some extra battery capacity and watched many reviews of the different brands of 100Ah LifePo4 batteries.  Power Queen was a highly rated battery and their price was equal to about all the others.  However, Power Queen was running a promotion where you would get a 12.8V 6Ah battery for free with each battery purchase so I took advantage of that.  I decided to go with 2 of the Power Queen 100Ah batteries.  I use the smaller battery in my electric start gas generator.  I was able to test their capacity to ensure that I was getting the advertised 100Ah from them and I am pleased to say that each one delivered about 101Ah.  I now have them wired together in series to get 24V and then attach them to the solar generator through an adapter.  This works well although the solar generator only charges at about 340W.  I can't speak for the life cycle of these batteries but with a 5 year warranty, I am not to concerned about that.  I did have the opportunity to ask a question via email to Power Queen and they responded within a day.  I think that they were a good value and would buy again.
hypos: Эта батарея выдает свою номинальную емкость в 100Ач. У меня есть Bluetti AC200P, подключенный к 6-контактной ручной панели переключения, и это работает хорошо. Я искал дополнительную емкость батареи и смотрел много отзывов о разных марках батарей 100Ач LifePo4. Power Queen была высоко оцененной батареей, и их цена была равна примерно всем остальным. Однако Power Queen проводила акцию, по которой вы получали 12.8В 6Ач батарею бесплатно с каждой покупкой батареи, так что я воспользовался этой возможностью. Я решил приобрести 2 батареи Power Queen по 100Ач. Я использую меньшую батарею в моем газовом генераторе с электростартером. Я смог протестировать их емкость, чтобы убедиться, что получаю рекламируемые 100Ач, и мне приятно сообщить, что каждая из них выдала около 101Ач. Теперь я соединил их последовательно, чтобы получить 24В, а затем подключил к солнечному генератору через адаптер. Это работает хорошо, хотя солнечный генератор заряжает только на уровне около 340Вт. Я не могу говорить о цикле жизни этих батарей, но с 5-летней гарантией мне не слишком волнительно по этому поводу. У меня была возможность задать вопрос по электронной почте Power Queen, и они ответили в течение одного дня. Я думаю, что они были хорошей ценностью и купил/а бы снова.

source_doc: In love! I really love this bag! I needed something smaller, but still with a good amount of storage. I got the red, and it does unfortunately show oil/water stains very easily. I might be brave enough to try washing it eventually, if the staining becomes super obvious. But I love the four pockets around the sides. When I change and need to stash my phone or work badge, they come in so handy! The shoe pocket is perfect for my size 7-8 shoes. The strap is the perfect length and keeps the bag right where I need it, but still allows me to carry it in the crook of my arm too. Highly recommend! I got the medium because I don't need a ton of room. Just enough for a change of clothes. I will say I do have to cram my work clothes in there if I wear a bulky sweater. So if you need more room get the large!

My only issue is the lack or limited instructions of the product! Overall, this product is worth a try!

source_doc: Put the lotion in the (Amazon) basket. So what I didn’t think about was that my dogs really don’t like having their paws touched.  I swear I feel like Buffalo Bill in Silence of the Lambs every time I pull out the lotion.  But Reverend has very sensitive skin and his paws get dry and chapped in the winter so I’m willing to give off a few serial killer vibes to keep him healthy.My biggest concern though is that they both are obsessed with licking me when I put lotion on my own skin so I was pretty sure they were going to go to town on their feet after getting lubed up.  I wasn’t wrong.  Luckily this balm is made of food grade ingredients so while I won’t let Kudzu eat it straight from the jar - which he really wants to do- I don’t worry so much about them ingesting it.  As a bonus, it is virtually odor free so I don’t mind getting in a little extra moisturizing on my own paws while I’m massaging theirs. I am hopeful that with repeated exposure, they will learn to love their doggie spa treatments. And I will enjoy not being stepped on with paws that are rougher than a junk yard dog's.
hypos: Положите лосьон в корзину (Amazon). Я не подумал/а о том, что мои собаки на самом деле не любят, когда им трогают лапы. Честно, я чувствую себя как Баффало Билл из "Молчания ягнят", каждый раз, когда я достаю лосьон. Но у Рэверенда очень чувствительная кожа, и его лапы сохнут и трескаются зимой, поэтому я готов/а немного притвориться маньяком, чтобы сохранить его здоровье. Моя крупнейшая забота, однако, в том, что оба они одержимы лизанием меня, когда я наношу лосьон на свою кожу, так что я была уверена, что они начнут "разгуляться" с своими лапами после того, как их намажут. Я не ошибся/лась. К счастью, этот бальзам изготовлен из ингредиентов пищевого качества, так что, хотя я и не позволю Кадзу есть его прямо из банки - что он очень хочет сделать - я не так беспокоюсь о том, что они его проглотят. В качестве бонуса, он практически без запаха, так что мне не жалко немного подмочить свои лапы, пока я массирую их. Я надеюсь, что при повторном воздействии они научатся любить свои собачьи спа-процедуры. И я буду наслаждаться тем, что меня не топчут лапами, которые грубее, чем у собаки со свалки.

source_doc: Didn't Work !!! I bought this Jump Starter in summer because I  knew I might have problems with my car during the winter time and it happened. I didn't use my car for couple of day's and my battery was dead and it was really cold outside. So I decided to jump start it. I connected the jump starter per all the instructions and it didn't help. Unfortunately I came to the conclusion after I googled some info that it's a waist of money. It won't start your car when you have dead battery. Fortunately I asked my neighbor to jump start me and he had a really powerful portable jump starter that started my car in seconds. And I don't have old car, it's from 2017. I just don't drove very often. You can still use it as a portable power bank to charge your phone and light and that's about it. To expensive for a power bank.

source_doc: Great rower. Pros:  I have been using this rower for a few months now.  This is a great, sturdy, affordable rower! I do not personally have any trouble with the foot straps.  They are velco and very strong.  I love the whole body workout that I get from this rower.  I filled the water to maximum strength and after 10 minutes, my heart is pumping!  The seat is more comfortable than other rowers I have used, and seems to be a little cushioned as opposed to hard plastic which was one of the main reason why I purchased this one.  Having a comfy seat, will allow me to work out longer!Cons: I wish it came with a few water purification tablets.  I don't understand the electronic board and I threw away the manual.  I wish the timer would stay put instead of going back and forth to some other number.

source_doc: I don't game, but this is a great mouse for CAD and every day use. I switch between my Chromebook, MacBook Pro, and Windows desktop consistently, but I carry this one mouse around with me everywhere. Switching between bluetooth and the WiFi dongle is a blessing. I can switch the mouse to control different machines easily and on the go ;)When it comes to like buttons and comfort and clickyness and DPI and other miscellaneous gamery super-into-it mouse nerd kinda stuff, I have no idea. I like it. I CAD and do, like, normal computer stuff for work and personal stuff. Cool mouse. For CAD I map the two side buttons to whichever button is the orbit/pan modifier key, which has been pretty useful for switching between CAD programs. The other button I use as the esc key.I only wish I could pair it with more than one dongle so I can use the mouse on my desktop at home AND at work with wifi instead of bluetooth.

source_doc: Couldn't tell any difference in my curls.. I've heard so many good things about Olaplex so I thought I'd give it a whirl. Given how expensive it is, I was expecting a drastic change and moisturized curls. I literally could not tell any difference in my hair. I have 3a curls, shoulder length. I washed my hair like normal and followed with Okaplex. I even kept it on for about an hour (each product) then rinse and style as usual. My curls weren't moisturized, shinier, and weren't as defined as I was expecting. I used the products twice to make sure and followed instructions from a few YouTube tutorials. No luck. I ended up returning both products because I didn't want to waste $63 on hair products that didn't even work. I don't recommend for tight curls - it might do better on straight hair or waves.

source_doc: Surprisingly discouraged. I am disappointed. Ohora has the most incredible selection of colors… So I am bummed to discover such poor quality. I have tried many semi cured gel strip brands. I’ve been wearing them for a year consistently. I change my sets every two weeks, usually because I just want to change my manicure, very rarely do I have any shipping or peeling. With this brand I find they crack and ship far more quickly than any other. This set has already had two nails that chipped so I took them off & replaced. Now I have three more chipped nails.  I think I’m just going to give up and take them completely off.  I have other Ohora sets in my drawer that I won’t let go to waste but unless I’m pleasantly surprised by the others I try in the future, I would not recommend this brand again.  So sad bc the color options are for sure the best I’ve found.

source_doc: Versatile cat shelter. I helped a young feral cat all fall. I bought this shelter for him.  I was impressed with it's sturdiness, and how rain rolled right off.  I stuffed it with straw and he used it regularly.  Recently I found a barn home for him. I have 2 other feral shelters in the back yard so I wondered if I should leave this one out too.  I cleaned out the straw and put a soft rug in it. I put it back in one closet.  I was not sure if my inside cats would take to it, but they did. Now there's a race to see who gets it first. No need to hang a no vacancy sign on it.  One cat is always in it.

source_doc: It just looked too big - but fit perfect after I got the collar attached and on dog. Jack, my 16-pound female Corgi will have her Spay surgery in a couple of weeks.  Wanting to avoid the horror of a traditional cone, I chose this product to prevent her from bothering the stitches.  When I first opened the package, I really thought it was going to be too big.  I measured her and ordered according to the chart.  I tried to inflate using the included pump, but it wouldn't insert far enough to really work.  I did force it in and it did start to work, but it was taking FOREVER, so I hose to blow it up manually.  Just a few breaths and it was done.  (NOTE - the pump has a tip on it that WILL BE wonderful to deflate this item.)After getting it pumped up, I threaded her collar through the attached loops and after properly allowing her time to get used to it, I placed this on her.  She didn't like it, of course, but did tolerate it.  I do think this will be a better option than the cone after her surgery.

source_doc: easy on belly, works as topper to kibble and/or home cooked. I also use in treat toys. So far so good. I have been giving my 7 years old baby girl home cooked meals, but wanted to make sure she has a good base. Recently she hasn't wanted her usual kibble, and this coincides with a cancer diagnosis.To whet her appetite, I focused more on the foods she loves, and then began adding in more vegetables. I happened to have a bag of Purina Beyond Organic dry food that when I offered it to her she seemed to like it. So then I decided to use that as a base, add the home cooked foods, then top off with some wet food. I basically want to make sure I am not missing out on anything nutrient wise. She seems to like this wet food.It is chunks with gravy, not a pate. She is on prednisone which has increased her appetite. I give her food in between regular meals to keep her belly happy. I have put some of this into treat toys for her to work on. I haven't totally figured out the best diet for her, but so far the combo of food I have been giving her has been easy on her stomach, has been making good poops, and seems to enjoy it a lot. I have already ordered some other variations from Purina Beyond offerings.

source_doc: Just as described! My machine was delivered Feb 4th. I started using it that day. Easy assembly. Only took 30 min. I use it about 3-4 times a week. 1st couple days I didn't use any bands to get used to the machine, then I started using 1 of them. I rotate excercise, 1 day I do 200 squats with only 1 band. Next day I do 50 squats no band, 50 with 1 band, anther 50 with 2 bands and back to 1 band to complete my 200 squats. I hit my zone minutes but can get used to it very easily which is why I keep switching up the routine. I am on a calorie deficit and this is the only exercise I do. I plan to try using the deadlift "feature" of this machine this week to add more workouts. I love it. Worth the purchase to me!Editing to add: I started using the deadlify feature this week and definitely will continue using it.  You can feel the burn where the squats wasn't!!

source_doc: Bring the water bottle! Due to a surgery I had, I'm extremely prone to dehydration, so I carry a water bottle with me everywhere I go. My favorite is my Owala Free Sip 32oz. source_doc: Great item for the money fixed up my oil leak! I purchased this and was concerned about the low price.  I cleaned it out thoroughly looking for debri before proceeding with install and found none.From reading other "cheap" replacement oil filter housing reviews most folks advocated for replacing the oil and temp sending unit.  The last thing I want to do is strip the engine down as far as I did for one of those.  I went ahead and bought auto part store senders and replaced what was on here.  It may have worked fine I just didnt want to dig back in to the engine for them.You have to take off the upper and lower initakes to get to this.  I found over a quart of oil sitting on top of the engine that I had to clean out.  Once replaced and everything re-installed I am happy to report that I have used my inspecting camera and a simple "dip stick" to try to find oil under the intake and it has come back clean.  I put this in before Christmas so as of this review over a month and so far so good.Very happy that my oil leak is finally solved!
