source_doc: Simple Tool Makes for Easy Work! I love these. I have been buying them for a few years. Fret polishing is a task that never goes out of style and these fret erasers make easy work of a tedious task. This is the first time I got the 180 grit eraser so I am really excited to see how that will work on some of the more stubborn scratches and tool marks that I find on frets. They are pretty simple to use, I tape off the fret board and then use them just like an eraser. I go fret by fret with each eraser working my way up from the lower grits to the higher polishing grits. This kit has the 1000 grit which I have already but I would encourage buying the 2000 grit eraser or using a finger nail buffer stick to really nail the mirror shine. I not only recommend, but I use them myself and love them!

source_doc: I love these. These are perfect for me. I have a small coffee machine and my current coffee mugs, ( aka: run out the door making coffee in the last minute) are too large for the machine. I also needed some smaller ones so I didn’t have to drink so much more liquid when I work at a manufacturing place and don’t want to have to go to the bathroom so soon after I get to work… anyways, I like the colors and the simple lid. They seal very tightly and the coffee comes out nicely. I have had ones with the small holes be very difficult to get the coffee to come out.The only problem is the lids are a bit difficult to turn when putting them on or taking them off. I put the “over” the lid, lid up and use it to help turn the whole lid. I still want to buy more of them. I even use them at home just so I don’t spill.

Мне также нужны были более маленькие, чтобы не пить так много жидкости, когда я работаю на производстве и не хочу сразу после прихода на работу бежать в туалет... Я все еще хочу купить больше таких кружек. Я даже использую их дома, чтобы не проливать.

source_doc: American AF. I have a really extensive, high quality knife collection and this particular knife I believe would be the one knife I would take if I could only have one. I have knives that cost much more, made of "better steel", superior finish etc, but this is the one. On mine I used a manual mill and a 3/8 endmill (better than filing imo) to take off just enough to give it a sharp 90 deg spine. Not necessary but that's what I did and that is the only mod that I wanted to do. May get a leather dangler sheath for when I want it like on my rat7, but I love this sheath. It's kinda tacticool, but rides high for my liking. SOLID locking in the sheath though. Surprisingly easy to unsheath with a little thumb push. This thing just works well, feels intuitive and doesn't leave you wanting. It's high enough quality that it always looks the part if ya know what I mean. A no brainier. As a (I hate "as a" comments) American, I believe we should be issued on of these at birth.

source_doc: It’s fun and enjoyable. I’ve never picked up a guitar in my life until this was delivered so I can’t attest to playability or quality. I did swap out the strings when I got it but more because I wanted to learn how to do it than any perceived problem with the strings that came with it. I can say I have enjoyed experimenting and learning with this guitar.  I paired it with an “Orange” amp and despite not having a clue what I’m doing have been able to replicate sounds like ‘old school’ heavy metal to clear/clean tones that could pass for country or blues if played by someone who knew more than 2 cords. I suspect in trained or experienced hands this guitar would be a good, but not great, guitar.A few things I did notice…1. There are some exposed wires coming out from under one of the pickups and the middle pickups are not level. 2. There is some discoloration on the body of the guitar  3. The tuning peg for the high E is finicky and sometimes feels unresponsive which can make tuning a pain.For what I paid, I didn’t expect perfection, and I have no idea if the uneven pickups impact playability or sound quality, the remainder are cosmetic or just frustrating. I think this probably represents a solis starter guitar or a good rehearsal/travel guitar for more experienced players.

source_doc: Nice Fit and Look but Having to Replace the Washer Nozzle with OEM Disappointing. I really liked the look of this and it was a perfect replacement. I ordered the black version to accent my Black Jeep which I was really glad I did for the look!However there is where my problems came and why I only gave 3 stars. It comes with a paper saying to replace the Washer Nozzle that comes with it with the old OEM version from the one you are removing.YOU MUST DO THIS because The Nozzle that comes with it is terrible and basically squirts a stream of water down the back instead of spraying it. I found this out the hard way.First, because I ordered the Black version it would look real goofy with the Red nozzle on it. That’s why I ignored the manufacturers direction. So I had to mask off and paint my old red nozzle to match black.Second, because the original OEM nozzle was old the plastic was brittle and one of the securing clips molded into it was broken in the process. You cannot buy just the nozzle and have to buy the whole light assembly so I had to do some engineering to make it work.The manufacturer needs to fix this functional nozzle issue and not make Customers have to hassle with this. If it weren’t for this I would have given it 5 stars!

source_doc: Great for making some 'fancy' coffee. I really like this brother.  It's easy to use, and quicker and easier to clean than the frother cups (although, I do love my frother cup when I want heated milk).The frother itself is very nice quality, and the digital display is nice and clear.  I've had it for a few months now, and I haven't had any issues with it.  I've only tried the wisk attachment, because I can't for the life of me find the other attachment. I don't know if I didn't get it, or if I misplaced it.  But, the wisk does a great job at making some fluffy milk foam for my lattes!  Operation is smooth, and it's easy to adjust the strength of the mixer by twisting the little ring with the ridges.I keep this on the coffee station, in front of my frother cup, because I use this one more because of its ease of use when I'm in a rush (which is always).The stand only works for me if I remove the wisk attachment, so that's what I do.Overall, I'm really happy I got this.  It's been saving me a lot of money that would have gone to Starbucks.  Now, I have my own coffee shop in my home.  The price is comparable, and in my opinion this one is a better deal over others because of the smooth operation of it, along with the digital screen.

source_doc: Not anti-kink hose. I've had this hose for over 4 years now and have used it many times in the travel trailer.  I also have the 10' version to use when the trailer is much closer to the water outlet at campgrounds.  I wish I could use the 10 footer all the time, but many times I need to get the 25' hose out, which drives me nuts.  It's a real pain to put back in the storage bin if it's slightly cold out as it won't coil up neatly and I have to fling it all around to get it to curve correctly so it goes in the bin.  It has several kinks in it that won't go away.  So, yeah, not anti-kink in my opinion and it's been that way ever since I got it.  (Didn't realize I hadn't reviewed it until I was searching my orders for another hose I purchased a few years ago.)  I'm about ready to toss it as I just ordered another 10 footer and will connect the two together when I need to.  The good thing about the hose - knock wood, it's never leaked or split in the years of periodic usage.  But, yeah, anti-kink is a lie.  Can't really address the hooking issue as I have it hooked to a Hose-Grip from J Wright Concepts, which is wonderful and a device every camper needs!

source_doc: The flies sure seem to like it. Wow. I mixed up a small batch of this stuff and dumped in a maybe half a dozen fruit flies from a store bought culture. I've got loads of flies now. I'm going to need more spiders.I put maybe a quarter cup of powder in a clean quart size plastic container that previously contained soup from Costco. I added boiling water and stirred, adding more water a little at a time until I had a mixture that would generally keep it's shape but would flatten out if I banged the container on the counter. While it cooled, I cut a roughly 1.5 inch square in the lid of the container. When the mixture was cool, I added the flies and put a coffee filter on top of the container, followed by the lid. Then I just set it aside and waited. It took maybe a week and a half before I saw new signs of life. Now I have a very active colony (swarm?) of flightless fruit flies. I've added new members from another store bought culture to perhaps improve genetic diversity. I don't know if it'll do anything. All I know is I had a few flies and now I have a zillion.

source_doc: A Most Excellent Mouse. The M913 is an excellent office and gaming mouse.  I have been a Razer user for years.  I was having problems gripping my mouse due to injuries to both hands and wrist so I went on Amazon to find a new mouse that wasn't over $100.  I came across the M913 and found the features perfect for me and I bought it and the gaming pad.A week after I had been using it I was misusing the software (I forgot to turn the mouse on) and was trying to turn it on thru the software.  Strictly a user error.  I contacted the company thru their website by filling out the form.  Since it was late Sunday night and it was one of those fill out the form and hope for the best I did not expect an answer for several days.  I was surprised and very happy when a tech support person sent me an e-mail with the easy fix.  My mouse was fixed in less than 10 minutes!  I am now a dye hard fan of Red Dragon perifels.  Thank you Red Dragon for a superior product.

source_doc: Best sleep ever!!! Okay, so I know this is an "Air Bed" (super-sized mattress) and not a standard or "real" bed but I've tried a bunch of "real" beds and have consistently had lower-back pain when I got up each morning. In desperation I thought I couldn't lose by buying and trying this Air Bed. Changed my life!!! EXTREMELY comfortable ALL NIGHT LONG! As you can see from the pics, I use it differently than most: (a) I found the fabric side with the channels to be less comfortable than the bottom so I inverted it with wonderful results; (b) by inverting the bed, the fabric catches on the carpet better than the smooth side so it doesn't shift when I get on or off of it; and (c) I didn't want to have to deal with fitting sheets so I just bought an inexpensive sleeping bad and it worked perfectly. I have the twin xl version and a double sleeping bag fits just right. I use this EVERY NIGHT and have been doing so for weeks. I do have to top off the air each night for about 10 or 15 seconds as there is a tiny leak. I couldn't find any air escaping so I'm assuming it's getting out through the built-in fan assembly. No biggee, though. I highly recommend this critter!!

source_doc: The plastic adheres when soaked. I bought these as liners for my reusable belly bands. First of all, I realize they do give measurements but you definitely need to go larger than a belly band sizing to get them to fit, so I should've gotten bigger ones. I think the length is inadequate to the width for the absorbance to wick away if you have an excessive urinator, which I do. But the worst part is when they're fully soaked, which happens quickly with my foster cairn that had bladder stones previously, then the plastic backing will sort of permanently stick to your fabric belly band. I had to soak in very hot water and pick away at it to get it all off. This had happened several times, so I won't be rebuying. I honestly should return them it's so bad. I much rather keep with the disposable Amazon brand wraps. My dog chews on those so I have to cover with a fabric one to keep him from eating them and as backup if they become soaked. I'm honestly surprised at the rating level on these, because that's why I tried them. It should be lower.

Мне пришлось замачивать в очень горячей воде и снимать это, чтобы все убрать. Это происходило несколько раз, так что я не буду повторно покупать. Честно говоря, мне следует их вернуть, так плохо. source_doc: Simple plug and start using. Was getting tired of using my earpods for video calls on phone. The mic just wasn't clear for those on the other side.I was curious about these and well, decided to try them.  WOW... worked great right out of the box.  My iPhone quickly connected and I was able to start using.  I did a voice recording so I could hear the quality. It was sharp and crisp.Now I have no excuse to podcast off my phone other than I don't like hearing my own voice.I at times have a friend with me and we do video call and have to position phone to get both our voices or hand it back and forth.This came with TWO lapel clip mics so now we can each wear one and keep the phone propped for video call.Will need to get proper cable adapter to try and get this to connect to my laptop. It doesn't have iphone or usb-c ports so I will have to get back to y'all once I get proper cable.  I expect it to work.I'm wondering if I can get a small speaker to connect this to when I am working the company booth. I usually end up almost yelling and losing my voice at days end.  That is my next project for these.

source_doc: “High density” does Not mean that it is hard enough. I attached a photo that some might find helpful about ways to use this block. I’m a yoga teacher.  Speaking from a place of experience and a certain kind of conditioning I prefer hard blocks. I have felt three inch (as opposed to four) lightweight hard foam blocks that are amazing. Such a block is great for a high amount of pressure that is therapeutic. Still trying to find a brand other than Manduka. So here I learn that “high density” doesn’t necessarily mean that it’s hard enough. I tried this block and i will return it. It is flimsy when using it on high height in something like the supported shoulder bridge which you can see in the attached image. I think I remember as a beginner I liked soft blocks because it felt more comfortable. Then I learned. So I hope that is helpful. Maybe everyone reading this is the type of beginner that doesn’t want a hard block. I have gotten off-brand cork blocks here which cost a bit more but have perfect density and hardness.

source_doc: Finally a mirror that works in my Honda! I was struggling greatly to find a rear facing baby mirror for my Honda Civic.  The reason? All of the backseat headrests are NOT movable! The headrest is part of the seat. Most mirrors with attached straps and gadgets direct you to strap the mirror under the headrest which does not work for my type of backseat. I was trying my best not to purchase a suction cup mirror to place on the window because I knew it would fall off depending on the weather, condensation and so forth. Luckily I came across this mirror, and even with reading reviews, I could not come across anyone who had my same type of backseat issue but gave it a try anyway. I was hesitant because just like the others, it came with straps to go across and under the headrest. Fortunately, I was able to strap the mirror around my attached headrest seat without using the strap used to go under the headrest. I pulled it tight and was able to maneuver the mirror to angle down on my baby perfectly! It works so well and doesn’t move! The mirror is very large so as I looked in my rear view mirror, I am able to see my child fully and clearly! She loves looking at herself too!I am very happy with this purchase- I just wished I bought it sooner!

source_doc: Easy to set up, a bit complicated to get full measurements. Since I am spending more time in my basement, I decided I wanted to know more about the radon level there. Several years ago, when the house was rented, a one month radon test was done that indicated above standards radon level, so a radon mitigation system was put in. Lately I have been spending more time in the basement, so I decided I wanted more info on the radon levels. There are less expensive radon monitors, but because of the reputation and history of this company, it is the one I chose. Setup is simple, though you don't get immediate readings for radon (though you do for temperature and humidity. You have to wait 3 days to get radon values. When they started showing up on the monitor, the levels increased over the next few days, but were in the safe range. Since I have a science background, I also wanted to see the detailed maeasurements. Airthings has both an app and a web site (called the Airthings Dashboard). Both are needed to get all the information from the meter. The app gives 1, 7 and 30 day average values, the Dashboard gives graphs over various periods. Since I don't have any other monitors to compare with I can't say how this compares in accuracy or ease of use to other systems, but this seems to be working well and indicates my radon mitigation system is working.

Настройка устройства проста, хотя немедленно получить данные о радоне не получится (зато данные о температуре и влажности отображаются сразу). Нужно подождать 3 дня, чтобы получить значения радона. Когда они начали отображаться на мониторе, уровни радона увеличились в течение следующих нескольких дней, но остались в безопасном диапазоне. Учитывая мой научный опыт, мне также хотелось увидеть детализированные измерения. У Airthings есть приложение и веб-сайт (называемый Airthings Dashboard). Оба необходимы для получения всей информации с устройства. Приложение предоставляет средние значения за 1, 7 и 30 дней, а Дашборд предлагает графики за различные периоды. Поскольку у меня нет других мониторов для сравнения, я не могу сказать, как это соотносится по точности или удобству использования с другими системами, но, похоже, оно работает хорошо и свидетельствует о том, что моя система снижения радона функционирует.

source_doc: Spendy in my opinion, even though I love them. I am 5*3" 170lbs. I was worried that these shorts would sacrifice comfort for absorbency, but I was wrong. These shorts are comfy that I would definitely wear them even when not on my period.They arrived at the end of my period so I can't yet talk about functionality... But from what I can tell I really think these will be better than all the other methods I've tried. Each method has their own setback. Even with every thing I've tried I have never in my 29 years been leak free during a period. Some products work better than others, like the cup... Less leaking, but still leaking. And inconvenient.I'm hoping this will address the issue.One thing I need to say is I love that they have pockets, but one of the pockets have a big hold in them. Their are threads where it could be closed. I just think they didn't sew it together. That was disappointing, but fixable.I just need to mention it because these are expensive... I'm not happy with the price point. I love the comfort and the quality of the fabric. Even without the shoddy sewing, these should not be this expensive!

source_doc: Perfect for my needs!! I am preparing for a Uromastyx. I am getting the enclosure, lights, and decor just right before I get my new guy or girl. I want to add some wood pieces in and these work for me. I couldn't really picture the sizes when I ordered them, so I just went with this size as it was a little larger. If you have a big enclosure, you may want to get even larger. I have a 4x2x2 (120 gallon) enclosure from dubia.com. My enclosure is huge!! I think I will end up buy a few more pieces of wood that are at least 14 inches and up. I have rocks, bricks, tile, and these wood pieces. There is still lots of room for more. I am happy with the look and feel of this wood. It shipped very fast. I have no issue with it. It is perfect for a smaller tank or enclosure. It is fine for a larger one also, just understand you may need bigger ones as well. I don't regret my purchase and would buy again. I think it adds layers and lots of areas to climb on.

source_doc: Maybe mine is defective... When this bottle warmer arrived I was so excited to try it.  After unpacking I noticed that ours is missing the lid for the formula cup---we don't use formula so I thought that is not a big deal.  I cleaned all the pieces and charged it overnight for use the following day.  The next day, I took a bottle out of the fridge, found the correct adapter, screwed it on tightly, and set it to heat the bottle to 98 degrees Fahrenheit.  After about seven minutes, the milk was ready.  I turned the warmer so the bottle was upright with everything attached and it leaked milk all over my hand.  After removing the bottle from the warmer, I turned the warmer on its side which is supposed to stop the heating function, but I noticed that the little red light that indicates the device is heating came on.  For a bottle warmer that costs $79.99 USD, this should not leak, and the automatic turning off of the heating element should work as advertised, but the one I received did not.  It is possible that I simply received a dud, but for the price I am not impressed.

source_doc: Love it! I really like these “mood ease” gummies. I seem to worry about everything, and this supplement has definitely helped with my anxiety.  I imagine it’s because of the Chamomile and Ashwagandha, which seems to work for me. I love gummies so I was glad to see that this product is sugar free. The suggested use is two gummies a day, so one bottle will last a month. The bottle was sealed very tightly, and the product seemed fresh. I really enjoyed the flavor which had a slight cranberry flavor.  I would never have thought to try a product such as this, but I am really glad that I did. As long as this keeps working for me, I plan on continuing its use. I recommend it!

source_doc: stomach ache after consuming. I have always loved these but I am discarding nearly the entire tray into garbage today as I ate 3 and had a stomach ache/central channel pain occur about 2 hours later and for the next 12 hours.  Seriously, a middle aged man in great shape and I had pain that was terrible until the chocolates passed through my system.  I then waited a few days and had a couple more and the same thing happened.  I have ruled out other items I ate and do not make such claims lightly.  I felt poisoned and am writing this review in hopes it doesn’t happen to anyone else. I wish I had read the other reviews about expired product… I think there’s something seriously wrong with these chocolates.

source_doc: Great price, cool smart LED charge light, does the trick. I was amazed at how low this was priced. It does exactly what I need it to and I like that it is made for two controllers. I love how the LED indicated changes to blue when the charge is complete. One thing that I don’t love about it is that my PS4 controller charge ports fit really snug on the charger. I can actually lift a controller and the whole charging dock comes up with it. I have to wiggle the controller out. Maybe this won’t bother anyone else but I kind of dislike that. I am still very happy with the product. Like I said, great price and does exactly what I need it to.

source_doc: It really works. I was a bit wary of devices to help cool my Series X and finally decided upon this one.  I am glad I did.  I know some mentioned the fan gets noisy, but I really do not notice it.  On my Series X, the temperature has definitely dropped and i like the temp readout on the unit.  It does have three automatic fan speeds with corresponding colours, but it has kept the unit cool enough that it always stays on the lowest speed, despite playing nex gen games.  I really am glad I bought it.  It fits perfectly on the top of the console, I have mine laying on its side and it looks like it came from the factory with this installed.  I would recommend it at this point as I have had no issues.

source_doc: A great dissapointment. The characters are one demensional tropes that I couldn't care less about, the story is bland and predictable and the dialouge is pointless. I feel like I know as much about all of my companions 11 chapters in as I did when I first picked them up and I am A ranked with most of them.The world seems shallow and uninteresting. I have no drive to play the game because I have no feeling of imersion and connection (both important in a story driven RPG) to keep me invested and wanting to fight on.The combat system seems dumbed down and boring. And since, as I said above, the characters are just tropes that I don't care about I don't care when they die beyond losing a unit for battle.Even the character and world design seems lacking.I REALLY wanted to like this game. Three Houses is one of my favorite games of all time, but this just seems like a poorly done nostalgia cash grab.

source_doc: I can never go back. I was very skeptical about this car seat. I held off on using to start with but then I had no other option as my son and I were in an accident that rendered his current car seat unusable. Thank goodness I just this one ready to go. The user manual explained well how to install and adjust for your kiddo. I was able to install quickly and easily, I love the lock bar in the base to ensure a tight fit! The straps are easy to adjust. And I love that I don’t have to reach around and maneuver to get my kid in his seat, especially now that he’s in the wrestle phase of getting in the car. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to use a “normal” car seat after the ease of this 360 seat. It’s also very plush and comfy and has all the safety of other evenflo seats!

source_doc: These are perfect for me. I am a guitar hobbyist. I like to play for a couple hours at a time and know only a few songs. I love to experiment and just goof around. Since the 80s, the biggest irritation has been guitar cables.. Whether I am tripping over them, snagging them, or the connections get loose and the awful static sound ruins whatever I am trying to play. I hate cables.This is my first set of wireless connectors and I have to saw that I think they are Awesome! No more cables and I can walk around while I play. On top of that, when the wife wants some quiet time, I plug in my headphones straight in to the transmitter and can keep playing. The sound is pretty good and I like the distortion effect the most as it has a slight delay effect. The other effects are good too, but I really like the distortion. I do wish that the sound were a bit louder like my old headphone amps were, but for this price, I am happy with the connectors, just the way they are.

source_doc: Fit well and actually work! When buying these I was a bit skeptical because they were so much cheaper than pants from an actual motorcycle store. However, I got a jacket from a store and was trying to save money so I decided to purchase these pants. Unfortunately I got into a motorcycle accident a couple weeks ago; however, I found out the pants actually work!! There was rain on the road, I had to make a sudden stop, my bike lost traction, slid on its side, and threw me off once it hit a car. I must have slid 15ft on the asphalt, got up and was completely fine besides a few impact bruises. On top of me being fine, the pants are also fine, no rips or tears. I will continue to wear them once I fix my bike. After this experience I had to write a review because I did not see any that mentioned wearing them in a accident.A few reviews mentioned upgrading the padding inside, which I could definitely see and probably would have helped with the impact bruises. But overall these pants are WELL worth the price and I would highly recommend. Saved me from some really bad injuries!Will try to upload pictures when my phone is fixed.

source_doc: Awesome for first time bike user! I love this bike! I have never used an exercise bike before but after researching what exercise equipment is good for low impact I thought I would try this out. I read another review that said this bike is only good for experienced users and I highly disagree. I will say I did have to replace the seat with a comfort seat as the stock seat hurt so much. I have zero issues with the new seat and can go for a while on my bike. I love the water bottle holder and the outlet for my tablet. I haven't downloaded the free app yet as I have been using other free videos for exercises. I highly recommend this bike for first time users!

source_doc: Well ... if it's all you've got, it's better than nothing i guess. I really wish I'd taken photos of this after i used it the second time. I was hacking at a relatively small branch of a tree for my pet squirrel's habitat. It was the second time i used it and up until this use, i felt it was pretty sturdy and durable. I aimed and struck about 4 times and the ax head just broke right off the handle. I definitely wasn't expecting the head to just fall off. I'm hoping it was just an issue with this one ax and not the entirety of them. Like, maybe i just got a defective or a bad one ? Not going to pay more money to find out though. I hope you have a better experience with yours than i did mine if you do purchase one.

source_doc: Nice, small rack.  Screw holes are not 16" apart and thus cannot be attached to studs. This is a review of "touekeng Garage Storage Tool Organizer,Garage Organization Wall Mount Rack Hanger,Super Heavy Duty Steel Garden Tool Organizer (3 Hooks, 1 Rails 16 in).”I hung this organizer today.  It’s not quite 16 inches long.  The furthest apart screw holes were not 16” apart - more like 15”.  I was close enough to the studs that I hope the screws caught some of the wood, but I couldn’t tell.  I may have to rehang it using the drywall anchors.  The padded hooks are nice, heavy-duty and versatile.  I like that I could configure them however I liked.  I couldn’t figure out what the rubber gasket was for, so I didn’t install it with it.  It was loose in my packaging.  I’ve tried to reinsert the gasket, but it's too hard to get it in now.  I don’t really think it makes much difference.It’s a nice small organizational piece for my garage.  I’m happy to have all the organizational help I can get!  I reduced the rating by one star because the screw holes weren’t 16” apart.

source_doc: Don't let first impressions fool you! I love to karaoke. I don't sing well, but I still love trying. I was so excited when the machine arrived! I tore open the box and my excitement turned immediately into disappointment! I actually laughed when I saw this little box that was supposed to be my new karaoke machine! I thought I'd been had! Still, I had to see how bad it was going to be. Guess what? It actually works pretty darn good! The sound is really good, and gets plenty loud. We just connected my cell phone with blue tooth, loaded the playlist and I was singing my little heart out! Just like that! I still haven't experimented with all the features, but we did try out the voice changing one and it's hilarious! We had a blast on New Years Eve with this machine! source_doc: Making a clunk noise when R click. I bought this mouse March 2021 so it's not 2 yrs old yet and the last few months I have noticed a loud clunk when I right click. I don't use any of the other buttons other than R & L click. I just like the shape of the mouse. It is really comfortable, although sometimes my pinky is hanging off to the side and gets stiff. The battery lasts a long time. I shut it off when I'm not using it to preserve battery as well as not use the lights as I stated above. I purchased the protection plan so I guess I will put that to use and get a new mouse. Would expect this mouse to last longer and not make funny noises even at the low price.

source_doc: Seemed great until I realized how off it was. I thought this would be the best thermometer ever because it can quietly read a sleeping child’s temp or easily read another child’s temp without contact. We have had this thermometer for 6 months and I thought it was reading accurately the whole time (we have used it maybe 10-15 times) and battery is still great. But when I took my 6 month old’s temp it kept saying 98 or 99 and I just KNEW she felt hotter than that. So I got our the trusty rectal thermometer and sure enough it read 4° higher! I understand it being a decimal off but FOUR DEGREES? That’s unacceptable. I wish I would have done this test months ago so I could have returned it! I got this thermometer because it had thousands of great reviews!

source_doc: Works so good but you'll never use this much. First of all my child had mild cradles cap, or so I thought. source_doc: Great Upgrade from HF Cheap Spray Gun! I will start by saying that I am not a professional, really only a weekend woodworker so my experience with HVLP spraying is limited at best.  I bought a discount big box store HVLP sprayer to dip my feet in the waters, only to find that it did not come with a nozzle wrench. After using it a few times and using channel locks to remove the nozzle for cleaning, etc. I decided it was time to buy a wrench, however just finding one is a chore and they tend to cost as much as another HVLP sprayer, so when I found this set I thought "Why Not?" since it comes with a wrench and a couple of other tips.Upon receipt of this gun, I decided to give it a try because I struggled with my cheap gun to get a good finish when spraying polyurethane. All I can say is there is a night and day difference. This gun is easy to set up and the spray pattern is SO MUCH BETTER!!! Not only that, cleaning it seems to also not be as tedious, not sure why because it basically has the same parts. If I ever need to replace it, I will order another one and recommend it to anyone looking to jump into the world of HVLP spraying.

source_doc: Definitely worth a play at a discounted price. Feels like a PS2 era game in regards to voice acting and hack and slash combat but, it’s actually pretty challenging to master the combat in this game. You can actually do some pretty neat things with the gum and katana strung together. You can also hit and then guard cancel into another attack to save animation frames, the game never explains this but once you get a hang of the combat it’s actually a lot of fun.The huge issue I have personally for the game is that it is somewhat too difficult. I have played the game about 7 hours and beaten a couple of bosses and I understand the gameplay loop and how to play, I just feel the checkpoint system makes the game too challenging. The game itself is difficult, but I genuinely enjoy the combat and the challenge to some extent, I just need more checkpoints after completing a challenging area. Often times I will play through a 5-10 min section of the game, just to die and have to replay it, over, and over again. I feel like I really do enjoy how tough the combat feels because overall it feels fair, but it’s hard to not make many mistakes through the long combat sections and overall I ended up losing interest in the game prior to finishing it. I don’t want the Combat to be easier, I just need more checkpoints.

source_doc: You Get What You Pay For. EDIT!!! I increased my rating to 4 stars. I think one of the batteries I received is just weaker than the other. I used one of the batteries to screw down some decking today. I drove about 240 screws and the battery was still going. So maybe I got one great battery and one mediocre battery.Here's my original review:The battery life is terrible. I fully charged both of them before use. I put the first one into an 18 volt Dewalt circular saw and cut some pressure treated 2x4's and 2x6's. I made about 12 to 14 cuts before the battery was completely dead. And even at the beginning, when the battery was fully charged, I could tell that the saw was struggling to cut through the wood. With the factory Dewalt battery that's not an issue.I used the other battery in a drill to drive decking screws. It lasted about half as long as I would expect my factory battery to last.Having said that, a 2-pack of Dewalt batteries costs $200, so for $200 I could buy 2 Dewalts or 11 of these batteries. So I guess these are a bargain. But hopefully you have more than 1 charger, because you'll be constantly recharging these.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.

Порции, которые она выдает, идеально подходят для моих собак. Теперь я могу контролировать, когда и сколько они едят, пока меня нет дома. Мне также нравится возможность наблюдать за ними и общаться с ними. Хотя они немного радуются, услышав мой голос, я замечаю разочарование, когда меня на самом деле нет рядом. Поэтому я стараюсь ограничить общение. Иногда, когда подается еда, они начинают возиться друг с другом, и я могу сказать им остановиться, и обычно они слушаются. В целом, эта авто-кормушка с множеством функций дает уверенность в том, что ваши маленькие пушистики получают свою еду, и видеть, как они счастливы, когда это происходит. Я с большим удовольствием рекомендую эту кормушку.

source_doc: Attractive and everything I wanted but..... I adore Lobster and Crab so I was excited to get this set.  The Crab Crackers were the best tool.  They were sturdy as were the red tools. But I was disappointed.  The Shellfish Scissors were flimsy, and I was afraid they were going to break.  I was super careful with them, and the metal picks were also flimsy, and I was afraid they were going to bend so I was afraid to pull crab meat out of the shells. I did not try the set on Lobster.  It was not an expensive set so I guess I got what I paid for............

source_doc: Use to be good, but not anymore. -UPDATE- I bought these almost a year ago, I don’t remember how long the 1st one lasted, but I replaced it at some point, and gave 1 away to a friend. Recently I’ve had problems with my camera focusing, and wondered if the lens had gotten dirty somehow, so I removed it. (it is a problem some phones have apparently) I couldn’t get it to stay on, so I ordered more. In less than a week the first one was shattered, even though I didn’t drop my phone. I just noticed yesterday the 2nd one is now cracked. Not sure if material got cheaper or what, but all I can think is that they don’t hold up even if I’m lightly leaning against a desk or something, because I haven’t dropped my phone in a long time, certainly longer than I’ve had these lenses for. Guess I’ll have to see if I can’t find a better option.-UPDATE-After leaving my review, the seller reached out to me and offered to send a replacement. So far it’s worked out. Wonderful customer service.

source_doc: This made me extremely nauseous. I read the benefits of taking 400mcg of folic acid & decided to entail this in my daily vitamin regime. This may work well for some. For me I had a very bad reaction to it upon taking it the first day. Within 4 hours I became very nauseous. I had to leave work. I knew it was due to putting this new vitamin in my body. I’ve researched folic acid since & wanted to share that there can be side effects from taking it. In some cases one may experience nausea, black stool, constipation, loss of appetite, bloating or gas. I spoke to my Doctor about it. There was no type of adverse reaction with the other vitamins I was taking. It was simply my body didn’t like it. He did ask if I took it with a full glass of water & food, which I did. He said this was important. So a heads up if you’re considering to purchase for the first time. This may not be for you.  I do respect this brand of vitamin. Unfortunately I can’t receive the nice benefits gained by taking it.

source_doc: You need this! Love this swaddle carrier! I had one similar to this one I got from Walmart a couple years ago (but I got rid of it thinking I wouldn’t have another kiddo) and I struggled to find one that you don’t have to wrap all yourself until I came across this one. I am so happy with this purchase and so is my daughter she is all smiles when she is walking around in her carrier. There is plenty of room for baby and mama I ordered a size large (I weigh 185) and it works fine, I could probably fit an XL but I didn’t know if it would be too loose on possibly making it not supportive for baby so I went with my gut and got a L. I will say I sometimes notice the support band that goes across baby’s belly rolls down it’s more annoying than anything it doesn’t mess with the support when it does that. Definitely a great buy for a solid price.

source_doc: Excellent to aid in learning. After many years away from the piano I am now retiring and attempting to teach myself how to play once again. I purchased a self-taught program which is very effective and came with an 8 1/2" x 11" picture of the keyboard showing the keys. As I am just starting out once again I found myself frequently referring to the "cheat sheet". I'm sure glad I found these keyboard notes which make it much easier to read music. I expected them to be thin but they are much thicker than I expected. I laid them across the keyboard and like the fact that they are slightly angled up as they rest on the keyboard but far enough to the top so as not to interfere with playing music. They cover the entire keyboard from left to right with letters that are large enough to see quite easily and a photo of the location of the note on a music sheet that is smaller and slightly less visible but that's ok the goal is to help me get started but I don't want to rely on them. These are quite durable, I expect them to last a long time and when not needed can easily be stored in the locking plastic box which they arrived in. I hightly recommend these for anyone learning how to play the piano

Поскольку я только начинаю снова, я часто обращался/лась к "шпаргалке". Я очень рад/а, что нашел/а эти заметки по клавишам, которые облегчают чтение музыки. Я ожидал/а, что они будут тонкими, но они намного толще, чем я ожидал/а. source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. I guess I will have to do that from now on since it is misleading to say the least.Lesson learned.

source_doc: Pretty Good. I haven’t been in a sleeping bag in a long time.  So I got this and tried it in the back yard.  Well, I picked a cold night with wind, below 30 on the mercury, and it did good.I had no tent which might have been ok if I had no wind.  It was cold.  But I did sleep, about as good as I could expect for the conditions.  I used my field coat to cover my face but the wind woke me up many times.I’m a little over 6 foot and medium build, I fit in the bag.  I feel like my head could have a little more room but it wasn’t a problem.Most importantly for me was having a very thin foam filled self inflating mattress.  it kept me off the cold ground.  And it was much better than being directly on the lumpy ground.  Again, a tent would helped a lot with the wind.Not that I needed it, but the bag has snaps that let it shut without being closed, or maybe there’s another purpose.  The zipper worked great.  The sleeping bag rolls back up easily to fit the carrying bag.I think with a blanket and a tent I would do just fine camping for a weekend.  Hope this helps you.

source_doc: Painful, but maybe it's me. I don't have plantar fasciitis or any particular foot issues, but I could use indoor sandals and thought the massage aspect might be fun. I thought I got the wrong item at first because the (unsealed) box pictures a teapot and herbs, but I guess that's supposed to reference natural healing; the box is actually pictured in the listing. The slippers run about a size small. I would've ordered a size 5 if they had it, but 6 was the smallest and it turns out they are just right. I don't know why the smaller sizes have a rocker bottom while the larger sizes have a flat bottom or why stone is listed as a material. The spikes on the slippers hurt even with socks. It's very hard to endure walking in them. The listing does suggest wearing socks and gradually increasing wear time to ease the pain, so I guess it was to be expected? This kind of thing is new to me and maybe if I had foot issues, I would feel a different kind of relief. The seller did personally reach out and respectfully reiterate that the pain is said to subside by some. That's possible and since I'm not the target audience, I reconsidered that I should remain neutral in rating these. I'll continue trying to get used to these, but if you just need ordinary slippers, don't put yourself through this. They're priced okay at $29.99 plus $5 off.

source_doc: Very Helpful. I first learned of these strips from my orthopedic surgeon. And back then I used them for carpal tunnel symptoms as well as tennis elbow symptoms. Being a former runner in my youth, I'm now dealing with a lot of pain around my patellar tendon area. I have been using compression sleeves for this without any luck. That also ended up hurting other areas on the back of my knees. And I got to thinking, KT tape. I did research on how to use this tape for my knees. I do not by any means recommend anyone to diagnose their own symptoms etc. But I can tell you, I am now in my 60's and this definitely did the trick for me. This is amazing tape for aches and pains that do not require surgery. I am now able to walk better and do more things that I haven't done in a while. Make sure to see your doctor for severe injuries. This tape did give me back my legs so I could walk without hurting after a 30 minute grocery store run etc. And if applied correctly, I can shower a day or two and it still sticks. Thank you for this tape. I can see why athletes use this.

source_doc: Least irritating shave I've had in a while. I didn't think there could be too much difference between these and the other razors I've purchased and have been using. While shaving, these seemed as good but no better than a new blade of the other brands I have. What surprised me, was afterwards when I was applying alum and expecting the burn I typically get there was none. I looked these up and the only thing I could tell that is different (from the details in the listing) is that the grind angle is different than other blades might use. This really does seem to make a difference as the next time I used them I experienced the same thing, and I know for a fact that burning is from the micro cuts you are getting when shaving. Alum on shaved skin exacerbates that burn, but with these so far there has been no burn. Hopefully I keep having the same luck, but I highly recommend these as a result!

source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: Bulky. I have large chihuahua so I ordered the medium according to their size recommendations.  I was surprised at how bulky this collar is.  It was a bit larger in circumference than I expected but I was able to size it down fine to fit, some of the lights are now tucked under, but there is still plenty of brightness.  The battery box and the AirTag holder are big though.  I put it on my giant Chihuahua and he was like, "what the heck is on ma neck, lady?" He got used to it quick.  I do really like the light show.  You can choose your color and your blink pattern.  This collar is bright!  Very visible will be the dog you put this on.  You can see in my one of my pictures the width of the battery box controller, and airTag holder which is what I docked the star for.  This collar is holding up well with our rainy winter night walks, but this thing verges on apparatus rather than collar.  Maybe it's just me having a smaller- but still *relatively* giant- dog and not being used to what a big dog might wear.  It came with a seatbelt adapter but I use a dog seat so I gifted that to a friend who likes it. I don't know how safe it keeps the dog but it keeps her out of the front seat!

source_doc: Too Much Fun! When I first ordered this drum I didn't know what to expect, I mean I saw people playing it and it looked cool but now I know.  I LOVE sitting on this box and just banging away! I think it's therapeutic.  You learn how to play it as you experiment with it. There are different ways that you that you can hit it the drum, or cup your hands differently that gives you different types of sounds.  To let you know how solid this box is, I weigh 250 pounds and this drum holds me up with no problems. I don't feel like it's going to break underneath me. I would say it's commercial grade, and the fit and finish is wonderful.  It really is fun to play, and even my adult kids want to play on Dad's drum.  When I'm not using it I use it as a small table for a one of my speakers. It is well worth the money and something that I could see lasting forever if not abused. I highly recommend!

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

У старого чехла были металлические зажимы, и если один не закреплён должным образом, это может поцарапать машину на ветру, когда она трясётся. Я предпочитаю пластиковые или резинообразные зажимы в любое время. Плохая новость заключается в том, что требуется закрыть двери в этот чехол, чтобы зафиксировать его на месте. Я не осознавал/а, что это как раз так и должно работать, и у меня есть серьёзная проблема с этим — двери Solara не имеют верхней рамы, это стекло соприкасается с резиновым уплотнителем крыши автомобиля. С таким материалом между ними вы рискуете получить протечки в салон автомобиля вокруг швов двери. Мне это совсем не нравится. source_doc: Not very good quality. I doubt this is truly a therapeutic grade oil. I wasn’t expecting the best oil, at the price…but I was disappointed. It had an unusually greasy feel to it for an essential oil, the smell is basic, and if the sting of clove oil is any indicator of its purity, this is not pure. I’ve put clove oil in my armpits a few times and regretted it. I actually put this one on to test it, and eventually I did feel a little heat. But I wasn’t sure I would at all. I do like the dropper feature though. I bought it to use under my finger nails while fighting a pinworm infection with a toddler, so I didn’t care if it smelled great, I just wanted something I could use frequently after diaper changes. Hmmm, perhaps latex gloves would have been a better choice.

source_doc: Perfect for what we wanted!! So we wanted to put these lights all around our room.  I took measurements and decided I needed to buy 75’ roll.  However what i didn’t expect at all was the strip has markings about every foot where you can cut it shorter!  This made all the difference for me.  I needed more than 50’ but less than 100’ and I was able to cut over 10’ off so there wasn’t a lot of extra where I came down to receptacle!  So after reading other reviews I used a cleaner and sprayed and wiped the entire area I was sticking it too!  Then I waited until it’s completely dry and installation was so easy!  And they are amazing!  I prefer using the app on my iPhone!  And connecting it to my phone was so simple.  They provide a QR code so setup was a Breeze!  I would highly recommend these lights!  And they are nice and bright

source_doc: Careful... I bought the 64oz which has a seam in the mouth (the 40oz doesn't) and I looked in there today, not even a week after it arrived, to find rust so just be sure to check every once in awhile that everything is kosure. I'm used to working with cast iron so I know I can scrub it out but it's not really something I want to have to worry about constantly.Other than that I feel like I haven't really been able to give this a fair shot but as mentioned, I bought a 40 oz as well which I'm hoping will be better.Also, I'm rating this as "not easy to drink from" (next section of review asks for a star rating on this feature) because I very much want a super fast, super smooth flow so I can chug like my embrava (not insulated) water bottles but I don't think that I will ever get that from any hot drink lid. Still a pita to have the lids be so... Gluggy and slow pour just because I prefer warm water.

source_doc: A remake that feels more like two steps backward than a step forward. I grew up playing the original Diamond and Pearl, and besides the notoriously slow engine run, I had really enjoyed those games and looked forward to the remakes. I found BDSP faithful to a fault, while not introducing enough new spins to qualify as a breath of fresh air. The Grand Underground held my interest for only a brief amount of time. Everything else feels stale, rigid, and uninspired. I’m not a fan of the chibi aesthetic, which I’m especially disappointed about since I liked the direction the new games were going with more detailed and realistic models. I have played Pokemon since I was in preschool, over 20 years, and this is the only Pokemon game I have not finished. I stopped playing after getting the eighth badge and couldn’t feel bothered to continue any further. (I did, however, help my sister beat Cynthia on Brilliant Diamond, and I appreciate that they’ve made the notoriously difficult Champion even more difficult. From the remastered music to the competent AI, hands down the best battle in BDSP.) When Pokemon Legends Arceus came out, I dropped Shining Pearl like a hotcake and didn’t look back. Arceus was the breath of fresh air I was craving.

source_doc: Headset is great! But I didn’t get my extra batteries! The headset is really nice I love it! It’s very comfy, the strap is not really necessary and can easily be removed entirely which I did to give it a bit more movement. The honeycomb style rubber swappable inside is nice as well. The passing is very soft and does the job nicely. I definitely see myself using this headset daily! But unfortunately I also got this combo because it came with extra batteries. I didn’t even get a single battery. Let alone 2! I thought the package felt light but all that was in it was the pieces to assemble the headset. There was a smaller box with what I thought were batteries but it was just a dock to charge batteries! Which was weird because I bought the combo pack. Is there anyone on the support team I can talk to about getting my batteries? Other than that everything’s great but my rating will remain unless I get my batteries because that’s what I paid more for to not get them makes the entire headset kinda weird looking and useless with the empty spot at the back of the headset.

source_doc: These look REAL ENOUGH and will fit Small to Medium spaces! These are quite lovely and come well packed Ed, tightly preventing any damage so yes, you have to fiddle with them to spread out the branches maybe for a minute for each pot but it’s literally no time at all. Yes they are white plastic pots! In my case? They are on windowsills where I will be opening the windows so, I bought a bag of River Stones at the dollar store and filled each pot so when the breeze from the open window hits them they won’t topple over. You could probably use any stones or even dirt but I liked the weight of the River stones. Not my first rodeo with these plants! I loved them so much I bought a set of six Cactus potted plants plants as well. They’ll get a nice review too. I have two left over from the 8 pack and they’ll go on a small night stand in my guest room. I’ve already had to warn the cleaning lady NOT TO WATER MY PLANTS! LOL also, the center pots in my pics are MINE…I just dropped a pot in each to see how it looked and decided I liked it. I will be buying more for an Idea that I have for an arrangement I want to do. I 100% do recommend buying these! Good Luck and TRUST ME on this.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: Easy to install & just work! I had cages on my pedals, but I was primarily riding my bike on a trainer.  I used the cages because I figured my feet would slip, but I didn't want the clicky shoes since I wasn't convinced I was going to ride enough to spend the time finding something that fits...I unhooked my bike and now its going on the road for real.  The cages are just not going to work for me, so these are just right.  I wanted something durable and at least decent looking for my cyclocross bike.  Like I said, I'm not hardcore, so I just wanted something with regular pedals - these fit perfectly and work as I had hoped.  Look cool and have plenty of grip for when I'm casually riding around.  Very satisfied.

source_doc: I finally found the perfect one! Here is my story. I've been looking for a heating blanket, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a go.  I am very happy I did!! Only setting number three on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if I go above seven. Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

source_doc: Expensive. After watching a few videos I purchased this lacquer to refinish an old Gibson guitar.  I applied gloss black lacquer over automotive primer.  I bought two cans @ $35 for each can.  I followed the instructions and warmed the cans before use. The first can applied fairly evenly but the second can I had all kinds of problems with splatter.  I had to sand out some big globs of paint and put on another coat.  I tried shaking the can, heating warmer and lower but the splatter would not stop.  I had to spray for a couple of seconds then clean the nozzle with a rag to stop the splatter. The other problem was orange peel.  I have used other brands for 1/3 the price and gotten better results.  If I had to do this over again, I would use a less expensive lacquer.

source_doc: Just What I Needed. I was looking for a bread cutting guide that cut all the bread the same size, easy to store in a small space and easy to clean.  I did not want the lovely bamboo guides because  they were spaced to accommodate 3 sizes of slices on a somewhat small grid so then I would have to move the bread after every so many cuts in order to have them be the same size.  The key word I was interested in is "easy".  With this guide if I want thicker slices all I need to do is skip a space -- easy! Used this bread cutting guide today and am quite happy with it and would purchase it again. It cleans up easily -- just a quick wipe with soap and water.  However it's crumb catching ability is not great. I just place it on a jelly roll pan and cut away.  If one is giving this item as a gift it, comes in a very nice box.  If you order a white bread guide do not be alarmed if the box shows the red guide on the outside.  I think the red guide just shows up better on the box.  This guide is so much better than the Presto one I had before. I would purchase this guide again.

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. I put my truck in my yard and stomped it, and of course, I was actually in 2wd. I placed it in 4wd and stomped it I was in 4w drive. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.

source_doc: dryer nice, but the red/yellow reset/test buttons keeps faulting. The dryer works & I like it, but each time I go to use it I find the red/yellow reset/test buttons have faulted and the dryer won't power on until I reset.  I've tried it in several different outlets & using a surge strip, same result when NOT in use.  I've also tested another hair dryer in the same outlet, no issue.  I have contacted the manufacturer.  They asked me to send a bunch of photos, which I did, along with the receipt.  Then they asked me to send more photos in order for them to activate the warranty. They asked me to cut the cord & send photos of that.  I don't have the original box, so I can't return to Amazon.  As of now, I just unplug it and don't leave it on when not in use.  I guess I'll buy a different brand so I have something to use until they respond.  The way the manufacturer is giving me the run around is the reason for the 2 stars.

source_doc: Beautiful flute, but… This is a very beautiful flute and I was so excited to get it. I hadn’t played in about 30 years and wasn’t sure if I could still play. I was pretty good way back when and really wanted to start playing again.When I started playing, I thought some notes seemed sharp. Well, as I said, it had been a while and I thought it was me. I continued to practice and did not see an improvement in the sharpness. In fact, the flute just got more out of tune as time went on. No amount of adjustment would correct this. Sadly, I was unable to continue to play this flute. It was too hard on my ears. I have returned it and will look at an intermediate flute to purchase. I am glad I tried it however because it sparked that part of me that always loved to play.

source_doc: Nice trimmer and accessories. I am normally a clean-shaven guy I like keeping my sideburns clean and sometimes I get a bit of a scruff that I need to keep clean.  I didn't have any clippers that I could use to keep the scruff from looking too bad so I decided to get this.  The clipper itself is nice and heavy and made up of almost all metal so it feels like it could take a beating if needed, I also nerd that I am like the design of it.  It comes with a bunch of normal clipper accessories such as guards, nose trimmer, etc, all of these were fine and fit and cut as expected.  Using the clippers was easy and charging it took almost no time at all.  It was able to at least make this mess on my face look presentable and not like I was homeless.  All said in done I like these the thing that stood out the most was the all-metal heavy design of them.

source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.

source_doc: Love This Air Fryer. I was hesitant to buy this air fryer because I wasn't familiar with the brand. I used to have a name brand air fryer and it died some time ago and I wasn't sure I needed to replace it because I wasn't using it much. I finally decided to try this one because of it's size and price. It's a perfect size for feeding 1 or 2 people. I also like the color. It's a big bigger than I had imagined before it arrived but it fits fine on my counter. This air fryer is easy to use and even easier to clean up; the non-stick interior just wipes right up. I still don't use an air fryer a lot on my whole food plant-based diet but I'm glad I got it. I think the price was reasonable and if you are looking for an air fryer, I highly recommend this brand.

source_doc: It turns off, Glitchy, connection keeps cutting off... Bought it about a year and 6 months ago. I first started noticing that the headset would randomly lose connection and or it would turn off. Usually I would turn it back on and that would solve the problem. This usually happened when I would try to connect to my xbox. I also noticed that in the middle of a game it would drop connection even though it was on and I had not moved anywhere. This started to happen more and more frequently about 3 moths ago. Now as of yesterday it kept turning off over and over again and or dropping connection. At first i thought it was because it might be low on battery. I plugged it in for about 1-2 hours. That did not solve the issue. So i thought maybe the cable does not work right. I checked the cable it was good. but just in case i used another cable as well. It still did not work. When i plug the cables in it shows a green light meaning it is fully charged or close to fully charged. Well it is still turning off randomly at intervals of about 1-2 mins. Yes I even tried keeping the cable on (charging) while the headset was on. It would still turn off. I am no longer within warranty. I guess I will go back to my other headset from  2013 lol. Do not buy they are glitchy!!!

source_doc: I was unsure at first BUT... I was unsure when I first took this out of it's box. I needed a carrier because I realized I really can't carry my newborn and do other things around the house at the same time. I forgot how useful carriers were with my first son. It's intimidating at first to see all the straps, but once you get this adjusted for your body and baby it's a breeze to snap it right on you. My 6 week old currently loves being close to me and sleeping on my chest. In fact this is his favorite place to take naps in during the day. It gets him settled down real quick when he gets a little fussy. It's so durable and sturdy I don't worry about baby in here when doing anything around the house. I even take this with me at the office, fortunately I own my own business so I can take baby with me to work. For the price it's great, it's worth every penny and more. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed in my closet. These are great! There are two different sizes you can order and I chose the smaller ( I think its like 7 inches)  since I wanted to use them in a sliding door closet with limited wall space. I put one on each end, at two different levels and now I can see my clothes so much better when I slide the doors open. My bedroom is dark and its impossible to tell black from navy and I was having to take them out into the next room for better lighting to see what I wanted to wear. Now, I slide the closet door open, the lights come right on and so much easier! And I can make it hand-held if I want an even closer look. They have a magnetic strip that attached them to the wall and it just pops off and on. The bigger size would probably give even more light, but for the space I had to use them, the smaller size work just great. I have mine set at the auto setting so they turn on activated by motion and shut off automatically once the door is closed again after like 20 seconds. But you can also just use the on/off switch if that’s better for you.

source_doc: I have a few gnomes... Most of them are solar.  I have a couple of Halloween gnomes that aren't solar and while I like them, I do wish they had solar and maybe red eyes considering they are Halloween figures. source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: For Curly Hair. My experience…it’s okay but results are not instant. I like the scent. It does make your hair soft however when you rinse it out, I don’t feel that the product made a difference. I have left the mask on overnight and again, didn’t leave my hair soft once I rinsed it off. I will continue to use the rest of the product and hope it can help. I don’t know what I was expecting for my curly, colored, bleached, damaged, frizzy hair. I was hoping it would help so I wouldn’t have to cut a few inches off but so far, it’s not helping. I found a hair mask very similar to this at Dollar Tree made by Salon Selectives (old product line, hidden gem) and I am really surprised at how similar they are. Just saying.

source_doc: The Strings I Didn’t Know I Couldn’t Live Without. When I first tried these strings I was highly skeptical because they are a fairly heavier gauge than I’ve always used on my stringed instruments.  But when I started playing a friend’s guitar I noticed quickly how incredibly BEND-Y they are!!!  It’s honestly hard to describe how smooth these strings feel.  I ordered some and put them on my favorite Strat, and I loved them so much that they are now on almost every stringed instrument I own!  They last a really long time too because they are pure nickel.  I was ride or die for the vintage nickel fender strings for the longest, but these are BETTER.  I would recommend them to anyone for electric and acoustic stringed instruments. source_doc: great for walking, a bad back makes it harder to move. I use this daily while watching TV.  My other half uses it to keep moving on rainy or otherwise lazy days.  I love it.  The remote came with a cheap and possibly old battery - it died quick.  Replaced it with a new and expensive one and it is happy as a clam.  Invest in a good battery if you want it to work with only one button push. I have a bad back and I was hoping I could move it easily, but that was to much to expect of my back I think.  But, I can get it out of the way if I have to just not daily.  It folds easily though. When not in use, it stays in the living room, folded up and covered with a towel to discourage interested cats.  They think I purchased a very expensive cat bed, so that didn't work but the towel keeps the cat hair off it.  Someday I will make a cover that fits it and matches the rug.  I have not paired it with my phone and downloaded the app, I just bring it slowly up to my speed and walk as long as I can.

source_doc: Worth the price. I hate chapped lips but I'm particular in what I want in my chapstick. Yes, it's cool that treat beauty offers cool flavor options and I really like the gummy bear flavor. However, there are other qualities in a chapstick that I find more important. 1) I hate when you apply chapstick and then it leaves a residual chemical/chapstick flavor on your lips. I am happy to report that this chapstick doesn't do that. It's slightly sweet, but not with a weird chemical taste. 2) I hate reapplying chapstick every 30 minutes or so. For me a good chapstick will linger on your lips until you eat. I drink water throughout the day and I don't want to reapply chapstick every time I take a sip of water. Yes, I know it will wear off, but a good chapstick wear off slower. This is a good chapstick by my standards.Added bonuses are the variety of flavors, cute packaging and huge size. I just ordered more from the treat beauty website because my daughter loves the gummy bear flavor and I told her she could have it.

source_doc: Some are good, some STANK. I'm a flower person, I love all things floral scents and I came at this knowing what I want. What I don't understand is why the seller doesn't group up the flower scents and the musky [really, musty] scents in one pack? I bought the green variety pack after returning the pink one and I'm still not 100% satisfied since I can't just choose a set with only floral scents.The Jasmine is great, skydive too, but the open and Darbar stink to high heaven! It doesn't make any sense to put a scent so masculine with primarily floral scents. I tried to get in contact with the seller but couldn't, either.Not all the oils were filled the same amount too. I get there's an inflation going on but this is stingy.For the price I wouldn't buy this again unless the seller is more flexible in how they're bundling the scents together. Makes no sense and I don't like that I paid for scents I hate and won't use.
