source_doc: Battery life has room to improve. I use a Glorious gaming mouse as my primary mouse. My only complaint is that I don't own the wireless version. I tried out this pwnage mouse in hopes that it would be everything I like plus the wireless aspect. In terms of customization, weight, accuracy, and feel, everything is very similar to my glorious mouse. I love it. It has a nice grip, it's very lightweight, and I can make the rgb pink. I fully charged the mouse and was gaming away until I hit about day 3 and the battery had to be recharged. Asking around my gaming group and reading online, 3 days is not very long for a wireless mouse at all. I really wish that the battery lasted longer on this mouse, but as it is I would rather deal with a cord and not have to worry about charging my mouse every 3 days. I am back to using my glorious mouse.

source_doc: Sturdy stainless steel utensils. I was looking for some large stainless steel spoons and forks. I noticed one day that I was missing several spoons & forks. If anyone has teenage boys like me, you know silverware seems to disappear. When I finally decided to purchase some spoons & forks, I knew I wanted stainless steel. I looked and found some made by a company called Keawell. I purchased a box that contained 6 large spoons and 6 large forks. When I received the utensils, I washed and dried them by hand. I love the fact they are also dishwater safe. They are not real heavy to hold like some I have used in the past. Very durable you can tell the spoons will not bend easily unless you force it to. So far I truly have enjoyed them and hopefully these will not end up in the garbage can. I would highly recommend this product to all my family & friends.

source_doc: I wish I found this sooner. I’ve had my leather couch for about a year and my bulldogs had put a few scratches on it and I knew I had to do something to protect it fast.  I ordered several different kinds of covers and had to send them all back because my cushions are connected to the couch.  This doesn’t move very much and so far I’m not having to constantly adjust it even when I recline it, they go back pretty much like they were.  My frenchie is crazy and she runs and flies onto the couch like a tiger is chasing her and it has stayed put for all those shenanigans so far.  The rubber grippers on the back work well.  I haven’t washed it yet but when I do I will air dry it because I know from past experience that a dryer will ruin them.  I wish I had found this cover and started using it when I first bought the couch but better late than never.

source_doc: Excellent lunch bag! When shopping for some type of lunch bag item, I stumbled across the Eco-Friendly lunch bag. I liked everything I read about it so I decided to order. I cannot begin to tell you how much I LOVE it. First I was amazed how big it actually is. The depth is so nice. One of the reasons I bought this was because I needed something to keep my Grandson’s milk & juice when we are out running errands. To tell you how much you can fit in the lunch bag. I had 2 bottles of milk, 2 bottles of water and a 16 oz soda in the main section. On the inside upper lid there is a section (with a zipper to close the section off) I was able to put 2 small box juices and a small ziploc bag of grapes. If needed I could have placed more items in that section along with a outside zip storage where you can keep your phone etc. The whole inside is lined with what looks like aluminum foil that keeps items cold or hot. Also if u should spill something, all you need to do is wipe it off with a damp cloth or paper towel. To bad something like this wasn’t around when my 2 were growing up. It is so light weight and the outside material reminds me of denim. I truly believe you will love it as much as I do!

source_doc: AMAZING! It literally melts my press on nails! I’ve never been able to get professional acrylic nails because all that filing of the nail bed to prep, would traumatize my nails to the point of creating pockets of fungus. Then I discovered press on nails and with some trepidation I tried it. I took them off after three days to make sure that my nails were clean and to my relief there was no sign of trauma. A whole new world of beautiful nails  just opened up to me! I came across this little gadget and I thought I tried it. I had nothing to lose because if it didn’t work as expected, I could always return it. I followed instructions and then soaked my nails for 5 minutes. When I took my hand out I couldn’t believe my eyes! They fake nails had just disappeared! I didn’t even have to use the scrapper. I used a cotton with acetone to finish taking what little was left. Then I soaked them again for an additional 3 minutes and I was done. I rubbed tea tree oil on my nails to help with the dryness and prevent fungus. This little thing is worth every penny. Healthy nails  have no price. Now I can safely become addicted to beautiful press on nails.

source_doc: Quality feels well made. This feels sturdy and strong. I love how tall it is so I don’t have to bend over to get this out like a my other baby gate. This does come with some wall caps that screw in but they aren’t necessary so I didn’t use them that way I can move it if I want to. The gate is easy to open for an adult with a button on top of the handle and below that have to be pushed at the same time so a baby wouldn’t be able to open it. I had my husband help me set it up but I could’ve installed it alone but easier with two people. The gate also can be left open which I like as I don’t always need it closed. I’m happy with this gate I just need two more I can close off my main living area.

source_doc: This is my second purchase of these. I originally purchased this belt when I had an iphone 8+ back in 2018.  I used it every other day when I ran.  I constantly pulled my iphone out of the belt 2 - 3 times a run (for pictures).  When I purchased an iphone 13 pro max I was happily surprised that it still fit in my old belt.  The belt fit me fine (I wear size 8 women's pants) and never "bounced" during the time I used it (although from time to time I did have to tighten it a bit as it sometimes came loose).Finally after many years of service, the zipper broke in December 2022.  I purchased a replacement and the quality is still as good as the original.  Not planning to upgrade my iphone any time soon, but I hope this still works in future.I highly recommend this product for those who don't like to carry their phones in their pockets when running.

source_doc: Does this company even have quality control! I can't believe what I received. If I buy a new product, I expect it to come in good condition. This thing is full of nicks and the paint is chipping off already. This should have never been shipped. It's not like I just got one bad piece, I also ordered my daughter a toy organizer, same company l, and that also came all scuffed up. My daughter of course fell in love with it and she's a toddler, I know she's going to ding it up, so that's why I decided to keep it and it was cheap. It was also horrible to assemble, the pilot holes were drilled crooked inside the trunk and I struggled to get the spring piece attached. Ended up stripping one of the screws. I was going to order a chest and toy organizer for my son's room, from the same company, it was just outer space themed, but not after this.I will be telling all my mom friends and family members to not purchase this brand. It is adorable, my daughter loves the princesses, but it's not worth it and I wouldn't want to support a company that can to this to it's customers. So please learn from my mistake and don't buy anything Delta makes.

source_doc: I love the thickness and double sided design of this bib. I really like this bib. In our household we go through bibs and always have a pile on hand as backups. My little one uses bibs as his lovey and comfort. I've gotten numerous bibs on here but this is definitely one of the thickest, if not the thickest bib I've gotten. I (and my toddler) prefers thicker bibs over the super thin ones. This one feels even slightly thicker than the bibs I usually get, which is the type with the fleece underside. I do love that the design is on both sides, but of course it is going to cost more. I only wish this was slightly a bit more affordably priced, but I also understand this is better quality (thickness, double sided design, etc) than most bibs, which is why it is priced at this amount. This is great for heavy droolers, especially if your little one is at the height of teething and drooling non stop. I still recommend it even if your little one is not a heavy drooler. I got this yellow safari animal design and the color is beautiful and vivid. I noticed there are also other designs available, and they are all equally adorable and have vivid colors. Overall I am very happy with this bib and highly recommend it if you can splurge a little.

source_doc: Can I give these more than 5 stars?! I love the convenience of using a Swiffer for quick clean-ups.  I have four rescue dogs and foster frequently too so I definitely use my Swiffer a lot.  But let's face it, the Swiffer doesn't really do a great job of cleaning.  In one area of my house, I have tile that was put down years ago before it became more popular to use the larger tiles (my tiles are probably only 12" tiles so I have lots of grout).  The Swiffer doesn't seem to really get down in the grout to clean.  I bought these reusable pads mainly because I thought they would be cheaper in the long run.  An unexpected huge bonus was finding how much better they actually work than the disposable Swiffer pads!  These pads are thick and absorbent.  They make it a tad bit harder to push your Swiffer around but the results are so much better and worth the extra effort!  I haven't tried to wash them yet. I have only just rinsed them off and reused them but will wash them soon and update if I have any issues (but I don't anticipate any problem with them). They do come with instructions telling you not to use fabric softener on them - just an FYI. So glad I ordered these and I will definitely order more!

source_doc: I bought this for my two dogs excessive itching. -This was nicely packaged.  No breaks or leaks.  Also came with three different pumps.  A screw on/off, pop top, and a pump.  I personally like the pump.  It’s the easiest.-Make sure to read directions.  I was giving my dog too much out of habit from another brand I was using.  She starting getting runny poops and I think it was making her feel sick.  I skipped it a couple days and just started giving her one pump and I have no more issues.-It doesn’t seem to bother the dogs at all.  I do a pump over their food and they eat it all!  It doesn’t smell at all.  Makes their bowls greasy but I expected that.The reason I give it a three star is because the other brand I was using seemed to work better.  It definitely helped the itching but they still do a bit as where the other brand seemed to stop it completely.  Noting that.  I wouldn’t buy this again I would stick with the other brand

source_doc: So HAPPY with this roll!!  Delighted! I have a Cuisinart Steam Toaster Oven and its very difficult finding pans that fit correctly. They are usually half an inch too long in one direction. Being my only oven, I want as large as will fit.  Before now, I buy a roll of  Parchment Paper and cut it to size each time. source_doc: Replacement to another Inspire. I had/have an inspire that is just fine except that where the band clips in, it broke and there is nothing to attach the band to. It is no longer under warranty. I really did not want to buy another one, but I couldn't come up with any way to fix it.  I did buy the little attachment so you can put it on your belt, but I use this as an alarm to remind me to take a med that has to be taken very early in the morning.  I was not going to wear the thing on my PJs because first of all I would probably lose it in the bed.  I tried another inexpensive smart watch, but the step count was really bad, and the silent alarm was one very short vibration and that was all.  So, I broke down and bought another Inspire.  I really hope this one doesn't break.  Other than that, I love this thing.  It isn't huge like most of them, and it works for what I need, counting steps and as a silent alarm.

source_doc: Absolutely brilliant device. I am an instant fan of this adorable egg cooker. I found out about it only a few days ago and I am so happy I got this.To start, my boyfriend suffers from a highly sensitive egg allergy, to the point where if he's in the kitchen while someone is frying eggs he will feel unwell from the fumes. As a result, I gave up cooking eggs for myself for over 5 years.This device is a blessing because I can finally eat eggs again without worrying about bothering my boyfriend. I might not ever make fried eggs again but being able to enjoy them boiled, poached, or as a tiny omelette is more than enough for me.The domed lid keeps the "fumes" contained pretty well until I have to open it, but since all the cooking is steam powered it's really not bad. This morning I attempted soft boiled eggs and as you can see I think they turned out wonderfully. My boyfriend didn't notice any discomfort in the kitchen either.So so happy this is in my life. It's very easy to clean and I love that you can set it and forget it, since it plays a little tune when it's ready.

source_doc: Seems like a good collar. My cats needed new collars and I thought I'd give this one a try.  I ordered the cloud print and it's cute.  No issues with sizing the collar to what I needed and I did try pulling apart on it to ensure it would "break away" if need be and it did come apart with a fairly good tug.  My cats are indoor cats so I doubt it will be put to the test, but would want to make sure it would just in case.  I do have to say I don't care for the bell.  My cat's last collar had a bell and it really wasn't noisy unless he was really running.  This bell is very noisy.  It's a smaller sound, kind of a tinny sound.  But I could tell my cat did not like it.  At least for the first few days he was constantly messing around with his neck like he was trying to find the bell.  He never did that with his last collar.  I was actually getting ready to take it off but it's been about a week and he seems used to it now so I'll leave it be for a bit longer and see.  But I do wonder if it's still driving him nuts.  I may still remove it at some point.

source_doc: Keyboard is too tall? Never thought I would have this complaint about a keyboard, but this thing is way too tall. I have had a Corsair K70 for the past 10 years and I am at a point of needing to replace it. Thought I would give this one a try and see if I liked the optical linear switches which I do really like.The problem is the actual height of the keyboard itself. It sits at least twice the height of my old mechanical keyboard. I tried adjusting my chair but found that it was a big enough difference between my mouse and keyboard that my armrests had to sit at two separate heights. Doing this hurts my shoulder and ruins my posture, but if I keep my armrests even like I would normally my wrist is bent just enough to cause pain.If you really cannot live without this keyboard for whatever reason, I would recommend raising your mousepad to match the height of the keyboard. I am tempted to do that just to keep this keyboard, but this is just dumb design in my opinion.

source_doc: Good for kids (and very good for adults ears) These are very, very light weight. I was desperately looking for foam mallets because they just sound nicer on steel tongue drums and mid class vibraphones. I bought these, not caring that they looked like a lollypop( probably not a good thing because it may entice little ones to chew on it) So I gave them a try and even though the foam was the density that I was hoping for, the handles are so light that I can’t get the sound I want, without whacking really hard,,,,and then all you hear is the thudding and no music. I thought the handle might be hollow and I that I could somehow add some weight but the ends are sealed ( I may chop it off & see if I can add weight and then sand the ends, so they’re smooth. Hmmm….may have to update later.Pros: For parents, whose so called friends, have gotten the kiddies a xylophone, this may save your sanity…Even though the munchkins may bang away, at that thing,,,the sound will not pierce a hole in your eardrum & make you long for their 18th birthday..lol
hypos: Хорошо для детей (и очень хорошо для ушах взрослых) Эти очень, очень легкие. Я отчаянно искал/а пенопластовые молотки, потому что они просто лучше звучат на стальных язычных барабанах и среднеклассных вибрафонах. Я купил/а их, не заботясь о том, что они выглядят как леденец (возможно, это не слишком хорошо, потому что это может привлечь малышей к жеванию) Так что я решил/а их попробовать, и хотя плотность пенопласта была такой, на которую я надеялся/а, ручки такие легкие, что я не могу получить звук, который мне нужен, не ударяя очень сильно,,,, а тогда вы слышите только глухой звук и никакой музыки. Я подумал/а, что ручка может быть пустой, и что я как-то мог бы добавить вес, но концы запечатаны (я могу отрезать её и посмотреть, могу ли я добавить вес, а затем отшлифовать концы, чтобы они были гладкими. Хммм.... возможно, мне надо будет обновить информацию позже. Плюсы: для родителей, чьи так называемые друзья купили детям ксилофон, это может сохранить ваше здоровье психики… Хотя малыши могут стучать по этому инструменту,,, звук не пробьет дыру в вашей барабанной перепонке и не заставит вас заскучать по их 18-летию..лол

source_doc: It is better than i expected with a small cabinet!!! I have a sub that is a 6" that I paired with a set of Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. The bass was lacking and I wanted something a little stronger. I ordered it and It was delivered in 24 hours on prime. It is much smaller than I expected. It’s just 2” deeper than the 6" cabinet it is replacing. I connected it to the system with the Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. It turns on right away. And it has strong smooth bass not muddy bass. I actually had to turn it down 5-7db below 0db on the gain control to match the monitors. Now, I have a complete Presonus system, that is very impressive for the cost. I have several other systems, A KRK VXT system and a Blue Sky system this is smallest system and it is very impressive compared to the KRK and Blue Sky systems I have in head to head comparison using the Mackie Big Knob 3. Very happy with this sub. highly recommended.

source_doc: Glittery. I’m not using this product again because it is glittery. I don’t think i saw glitter in the description, so I was not pleased to put this on my skin and find I look like a preteen. Luckily I tested on an arm before putting it on my face - I’d hate to go into work all glittery. Just for kicks, I did try it on my face on a day when I knew I wasn’t going out, and indeed I did look like I was getting ready for a glamour shots session.That said, it is a nice skin oil, if you don’t mind the glitter. I could definitely feel a difference in softness in the patch of skin I tested and my skin felt nice when I did put it on my face. So it works, for what it is, I just wouldn’t use it.

source_doc: Pretty Good. The first time I started looking for something like this, I just gave up due to too many options.  Since I had the chance to try this, and I figured it met my first requirement of not being plastic, I was happy to give it a try.It fits the bill pretty nicely.  It saves a bit of room by getting some of the tiny stuff off the cabinet floor under my half bath sink, and then gets some of the larger bottles cleaned up and in one place as well.As I suspected, for every bit of space you gain, you also gain some complications - and I'm sure this is true for almost every device like this unless it was engineered specifically for your EXACT cabinet.For example, I like that it pulls out, but then I have to leave some space in front of it so it can do so.  And then I can't put anything too tall on the top because those things could hit the top of the door and stop it from pulling out all the way.  So it helps, but it's not making an astronomical difference under there.  I still like it.  I wouldn't bother with almost any of the plastic models.  At least this does NOT seem cheap or flimsy at all (anything cheap and flimsy trying to help you save space always makes more problems than they solve).

source_doc: Great for Price, Better after Tweaks. Loved the lamp. I am particularly fond of the design which is why I got it. As a student moving from dorm to dorm it folds nicely. Great Student lamp. It has two different strips of lights that cause the change in color. It is not the best light I have had but for the price it is pretty decent. Lumens I provides enough light for the tasks I perform at night which are normally just computer work, occasional solder, tiny tool usage and eating at my desk. I was really annoyed with where the switch was so I cut it off and reconnected close to the base of where the clamp is. I can now easily reach the on and off and lumen adjustment. I would have preferred the switch be closer to the head or arms of the lamp but I am happy with where it is now. I added a rubber pad to the clamp so I don't get charged for damages to the desk. I also had to un hinge a spring and tighten a few of the screws. The springs are unevenly strong that it pulls the light in funky ways and after removing a few and then tightening screws the lamp still adjusts and moves and stays where I want it. I have been pretty happy with it.

source_doc: Have to use force when plugging or removing from switch. I figured it would be great alternative for my switch that I can travel with for my system, but it makes me feel iffy when I plug it into my switch. I have a hard time unplugging it and even plugging it in. As if it's tougher to insert into and remove from the c-port. I figured with decent reviews it would have been perfect but I just don't feel good about using it when I have to use force to even use it. I don't want to ruin my switch or the cord itself, but mostly my switch. I use it as a last resort. Maybe I would have better luck using it with my dock? Or maybe my cord was just not that great? Either way, I recommend looking for a better one or even the real Nintendo cord since I wouldn't want to recommend any cord that could possibly ruin someone else's system.

source_doc: Not just a pregnancy pillow! I had 2 major abdominal surgeries and was absolutely struggling to find a comfortable way to sleep. When sleeping on my non surgical side, I rolled to my belly in my sleep waking me up in terrible pain. I gave this pillow a go. I wish I’d have gotten one of these years ago! It comes vacuum packed, I tossed it in the dryer on air fluff for about 30 mins and left it out to form as suggested and washed the cover in my sensitive detergent (dried cover on very low heat because of the fabric type). It formed beautifully! I couldn’t wait to try it out. I did add a bit of extra poly fill on one side to make it more firm only because I wanted a firm barrier to prevent me from rolling on my belly. It worked perfectly! I never rolled on to my belly once. I’ve been using this all week now and I have noticed that my incision sites aren’t anywhere near as painful and it’s even helped with painful joints from fibromyalgia. I wish I could give it far more stars. It wasn’t flat like many other pillows and their reviews, it was truly perfect. This is a fantastic investment. Now I just have to work on getting the hubby to stop resenting my pillow for replacing him lol

source_doc: Very Sturdy. I have bought what feels like a ton of these over my adult life for all kinds of different, practical applications not just for hanging a shower curtain and this one has to be one of the sturdiest ones I have ever purchased.  I wasn't so sure about the black as I normally stick to white, off-white or a light tan but for the purpose of my purchase, I was indifferent because I just needed a sturdier rod in my laundry room.  I use this rod to hang the clothes right out of the dryer and sometimes, the weight of clothes can be so much that a regular, cheaper rod, will buckle under that kind of weight.  I was hoping that this rod would solve my worry about that because I had my other one fall on me, a couple of times by that buckling under the weight of the clothes.  This one is absolutely the answer.  It is really easy to install and extremely sturdy, I can easily hang about 3 loads before I have to put them in their respective closets.  That's a LOT of laundry, and an amount that my other rod couldn't even dream about holding.  The price is very reasonable as well, so if you are in the market for a really sturdy rod, this is it.  I hope you find this review helpful!

I need more time to see how this will improve my lips. I will update and report the result here. For now, I will apply this before bedtime and will keep using my current lip balm during the day.

source_doc: I like it a lot. I had an old one I bought years ago that was smaller. This one is large enough to easily accept a paper shopping bag, and it’s a little taller than my old one, so if I have a bunch of plastic shopping bags, I can pile them up higher.  It’s pretty cool that I could fold it up if I needed the room for something else, but I never do that..  I don’t understand why some people complain that it slides around. The back of my SUV is plastic, and it doesn’t slide around (and I am not the most gentle driver either, but if I had to slam on my brakes, I would say all bets are off and I would not blame this product).  I’ve heard some of them fall apart, so I pulled on mine from different directions, and it’s not falling apart. I don’t doubt with automated manufacturing that some of them would be defective. (check them out before the return window closes)..

source_doc: You're paying less for a reason. I've used wood glue many times. But in the past I've used gorilla glue, which has never disappointed me.  When I found myself needing wood glue again and saw this at half the price and with great reviews, I thought I would give it a try.  I learned the hard way that there is a reason it's so inexpensive.  It simply doesn't hold for very long.  I'm talking days.  The longest hold I was able to get was a couple of weeks, but only because I avoided touching what I had used it on for a majority of that time.  I'm grateful it was only about $5 that I wasted as this will be going in the trash when I finish this. And I just purchased gorilla glue .... which I should have done in the first place.

source_doc: Works great, so far. It’s very sturdy and seems well-made but I can’t speak to the adhesion, yet.  I bought this during the winter and I prefer to wait until it’s warmer so I can clean the garage floor and use the adhesive stickers for exactly where I want it.Currently I have it on an old area rug so it doesn’t slide around.  I really like how I can feel the slight elevation in the front so I know it’s close then I feel the higher back which signals me to stop.  I don’t have to guess at all; it’s like my tire fits into a perfect little trough.  I have about 3 inches between the front of my vehicle and the garage wall and maybe another 3 inches of space in the back so my garage door will close.  This device works great and saves me from guessing or getting out of my vehicle and checking clearance.  If I had one suggestion it would be that it should be a little wider but I’ve gotten use to it

source_doc: I would describe the fram brand as barely adequate, if that. The build quality feels just really cheap. Everything about it is cut rate. That's probably why it's priced right around $4 right now. I don't know about all the people that say it's destroyed their engines and whatnot. I guess that would happen if pieces came off at and it came apart in some way and started to clog up the oil passages. But from what I've seen no one's ever been able to prove that that has happened. Now that's not to say it hasn't happened I just don't have the time to do extensive research. But everything about these is just cheap. I have no idea how well they filter. For a few dollars more you can get something that feels really good quality. So I decided not to use cheap oil filters anymore and so I find these unacceptable. Like I say I'm not going to make claims that they ruin engines because I have no idea. I know the nickname for these is orange can of death. It's pretty funny but I haven't seen that to be really true at all like I said above I haven't seen proof about it. Anyway yeah I'm just not going to use filters this cheap and low quality.

source_doc: In anticipation of using, I'm going to say it's right up there with Hydroflask. My family owns too many water bottles and most of them are hydroflasks. We've got a few eco vessels and a few generic throw around ones. But I wanted to be different so that I would know it's mine... My wife might try and claim it as hers like she did with another hydroflask bottle I bought.I really like the size and the wide mouth opening and the chug cap. The wide mouth when you have the chug cap off makes it super easy to fill with ice and drink. It's wider than the hydroflask wide mouth bottles. The chug cap is really easy to take off. It has a grippy edge to it.Having had the handle cap for the hydroflasks, I think I can honestly say I like the yeti design better. A solid shape as opposed to having it swivel. I prefer the solid shape.Even though I haven't used it yet I have no doubt that it will perform as well with hot and cold as the hydroflask bottles. I plan on using this for travel and of course those hot summer days on the golf course.The picture doesn't do the color justice. It looks better than the picture. I'd definitely get another so I can have 2 in a rotation... Just a different color.

source_doc: I thought I would use it more. This UV light for nails is very lightweight and as simple to use as any I've ever used. I got this for when I do my nails, so I could cure my nails all at once rather than one at a time, and it definitely works good for that when it's the finished nails. I have nerve damage in my right hand,  so I actually find that initial gluing of nail to finger works better for me if I just stick with the single nail at a time. So, unfortunately, this has only been used 1 time. I really thought I would use it more,but it's too hard for me to keep my hand straight long enough to put all nails on then under the light. I just bend them and they come off and it becomes a mess. But, having said that, it is a decent light for anyone who will not have issues like I have. Or great for even curing nail decor that needs UV light after the nails are already glue on. I wish I could have given a better review of this product, but from what I can tell, it does what it says, and works as good as it says. source_doc: No complaints with quality. I got this for an emergency pull rope / strap for the trunk of my car.. 4" did not really register as to how wide that actually is, or how thick this strap actually is, until I got it in.. One of those (brain fartt) moments where you could kick yourself in after thought.. In any case, this is way more then I need for an emergency strap, so I am going to look for another.. I have one that is thinner and not as wide in my one vehicle, and I wanted one for my other vehicle.. If you want one for something like that, this is going to be much thicker and heavier then most people will ever use..With that being said, the testing I did do with it, it worked fine.. But let me be honest when I say.. 16,000 pounds is like towing a semi.. I have nothing that will use or need that kind of a heavy duty strap to tow.. But then again, I have seen smaller one break trying to pull out bushes and stuff.. So better too heavy then not heavy enough and breaking.. Just know, if you are looking for compact, this is not for you.. But from what I can tell so far, it is nicely made and I have no complaints about its quality.

source_doc: I have thought about buying like 10 of these. I am a nail girly - I spend a lot on at-home nail products. So I have spent quite a bit on nail drills that always end up breaking. I usually buy the ones that are around $80-$100. I can honestly say, none of them have ever been anywhere as great as this one. I've had this for a few months and it is still going strong. I am not sure how long it'll last, but my others usually only lasted this amount of time. If this broke I wouldn't be upset, I would just order a new one because it is worth every penny. I LOVE that it is cordless, but ESPECIALLY that it isn't bulky like most cordless nail drills that are attached to a big block. It is legit perfect. Another thing I LOVE that makes this so much better than others, is that it can go fast, but more importantly, it can go slow. Even on the slowest setting every other nail drill was too powerful sometimes, but this one is perfect. Power when you want, but gentle when you don't. I would spend $100 on this and it would still be worth it.

source_doc: Totally worth it! So, I know you're supposed to clean the humidifier daily - that's all well and good when you're a) not disabled; b) dealing with Stage 4 Cancer ; and c) just too dang tired.  I wanted to wait and see just how well they worked before writing my review.  Each time I refilled the humidifier I would add 6-7 drops.  Normally, I clean them once a week - and I have 2 humidifiers so it takes some time to clean them.  Well, I have been very sick for 2 weeks, and I knew the chambers were probably gooky so I turned them off for about 2 1/1 days.  I cleaned them today expecting some kind of science experiment gone wrong - even cleaning them weekly I'd get a ton of gook.  Well, there was gook, but surprisingly not nearly what I expected.  I am now using 10 drops because I realized I have an almost 2 gallon tank so I'm hoping next week when I clean them I'll see even less gook.

source_doc: Works well, seems well made. Ok, I hate cleaning my shower. I mean it's not gross, but it's not spic-and-span either. I was glad to receive this and as soon as I got it, I plugged in the included charger and charged it for an hour or so. (It shows a red LED when charging that flips to green when fully charged.) As the pic shows, it consists of the head, where the brushes attach, along with 2 other sections, one of which contains the battery, the other is an extension piece that also telescopes to provide more length. You also get 4 brushes of various sizes.After charging it up, I sprayed down the shower with a soap scum cleaning spray and let it sit for about 5 minutes. Then I went to town on it with this little baby. I made the mistake of trying the large, flat brush, and I quickly realized the large rounded brush is a much better option for shower cleaning. Otherwise, it's a little hard to control and it dances around a bit.It worked well, and made the job simple - no awkward bending, reaching, standing in the tub, etc. Glad I purchased it. I've not tested the battery duration yet, but it didn't slow down, and still had plenty of power after I used it.

source_doc: Inexpensive, but with cheap construction. I got this shelf/rack for my basement exercise room. It was inexpensive which is good because it is also somewhat problematically constructed.The first one they sent me had a piece soldered upside down. So I wasn’t able to assemble it. The second one had all the pieces soldered correctly but when I hung them up, the one side was longer than the other. So I couldn’t make it level. I had to Jerry rig it to make the bottom racks be level. (Second picture) I also had trouble with the mollies they included—they were super weak so I wasn’t able to successfully hammer them into the wall even after I pre-drilled holes. I got them partially in and then the top would just cave in and I had to cut them off.I found the installation instructions difficult to follow and incomplete. Thankfully I’m handy enough to figure out how to do it. But it took a fair bit of time. So just prepare yourself for that.Because it’s attached with six screws, it feels pretty solid. I think it’s going to do the job well.

source_doc: Pumps well and came with 21 mm as well. I really enjoy using this hands free pump in addition to my other pumps I have from last couple of years. I just had my 3rd baby and hands free is the way to go if you have little ones. It's easy to use and cleaning is not hard, basically same as other pumps with cups. I got this because I wanted to have other options when pumping middle of the night. Also, I didn't see it mention in the listing but 21mm came with it as well.As for the cons, I noticed the actual pumps on top falls off and is not as secure as I would have liked. I wished it had a bit of a screw on so it would remain in place. Sometimes when I angle it to put them on my breasts, the pump (top) parts comes off. Also, I am not sure if they sell the actual cup for this pump but it would be a good idea since there are special and spectra cups would not fit here. The noise level seems a bit louder than my willow 3.0 but  since they work fine, I am pretty much used to it now.

source_doc: Not Just for Babies! I always like to sleep with some sort of sound going and I usually like the sound of a fan noise blowing however, when I go away which is a lot, I never have any sounds I can take with me besides what I get from an app on my phone. When I saw this popup in my feed, I knew this would make the perfect addition to my travels.The product itself is small and compact. I can throw it in my suitcase and use it when I get to my destination at night in my bedroom for when I sleep. There are about 5 lullabies you can choose from and also nature sounds which is what I use to help me fall and stay asleep.

source_doc: I should have bought this years ago. I love this thing.  I love hard boiled eggs but often don't eat them because of the hassle of making them.  When I do make them, I tend to not eat all of them, or by the time I do, they have lost their flavor.  With this egg cooker I can make them on demand with pretty much zero effort.  I also love fried eggs over medium but it's such a pain to always get out the frying pan etc... I just make medium boiled eggs with this and it's pretty much the same!  I tried doing the poached eggs, but could not find the best amount of water/time to get them cooked right.  I could get the yolk perfect, but the underside of the egg white was still runny.  Added more water and the yolk was almost completely cooked and the underside egg white was till runny.  Not a big deal because again, I get exactly the cook I want with the medium boil and can do more eggs at a time.I would have paid triple for this item it's that good.  I don't really understand the negative reviews about the timer.  It is loud, but not obnoxious and I can hear it anywhere in the house.  The melody is fine, it took me a few times to realize it was the egg timer and not my phone ringing.

source_doc: Brings sound down a notch and are super comfy. I work from home and have a couple of dogs a toddler and various other distractions around the house, usually when I want to tune them out I throw on some headphones but sometimes I just want quiet so I got these to help with that.  It came packaged well and I didn't see any defects in them.  In the box you get a case, two rings to put the ear tips on, and 6 different ear tips to use.  I chose the large double-flanged and got to it. Getting the stock tips off was fairly easy and putting the new ones on was too after that I stuck them in.  It isn't complete noise cancelation I can still hear most things fine but it's like the volume got turned down a bit which I love.  Also when Im wearing them I can barely feel them so I might actually try sleeping in them.  All in all, these are fantastic 5 starts not notes.

source_doc: Love the ladder hardware, screws are horrid. Love the hardware, the screws are worthless.  I used oak sides and rockler steps.  (Saved enough on the rolling hardware I decided to splurge on the steps).Be careful planning the alignment of the top rail as the wheels only clear the mounts at the operational angle.I read how bad the screws were bug figured I could be careful.  They're horrible.  I predrilled, new bit, gently installed, and the heads still stripped.  I complained and was sent smaller screws.  I ended up replacing them with others from Amazon.  Pain in the neck because I had to use an easy out on 3.The wheels and rail are fairly straightforward to install.  I built my ladder, then put it up to figure out where to screw the top in.  The hardware seems fairly well made.  I did have trouble putting the caps on the rails and between the rails, the o-rings wanted to tear themselves up the fit was so tight.  That was annoying and I replaced one, but I ended up deciding they weren't that important and didn't worry if the others tore.Would have preferred that the bottom locks, but the ladder rolls smoothly and I'm really happy with it.I replaced the screws with:https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00GI8BVKG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00
hypos: Мне нравится фурнитура для лестницы, но винты ужасные. Фурнитура хорошая, а винты бесполезные. Я использовал боковые панели из дуба и ступени Rockler. (Сэкономив на движущейся фурнитуре, я решил потратиться на ступени). Будьте осторожны при планировании выравнивания верхнего ограждения, так как колеса лишь слегка освобождают крепления под рабочим углом. Я прочитал, какие плохие были винты, но подумал, что смогу быть осторожным. Они ужасные. Я заранее просверлил, использовал новое сверло, аккуратно установил, и головки все равно сорвались. Я пожаловался и мне прислали меньшие винты. В итоге я заменил их на другие с Amazon. Это было неприятно, потому что мне пришлось использовать извлекающее сверло на 3. Колеса и направляющая довольно просто устанавливаются. Я собрал свою лестницу, а затем поставил ее, чтобы решить, куда прикрутить верхнюю часть. Фурнитура кажется довольно качественной. Это было раздражающе, и я заменил одно, но в итоге решил, что они не так важны, и не переживал, если другие порвались. Я бы предпочел, чтобы внизу были замки, но лестница катится плавно, и я действительно этим доволен. source_doc: Works great for my very fine thin fragile hair, but it's a bit sticky... This TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist works great for my very fine thin fragile, and somewhat curly hair. This spray mist is a bit sticky, but I guess that's what gives it its grippiness.Whenever I go out, I always wear wigs, but at home I sport the little bit of hair I have, as it's just more comfortable. This works as a double duty product. It provides a bit of texture and volume to my natural hair, making it look like I have more than I do.It also gives it more grip for keeping my wigs in place. I'm unable to wear a wig cap, only wig grips. This gives them something more to hold on to than just my wimpy looking hair. When I remove my wigs, I can just spray with water, scrunch, and let my hair dry to revive it.This is not the type of spray or mist that you can easily spray onto your hair, as it actually doesn't create a mist. I just spray it into my hands, rub them together, and apply it throughout.Even though it is not technically a mist, I still like this texture, volume, and grip it provides to my natural hair, and would absolutely recommend it!
hypos: Это хорошо работает для моих очень тонких хрупких волос, но немного липковато... Этот спрей TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist отлично подходит для моих очень тонких хрупких и немного кудрявых волос. Этот спрей чуть-чуть липкий, но я думаю, что именно это и придаёт ему сцепление. Когда я выхожу, я всегда ношу парики, но дома я обладаю тем крохотным количеством волос, которое у меня есть, так как так удобнее. Это работает как двойной продукт. Он придаёт немного текстуры и объёма моим натуральным волосам, заставляя их выглядеть так, словно у меня больше волос, чем есть на самом деле. Он также обеспечивает лучшее сцепление, чтобы держать мои парики на месте. Я не могу носить сетку для париков, только зажимы для париков. Это даёт им что-то большее, за что можно ухватиться, чем просто мои жалкие волосы. Когда я снимаю парики, я просто распыляю воду, мну и даю волосам высохнуть, чтобы «оживить» их. Это не тот тип спрея или тумана, который можно легко распspray на волосы, так как фактически он не создаёт туман. Я просто распыляю его на руки, растираю их вместе и наношу по всей длине. Хотя это технически не туман, мне всё равно нравится эта текстура, объём и сцепление, которые он придаёт моим натуральным волосам, и я бы абсолютно порекомендовал/а это!

source_doc: Disappointment. Bought these based on the reviews that were like "Oh my god these damaged my stairs when I removed them!" because I didn't plan on removing them and I wanted them to stick as good as possible.Well... they don't. These are old stairs. Still though, I prepped them as I would anything that I plan to stick with adhesive. They were very easy to stick down but unfortunately they're not that sticky. I've walked over each piece on each stair back and forth multiple times to get as much pressure on every point of contact and they just won't stay stuck. I don't know what to do other than maybe some contact cement around all the edges.These are cheap and look alright. I'd be more upset if they were priced higher but I should have figured this would be the outcome for what I paid. I guess I was just hoping that the reason other reviews say they damage stairs when they're removed is because they stick SO well. Not the case, actually.

source_doc: These are great! I ordered these when the time changed (we live in an area that does Daylight Saving Time) and it started getting dark by 5:00pm. I didn’t like pulling up at home after work and getting out in the dark, so I got these bulbs to put in the fixtures on the front of our detached garage. They work like a charm!! I was so pleased the next day when I came home and had lights on! We’ve had these all winter now, and I purposely waited to write this review so I could be sure of how well they work. They come on at dusk and go off at dawn - just as advertised! I actually like that they stay on all night because then they function as security lights. I have absolutely no complaints about these bulbs, their brightness, their dependability, nothing. They are fantastic and I wish I’d bought them years ago. I would certainly recommend these to anyone.

source_doc: Good Keyboard for a Beginner or Novice. this is a nice keyboard for beginner.  It's not quite the full piano keyboard size but better than a 66 key offered on some.  I am an adult beginner, and this works fine.  There are way more bells and whistles then I need and the manual that comes with it is thick, I hope to get to it someday.  I have noticed that the keyboards and the song playback option are just a bit off.  One or the other is sharp or flat by just a little so it is a bit annoying.  I went with Yamaha because of the name and the PSR-EW310 is near the bottom of their price range, and I am glad I bought it.  It does not include a stand or a bench but the small table I have it on works fine for now, no sustain peddle either.  I did buy some headphones because I live in an apartment and so glad I did because it helps shut out other noises and I can concentrate better.  Yes, I'm a little ADD.

source_doc: Not A Bad Alternative For Cat Litter. I wasn't so sure about this litter but I was surprised that it was not so bad. I have 3 cats and 2 litter boxes so the main issue I have with cat litter is the strong smell that the boxes leave around the house. I've tried all kinds of litter and while they do work it doesn't get rid of the smell entirely. I started using this mixed litter and it works really well. I know the litter is flushable but I feel better just throwing it away when I clean the boxes. The cats took a bit to get used to the mixed litter but I was surprised that it did handle the odor really well. I would have to get more bags to handle my 3 cats but I would use this Mixed Litter again because it did get rid of the odor and easy upkeep.

source_doc: Bought ultra healing in lieu of regular version due to availability/pricing. Same overall quality of the ultra healing product vs the regular Curel moisturing lotion.  The former's viscosity is a little thicker, so as you apply/rub it on, there is a less fluid/liquidity feel to it as the regular Curel.  I would not characterize it as 'tackier' application feeling but definitely thicker and not as smooth/slippery.  If this bothers you, get the  regular blend Curel.  I don't have any comment (yet) if the ultra healing works any better/quicker than the regular moisturizing version as this is my first/earlier use.  I will say the regular version works fine, so I expect to have improved, quicker results from the ultra healing.  I love Curel as I have very low oil and very dry skin.  I apply the lotion in the morning and in the evening, and it resolved some significant skin cracks (actual severe that had some light bleeding) and fingertip ends very rough/dry/abrasive skin in about a week.  So now I use it regularly twice a day and have had no recurring dry, rough, or breaks in the skin.  I don't perceive either ultra or regular Curel as oily or leaving a long-standing film.  I just rub and spread it thoroughly over the skin and in a minute or two I don't even think about whether my skin is greasy, don't notice it.

source_doc: I love it. I did significant research before pulling the trigger on the Honbay modular sectional. I’m so glad I did. My family and I absolutely love it. As other reviews mentioned, 5 out of 7 boxes arrived earlier than expected. The 2 remaining boxes arrived the next day. Once I had an idea of what I was working with in my space, I ordered two additional ottoman pieces to create the sectional I had envisioned. I have a weird space in my living area so many traditional sectionals would be too large. It was super easy to assemble, I did it myself over the course of the two arrival days. I love the storage in each piece, which really helped to declutter my living area and eliminated the need for two storage baskets, freeing up floor space in the process. I love the firmness of the seats. I would agree with other reviews that the back cushions could be fluffier but I added a lot of my own pillows which solves that problem for me. My kids and my dog have bounced around on it and I haven’t noticed any instability. With the layout I chose, I love the little cutout which makes it easy for kids or dog to climb in. I’m so thrilled with my new sectional. If you are on the fence, do it!!

source_doc: Poor Quality. On the positive side, the lock is easy to install. The directions are clear and the lock has a voice menu. After following the directions and installing the lock, I added batteries and set the administrative passcode. I then programmed the lock for a left hinge door - all very easy following the instructions. Beware, after making these settings, the door locked. I wasn't able to unlock it with the passcode. I had to retrieve a spare key and enter through another door. After deleting the default passcode, I set up my own passcode. So far so good. I then tried locking the door by pressing the # key for 2 seconds. I heard the motor whir and the voice stating that the door was locked. Unfortunately, door was not locked. The deadbolt hadn't moved. Whether I tried locking or unlocking the door, the motor would whir and the voice would announce door locked, BUT the deadbolt never moved or engaged. It would not lock or unlock. I was disappointed because the features of this lock were exactly what I was looking for. Quality is just not there.  I returned it.

I love that they have the bar infront to hold things in, easy to clean, the perfect size for what I needed them for, and SOMEWHAT easy to put together. The only reason I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the reason why I said somewhat easy to put together. I had one end piece that the holes were not done correctly for the bar piece. So could only use one dowel to hold it in place instead of two. Which shouldn't effect it at all, but you expect something to come in with no defects at all. With that being said, I would get these again in a heartbeat and highly recommend them.

source_doc: Love them. I just purchased for a second time.Pros:I like these because they have a size 0 that is wide. These nails are durable and lasted me two weeks. (Of course that depends on how you apply your nails.)They come with a lot of nail sizes, which I like. I have wide width nail beds and their size 0 fits great. (Since I repetitively use the 4 & 5, I wish you could just order your sizes versus having extra sizes I cannot wear, but I get my money’s worth by using the extra nails to practice designs.)FYI, I use gel polish so it definitely makes them look professional. They are thin by the cuticle and thicker at the end so it makes it easier to file to fit your nails and look like acrylics.The price is great for how many nails you get and for the quality. I did crack a nail after I took them off, but this was me putting a heavy object on them. Please do not think these nails are unbreakable, because they can. They are still very strong (not fragile) and did excellent for the two weeks.Lastly, I did not have any issues where I had to contact customer service so I cannot speak to that, but the product is good. I will buy again.

source_doc: I was skeptical. I needed a carrier for 2 kitties I got from our daughter. source_doc: Not the best for spices. I bought these to store some of my dry spices however I noticed that the jars had a strong chemical smell when opening them. I did not want these chemicals to seep into my spices. After a bit of tinkering with the jars I realized that the chemical smell was coming from the white styrofoam seals in the lids—once I took them out the jars smelled fine. I choose these jars specifically because they screw shut unlike some others jars that just have a cork/plunger type lid. For my purposes since I use my spices frequently and I don’t live in a very humid climate I don’t need the airtight seals which I took out. With that in mind this was a good purchase for me however it may not be for others who are looking to store spices.Edit————After removing the chemical smelling seals that came with these jars I decided to buy rubber gasket seals online to replace them. Cheap and very effective and now my jars are air and water tight. Unfortunate that I had to go to this extra step but these jars are nice enough for me to go the extra mile.

source_doc: The formula has changed. I bought this product because I have used it before and loved it.  However something changed and it caused a mild allergic reaction.  I know that I have some allergies that often get labeled as “fragrance” in skin products so I normally test a new product on my wrist first.  I didn’t this time because I had used the product before, so I just immediately applied it to my whole face. I did notice that the scent was stronger and the ingredients have changed slightly (I looked after I had the reaction).  I normally would not leave a negative review on a product for an allergic reaction, but since this was something that I have been able to use without issue in the past and can no longer use, I felt that people should know.

source_doc: So sadly disappointed. I bought this sticker for my son’s wall above his computer where he plays his computer games. I thought that the pattern and the writing style were super cool and I knew my 10-year-old would love it. I ended up ordering this item twice because the first time it never arrived the second one that I got. I cleaned my wall before sticking it and  made sure it was dry before placing it where I wanted it. Once I stuck it on, I could tell there were going to be problems because it immediately started peeling on the sides where the first letter is and the last letter is the next morning after the day I put it up the entire sticker had fallen off my wall. I wish I could send it back, since I have it stuck to a piece of cardboard in case the company will work with me and returning it but please don’t buy this unless your walls have no pattern or any type of raised parts to it. I’m not sure if that’s why it didn’t stick but I cleaned it and ride it so I don’t see why the sticker did not stay on my wall.

source_doc: Bright Lights. Short Length. I ordered these to add some lights under my cabinets. I am currently using battery operated puck lights… which need battery replacement often. I don’t want to keep replacing the batteries or forgetting… and then they corrode. ANYWAY, these were my solution. However, I am not handy, and I have zero clue how to install these. You would think it’s as easy as sticking them up and boom you’re done. But I’m afraid to cut the wire and then they don’t work. My boyfriend is an electrician, and I am hoping he can help ease this process and make it worry free for me… but for now, I’m not so sure what to do. There are detailed instructions, but I am scared to do something wrong… and how do they connect between cabinet spaces? However, I am happy this came with all the pieces necessary for the job. And as you can see the lights actually work and are pretty bright. I can’t blame the lights that I don’t know how to install… but to me, personally, it’s not very user friendly. I “pretend” hung them in my kitchen, and they weren’t long enough any way. I would consider hanging them in my closet, where no cutting would be involved, but I don’t have an outlet in there. Hopefully one day I will be able to provide an update with a more positive review.

source_doc: Best Wipes - From a Preschool Teacher! I’m very fortunate in that I teach a class of twelve toddlers who all require diaper changes throughout the day. I’m fortunate because while I was pregnant, I was able to test out ten different kinds of wipes! These were by far my favorite. Most wipes are too dry to really get anything clean. I felt like I was scrubbing some of the kids’ bottoms to get them clean, which obviously isn’t very comfortable. These wipes are a dream! Wet enough to get the job done, and thick enough that I have never felt like I was going to get anything on my fingers. (Granted, I wear gloves at the preschool. I mean with my new daughter!) My girl has never had diaper rash, and while she has eczema on her little face cheeks, her booty remains clear! I had 3 boxes of these wipes, and she is ten weeks old. I still have 3 packs from the second box, and I’m only opening the third to send some to daycare. They last a while! Just get them!

If their manufacturing and packaging practices are truly cGMP as claimed, this seal issue should never have made it to the hands of buyers.

source_doc: About 2/3 shades lighter than picture so order wisely. This hairpiece is very beautiful. It’s long wavy and light. It wraps around your bun really well and cascades down your back very beautifully. The only problem is that the color between what you see in the picture and what you get when it arrives is way off about 2 to 3 shades lighter than expected. I ordered the blonde color and I thought based on the picture that it would be a dusky darker blonde and it ended up being a lighter blonde, lightening towards the tips into an almost platinum blonde, so I can’t use this hairpiece, but that doesn’t mean I didn’t like it. It’s a really well-made piece. I wish that the colors were more true to what you would expect when you order so please keep in mind the difference in color I’m attaching two pictures one is with flash and one is without, and then you can see the difference between what I ordered and what I got. I did order another piece that I hope is closer to my hair color so that I can use it because I really did like this. Took a star off for color variation, and kept the 4 stars for the quality, fit, and price.

source_doc: Really liked them, but they would not charge. I really liked these lanterns. They flashlight option was extremely bright. The big downside is the charging. Upon receiving them, I plugged them both in. A blue light came on for about 5 seconds and then disappeared. I assumed this meant that they were fully charged. I took them camping and they started fading before the end of the first night. The next day I plugged them both in for about 3 hours apiece. The same thing happened when I plugged them in, a blue light for about 5 seconds then it disappeared. No indication if they were actively charging or fully charged. After 3 hours of charging apiece, I tried using them for my 2nd night of camping. As soon as I turned them, they died within a minute as if they hadn’t been charged at all. I returned them. These lanterns failed me on my camping trip. I can’t have an unreliable light source that doesn’t given any indication at all of charging or battery status. It’s a shame because I really liked the outside of the charging issues..

source_doc: Simply Beautiful. I got these lights in with no idea of what exactly I was really ordering. Which is very odd for me because I don’t spontaneously get products without reading every little detail. When they arrived and I saw that the strand was 400’ long,  I was surprised and then a little disappointed in myself for ordering them. Until my brain started to click. I decided to take the forever long, flexible and sleek looking strand and I literally wrapped each branch of my Christmas tree from the top to the bottom and still had plenty left over. They were so pretty, blended right in and had people asking me if my tree was a pre lit. I didn’t have to worry about gaudy light string’s being seen, lights never got hot and I was able to change them from being on steady to blinking, twinkling or fading in and out. I also loved how it came with a remote control as I was able to change the brightness level. I do recommend that If you do use these and decide to wrap them up afterwards, take your time and go slow or you’ll end up with a big birds nest as I did. I was able to get it straightened out but it took some time!

source_doc: if you use festool, with makita vac…it’s a must. it has taken me a long time to work with multiple tool platforms.  Not having a money tree and moving among trade work, construction, and wood working it is also a fact that festool doesn’t make every tool under the sun.  I like the makita vacuum and have really enjoyed it, but bouncing back and forth between AWS gear and plugged in festool devices I got the idea to get this product and velcro a festool power chord to it.  Now when I use my festool planer or sander, I swap hoses (which is easy unlike other extractor or shop vac platforms) and attach the one with the chord.  No it’s not the festool system, but it works for me and has made my desire to get another dust extractor not be a hot button issue.  The older I get the more conscious I am of what I am breathing in.  I can’t say I gave much thought into sanding walls in my fraternity house 30 yrs ago. What I can say is that while I work alone in a job, I will have several extractors, but as far as I am concerned this hose has at least temporarily saved me $900.

source_doc: Made me break out, scent is a bit strong for me. This has a sticky texture and doesn't quite absorb into the skin, but rather, sits on top of it. I personally didn't love the scent and found it to be a bit strong. I put this on my body and immediately started itching and developed hives. As soon as that happened, I went to wash it off my body and then came to read the reviews, where I learned from another review that this is meant to be WASHED OFF after applying, though it isn't included in the package instructions. I must say that, after rinsing, I did feel a bit of relief from the pain I was experiencing and it did help me feel sleepy.I would use it again, but this needs clearer instructions.Also, about the pack@ging: Personally, I feel it's a bit wasteful to pack the plastic-wrapped bottle in a heavy b0x, use something to fill the empty space. And the note from the family is sweet, but I don't know them and it's printed on heavy cardstock. I'm not hanging it in my house anywhere, and I'd rather none of this was included, it just gave me more to discard (I recycled the b0x, its filling and the note). But even if I were giving this as a gift (which I wouldn't), it felt a bit overdone and wasteful.

I did not personally like the silicone bottle brush that was included so I just brought my own regular bottle brush. I did really like that it came with a small soap bottle. I think this would be perfect for a working mom who is pumping and doesn't want to leave their pump stuff all over the icky shared kitchen or something.

source_doc: Took me a long time to figure this out, but happy with it now. I was eager to try this as a way to record from my guitar onto a Macbook Pro, but was totally new to this type of device.  I understood that I would need to download 'digital audio workstation' (DAW) software, so I read about a few options and decided to go with the free version of Waveform. After downloading it, and connecting my guitar to the BOMGE, and connecting the BOMGE to my laptop (all of which were simple and quick), I spent an unsuccessful hour trying to achieve a recording. Then I downloaded Audacity software and retried, but was again unsuccessful. At that point, I had no idea whether the trouble was the BOMGE or just me not being able to figure this out. Turned out it was me. I returned to Waveform, re-watched a couple of its Youtube tutorials (which I highly recommend for beginners), and eventually got the hang of this. (With the guitar plugged into port 2, make sure that the 'inst' button is set on, and in Waveform, set the input for the recording track to 'input 2.') After that, the info page that came with the BOMGE was meaningful, and I have found the device to be just what I hoped for. source_doc: My GPRO TKL Replacement. I hate to admit this but I'm a Logitech fan, and all of my peripherals, until now, are Logitech hence why I have a GPRO TKL and a G604... Both of which have problems after 2 years.. Anyways, goodbye Logitech, and here I come Keychron. I originally bought the K3 v2 since I wanted a little bit more space on my desk and improve the ergonomics. Summary is it didn't work out. I kept hitting the LED and Page Up keys so I got these instead. For the price, this keyboard has A LOT to offer especially since I outgrew the RGB trend. I also don't care for the software or custom macros. For the past 2+ years I've owned my GPRO and G604, I never touched custom macros and key binds.As a Logitech fan, it hurts me to say that the quality of this keyboard is probably better than their G lineup. Only time will tell if this will hold true for me, but it probably doesn't matter because I can just replace the switch and keycaps when this dies, unlike the GPRO TKL (you can desolder it...).

source_doc: Wish I had bought it sooner. Glad I bought it when I did because I got it for half the price it’s selling for now. I previously had famous chefs oven type air fryer. It worked decent for about a year, but it was extremely hard to keep the inside clean. I use it several times a week so I kept it on the counter but it was an eye sore! It started giving off a burnt wore smell so I pitched it and bought this one. I didn’t want to spend another $200+ so I gave this one a chance. I absolutely LOVE it!!!! Everything cooks beautifully, clean up is very easy. Wish I had bought this one from the very beginning

source_doc: I hesitate to say how much I love this guitar but…. I sent mine back. It was said to have a blemish on the body. It did not. It was gorgeous and beautiful and I love the feel and pickups. It had a warped neck. It needed a fret job and a nut job. I can do fret jobs but I can’t fix a warped neck. I almost cried sending it back. It had a wonderful vintage feel and tone. I plan to get another. I love this guitar and I have a lot of guitars. I can’t recommend this to anyone other than luthiers who appreciate the 70’s.To new players get a new guitar with perfect action and half price. Eart. There’s so many.

source_doc: Great bulbs! I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I was thinking I'd switch to all Kasa so I'd have just the one app on my phone.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I decided I'd just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2 minis.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  I thought it was me.  I decided last resort to try a Lumiman bulb just to eliminate a Kasa hardware factor and maybe my WiFi was an issue and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  Plus, these have no color which I rarely use on any of my smart bulbs.  So win win.  Too bad it seems there are no Lumiman plugs.  I used the second bulb in a lamp where I was using a Kasa plug.  Anyone have any recommendations to replace my other Kasa plugs?

source_doc: Don’t waste your time or money. I have a 6 year old German Shepherd that was going on a 1k mile road trip with me. I wanted her to be more comfortable while strapped into a safety harness in the backseat of my GMC Terrain. I ended up purchasing this 1 piece grey inflatable seat extender in a bind because a different product I ordered had been delayed and wouldn’t arrive in time. I read the reviews and knew I was taking a chance.Product inflated easily using a shop vac. It fit very well and I was able to adjust seat position and seat back easily.The outside temp was around 28° F so I left it inside the house after checking the fit thinking I would pop it in place before hitting the road.In a 70° F room it completely deflated in under an hour. I checked the plug, reinflated it and again it was completely deflated in under an hour. I decided to give it one more chance; fully inflating it and checked it for leaks in the bathtub. I could not find a single location where air was escaping. No air bubbles at any seams or the plug.I ended up putting empty cardboard boxes in the floorboard instead of using this product.Don’t buy it. It’s not worth the high chance that it will be defective.

source_doc: Nice, Slim. I had my doubts.  But I like these.  The one I use most is holding olive oil.  I like the very thin spout, I have good control of how much oil I add to the pan.  The slim design makes it fit nicely into my cabinet and I like the way it feels and fits in my hand.  The little gravity stopper is very nice, I must say.  No dribbling, the top is always back on as soon as you tilt the bottle back up, not sitting in an oily puddle on the counter.  The other we use for my kids mouthwash. They were having problems opening the locking caps and this is perfect.  I was worried they'd destroy it immediately, I really was hesitant about having kids handle it daily, but it holds up just fine, it has resisted their destruction so far.  The glass seems fairly thick and it has a silicon boot to keep the bottom from chipping, thank goodness. This set includes two adorable little shot glasses meant to fit atop each bottle.  Obviously I don't need the one from the olive oil bottle so I use it to start plant cuttings, but "someone" in my house was enjoying it as a liquor shot glass before I co-opted it for horticultural use.

source_doc: Just what I wanted. I had a jump rope but I didn’t like the super light jump rope cord on it. I needed something a little heavier that I don’t have to spin at a thousand miles an hour to make it track straight. This kit is fantastic, I trimmed the medium cord (the black one) to the size in needed with the included tools and took off using it like I’ve owned it forever because it felt so natural. The medium is perfect for me but I will also trim the other two cords to the same length so I can mix it up now and again. I have nothing but good things to say about this set, the handles are comfortable and spin well, the quick release system works well, all three included cords seem high quality and the case is nice. The extra set screws and Allen wrench were a nice touch and the cable cutters are so nice they are going right in my tool box after I get my other two cords sized. In my opinion this jump rope set is a great value and I can recommend this without reservation.

source_doc: Awesome thermometer. I love this thermometer! I never worried about a thermometer until the RONA hit. The first time I caught it was right before we could get vaccinated and I have Fibromyalgia so even the CDC told us that I was going to have a rougher time of it than my mom. And I did, I fought with a fever for over a week while she never had a fever. (That's just the pertinent symptom here) We had gotten 2 thermometers one for the temple and I got a regular one because I had to be able to use it simply and in the dark and didn't want to fumble with it. But they both used button batteries. Guess what, a couple years later when I got it a second time (proving I was more prone to it because I didn't pass it to my mom as she had passed it to me) Both thermometers were dead and we couldn't check my temp, though I didn't have a fever. So when I saw this one and saw it took normal every day run of the mill always on hand batteries and that it displayed the same as the ones we had I grabbed it right up and it didn't disappoint. And while I don't need it yet, I did try it and it works perfectly. I'm so happy with this thermometer.

source_doc: Going back to knipex. Long story short, I tried to use these, and they weren’t for me. After cutting what turned out to be a hot wire thanks to sloppy wiring in the past, I discovered these after watching a video recommending them.  I thought the pliers would be sort of a two tools in one for my tool belt.  If I need to cut a heavy gauge wire, the button would give me additional leverage without going back to my tools or carrying one more tool around.  What happened instead was the 85% of the time I was just cutting 10, 12 or 14 ga romex that the pliers were awkward in my hand and about half the time locked shut.  It would turn  a no look grab from tool belt, cut and return to tool belt into a grab, fiddle, cut, return.  I don’t have small hands but I am certainly not palming basketballs either (typically size L glove). The wihas were bulkier than my knipex cutters. The difference was a tool that took little thought was replaced with a tool that just didn’t fit or feel right.  When I was removing some old chain link fence, I appreciated the extra leverage but how often do I do that.After trying them for a month, I finally just went back to my knipex cutters.  Maybe I didn’t give these a fair shake, but I really don’t like using tools that offer me no benefit.

source_doc: Warm White Light Bulb. Exactly whT I expected. I got the warm white color. 3000 Lumen or whatever the rating is. I knew these were not dimmable. I didn't see the note on the site that clearly says do most dim these or else they may flicker or hum. My microwave does have 2 settings for lighting underneath. They do flicker a bit only when on the lower setting. As they clearly posted. However, I decided before I bought these to not use the lower setting. Not a big deal. We use it as a kitchen night light. Why didn't I buy the dimmable ones? Because the ones I saw came in a pack of 6 and I only needed 2. If it really bothers me later I will buy dimmable lol. These are good bulbs. I didn't rate the longevity because they have only been in my microwave for 5 mins.

source_doc: Using as an Ice Bin. I am writing this review and including pictures for those, like myself, who wants to use this as an ice bin.  I don't have a refrigerator with an built in ice maker and so I needed something to store a bag of ice.  I had originally purchased the 21 cup LocknLock but when it arrived, it didn't look big enough to hold a big bag of ice; so I sent that one back and ordered this 50.7 cup LocknLock bin.  It is large and takes up almost half to the upper freezer shelf but as I have a separate stand alone freezer, this isn't a problem.  What I like about it is that this bin have a large front door that I can scoop ice out of.  The lid snaps easily in place and the base seems pretty solid so I don't expect any leakage.  No cons so far but will update if I experience any.  The pictures shown are what was left of the bag of ice I'd purchase, so about a quarter of the bag.  I think another bag of ice will fill this bin completely full.

source_doc: The shrimp are healthy! The shrimp are beautiful and healthy and so fun to watch.  DO NOT put them in a tank with a betta, guppies or Harlequins.  I have 2 tanks, and at first, I thought it was the betta that was eating them, so I removed him to my second tank. They still kept disappearing, so I removed the harlequins, because after hours of observation, I saw them get aggressive to the helpless shrimp. All that was left was guppies, and they still got eaten. I loved the shrimp so much, they were so fun to watch, but if I try again, I will have them in their own tank with nothing else.  They all arrived alive, healthy and very active.  Their color is so striking.  I feel terrible the research I did online was wrong.  I do wonder if you can keep different colors of shrimps together?  The red and white ones are so cool, too.  So learn from me, people, and don't put them with other fish or they will become a very expensive appetizer!

source_doc: Good value. I bought this in January, 2023 and have been playing it for 3 months now. I am a beginner so I didn’t want to invest too much in something if I didn’t stick with it. The threads aren’t rounded off but don’t stick out too much on the sides. The strings were a bit rusty from the warehouse but I didn’t change them out in case I wanted to return. I finally changed them out the other day after 3 months averaging 8-9 hours a week of playing.  Sounds much brighter and louder now with fresh strings. The tuning pegs turn smoothly and after the strings stretched they hold tuning fairly consistently. I decided it was time to get it a case and today received this case today. A perfect fit. Crossrock Hardshell Arch Top Wood case fits OM, Martin 000 Guitars-Vinyl Tweed(CRW600OMTW)If you’re a beginner, I think this is a good one to go with. I really like the tone of it compared to others I have heard. My music interests are Dixieland and music from the 30’s so the tone fits that era well.
