source_doc: Everyone said I was dumb for getting this. Literally everyone I spoke to who mentioned this type of product wrote it off and said it was unnecessary and I was dumb for wanting it. They said I’d be too busy cleaning my newborn I would just apply creams with my finger and wouldn’t care.I do care. I care a lot lol. Personally i’m the type of person who eats chicken wings with gloves and washes my hands 20 times when cooking. I hate having random textures or residues on my hands. I made it maybe 3 days with my newborn before I ordered this because I was going insane feeling butt cream residue.I am so relieved I bought this. We switched from our expensive butt cream to cheap petroleum jelly, which works for our baby so much better lol. This spatula is godsend. I just swipe a glop of jelly onto it before the change and then smear it on my baby’s bottom like icing on a cake. The flat sides are great because you can get jelly right in the crack without hassle. You can also tackle their legs and arms without worry of getting them messy with jelly. It is easy to clean with a baby wipe after as well

source_doc: Its ok. not great, but not terrible. I looked at almost every bedside bassinet on market. Read every review, and ended up getting this one. Its not bad. its ok. I dont see much of an issue with sturdiness like some report. I think if you push with force any object even a livingroom couch you can get it to teeter totter. I think the collapsable feature to fold up and set back up is not as simple as i had thought. I wish i had watched a video of someone doing both. I imagine we will leave it assembled and just pick it up to go to another room if needed. The height has 4 settings, although not as high as i imagined. it wont even line up flush with our basic bedframe and matress i think is low to begin with, sits lower. For what it is and for the price, i cant imagine any other would be any better. So, for now, it may work out. baby not here yet, so havent actually used it yet.

source_doc: Nice kit with plenty of extensions. I used this to pull the center drive shaft bearing on my BMW. I found it really easy to setup and get everything in place. I had to use a pair of extenders to reach down the shaft a ways, but even with them combined I found that the tool worked perfectly.All of the pieces are well made and precisely cast. There is a pretty sharp edge to the bearing separator that is great for some applications. This tool is made of cast metal, but it's stronger than I expected.The case is great also at keeping things organized.This is my first tool from Orion Motor Tech, but I'm happy enough that I'll look for their brand next time.Update 02/20/23...I have now used this to remove 5 different bushing or bearing sets and I'm Really Really happy with it. The last bushing I removed was the lower control arm bushing and I used a low torque impact wrench to turn the shaft instead of my fixed ratchet. No matter what I throw at this tool it remains looking and working like brand new. If I lose this one day I would buy it again. Of course I can't imagine it breaking at this point, but I would buy it again in that case as well.

source_doc: Absolutely Luxurious. I have been singing the praises of Andy Pandy diapers for six years and you could not have paid me to use anything else. Until the size large were out of stock for months. I had no choice but to find something similar and I did when I came across Eco Boom. Then for a reason I cannot recall I was on the hunt again. These diapers were on sale and oh how I wish I had been able to purchase more because they are the best diaper I have ever put my hands on. The feel absolutely divine, almost too good to be something a little human poops on. I have had no issues with leaking and they hold pee just as well as the other bamboo diapers I have mentioned here. They are out of my price point but if I they ever go on sale again I will be back. If you can afford them, I highly recommend these diapers.

source_doc: I love this thing! This product came and it was exactly how I expected it to come. Shipped perfectly! This thing works great, and has a mind of its own (in the best way). I usually like to run it when I am at home, just incase it gets stuck or anything, but it also runs while I’m at work! Which is awesome because it makes the house feel a little bit cleaner when I get home and takes the stress off a little bit. I like to use this in between vacuums too, and I can’t believe how much it picks up even right after I use my vacuum! I would recommend this to pretty much everybody, especially pet owners with a dog who sheds, like me! Great product! The app is so easy to use and I can start the cleaning or pause the cleaning right from my phone, from anywhere! I don’t have to be home to operate it which is another added bonus! Plus it alerts you if the vacuum is stuck or has low battery.

source_doc: SHARP. I ordered these scissors because the reviews were good and said they were sharp. They are very sharp I ordered the lefty.  Just a heads up to anyone who is just getting started in grooming your dog with little or no experience take extra care in using these it is extremely easy to cut yourself which I did, the dog wasn't the most cooperative and I got my finger.  I couldn't believe I did that, I thought I cut the dog but luckily I got myself.  Amateur mistake I know but I am an amateur.  My hats off to the professionals out there that do this everyday you surely earn your money!  To all my fellow amateurs good luck and be careful.

source_doc: Just what I was looking for just in case. I was looking for a tire jack for when I travel in my 15,000 lbs fifth wheel but didn’t want a bottle jack due to weight and the possibility of damage to axle if placed wrong. Then I found the Rapid Jack!  It’s light weight, looks like it is easy to use, withstands up to 30,000 lbs, everything I wanted. I haven’t had to use it yet but will make sure I’ve tried it  before my next trip. It looks pretty straight forward though. I think this was an excellent buy and an excellent price. When I had first started to look for one around Christmas time the cost was doubled than what it currently is so I think this was a heck of a deal and I’m glad I waited to purchase this. I highly recommend this item to anyone that travels with a multiple axle trailer.

source_doc: Very convenient way to work on my bike. This repair stand has made working on my bike much easier.  My back is not what it used to be, so I prefer to sit when working on my bike.  I used to flip my bike over and balance it on its handle bars and seat to perform maintenance and repairs.  Now I just clamp it in and go.  I can work on the derailleurs so much more effectively now that it can be upright instead of upside down.  I do not have an e-bike so I am not sure if it would handle that weight.  My bike is about 58lbs to give you and idea of what I have been using this stand for.  The tool tray has magnets that are great for holding the little nuts and bolts that have to be removed.  The tray is sturdy enough to hold my commonly used tools, but I would recommend not putting too much weight on that particular part.  The clamp has been kind to my bike's finish and has not scratched it at all.  I don't fold the stand up very often because I have enough space not to worry, but I do like having the option.  It folds up easily and is pretty compact.  I recommended this to anyone that prefers to do their own bike maintenance.

source_doc: Well made, good value. This one I am keeping. I have purchased other guitars with semi hollow jazz style design. I have gotten rid of all of them, mostly because of feed back and tunning issues. I did spend a lot of time getting the action to my liking. At first I thought I would not be able to accomplish this but I got it. I was tempted to buy the classic vibe model because I already have one in 50's tele, which I really like. However, I really like the simplicity of design on the affinity model in spite of some of the bad reviews I have seen. Did not really find them on this guitar. The neck set up was a bit of a challenge but I got there. I also own an American made tele and strat. Nothing plays as easy or as well as those. This one poses a good competitor at a really substantially lower cost and it is really pretty, The pups are not the greatest but still really ok and I can refine the tone with my modeling style amp. I truly enjoy playing this guitar.

source_doc: Great for the price. I found myself DIYing a new stereo install in a 2015 Miata.  The Mazda engineers seem to have intentionally made everything difficult to get to, or super tight to work around for anyone with big hands.  I ordered this because I don't forsee myself doing much of this sort of thing, so I didn't want to invest in a "I do this for a living" quality product.The plastic is kind of soft, so I don't imagine these would manage to survive much more than a dozen or so cars worth of stereo installs, but for the money it sure as heck beats the more durable options.I didn't even realize it comes with valve stem caps when I ordered it.  That seems like an odd inclusion, but I suppose if I ever need to fill up with air at the gas station and manage to forget to put the cap back on, at least I have spares (enough to derp every wheel twice!)If you're looking for something quick and dirty to accomplish a task, and not looking for something to earn a living with, these are just fine (and heck, for all I know the more expensive ones are just as durable, and I owe these guys an apology)

source_doc: 1mg time release lasts WAY too long, 13+ hrs after taking pill. I've done a lot of experimenting with different timing/dosage of melatonin, so I have a pretty good sense for how any given pill is affecting me. In theory, a 1mg time-release pill should be exactly what I need (more on this below). However, for me, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then induces drowsiness WAY too long. I don't feel much affect until 1-2 hours after taking it, and then it gets most intense right when I need to be waking up (about 8 hours in), and then it continues to make me sleepy for 4+ hours after that. I can definitely feel the affects lasting more than 12 hours.Before trying this tablet, I had been taking a regular melatonin pill divided into 0.5mg pieces twice per night---0.5mg before bed, and 0.5mg between sleep cycles (about 4 hours later). I had been doing this because I need help both falling asleep and staying asleep, and I only need a little melatonin to notice the affects. Taking 0.5mg twice worked well for me. Then I discovered this time-release 1mg tablet, which sounded ideal since I wouldn't have to take a second dose halfway through the night. However, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then lasts WAY too long after that (as described above).

source_doc: very simple and straightforward, easy to use. This device was beautifully designed and the instructions were easy to follow.The way the device heated up the wax was a game-changer for me. I've used other waxing products in the past that required heating the wax up separately and it was always a hassle. With the roll on wax device, all I had to do was plug it in, wait for it to heat up, and then I was ready to go.Using the device itself was a breeze. I simply rolled the wax onto the wax strips, placed them onto my skin, and pulled them off. The strips adhered perfectly to my hair and removed it effortlessly. I was pleasantly surprised at how painless the process was. In the past, I had always associated waxing with pain, but with this device, I barely felt a thing.One of the things I loved most about the roll on wax device was how efficient it was. I was able to remove hair quickly and easily, and the results were long-lasting. I also appreciated how easy it was to clean up after I was done. The wax came off of the strips and the device itself with minimal effort.In conclusion, I highly recommend the roll on wax device to anyone looking for an effective, painless, and efficient hair removal method.

source_doc: Meh... It's OK for low volume playback. So, I have 2 offices I work out of in my home. My small office has a set of M-Audio AV32.1 to play background music at low volume, but I always find the low end lacking. I run a 10" Monolith sub in my other office, paired with Mackie XR624 monitors and I'm mostly happy with that setup, so I thought I would get another Monolith, but I think if would be way too much sub for the M-Audio speakers. Thankfully, Monoprice makes a very inexpensive 10" sub that supposedly plays down to 20hz. I played with it for a couple of hours, and so far, it's ok. I'm cycling now to break it in, but overall it adds that little depth  I was missing on the M-Audio speakers. I'm sure they'll sound better once they are broken in. source_doc: Love it! Very sturdy little stool. I hate to say it but I am 420lbs and getting one of these I was worried I would break it when I sat on it but this little handy dandy stool is pretty darn sturdy. I work as a after care teacher in early education, I have a bad knee and plantar fasciitis in for feet so standing for to long sometimes is kinda difficult. I have to sit with my leg extended out so holding any of my weight up off the stool isn't something that happens. Also my kiddos at school are always wanting to sit on it and of course they try playing with it and it's held up very well! As for comfort, I mean it doesn't have a cushion so it's not like super comfortable but it gives me a place to sit and it holds me up so yeah its good enough. Another good thing is is that i am a tall girl and this isn't so short like other stools like this one where I snap crackle and pop when I go to sit down so that's definitely a plus. It's most definitely worth the money if you need a portable stool.
hypos: Люблю это! Очень крепкий маленький табурет. Мне не нравится это говорить, но я весом 190кг, и, когда я купила один из этих, я боялась, что сломаю его, когда сяду, но этот маленький удобный табурет довольно прочный. Я работаю педагогом дополнительного образования в раннем детском образовании, у меня проблема с коленом и плантарный фасциит на ногах, поэтому стоять слишком долго иногда довольно трудно. Мне нужно сидеть с вытянутой ногой, поэтому удерживать на табурете свой вес не получается. Также мои дети в школе всегда хотят на нем сидеть и, конечно, они пытаются играть с ним, и он прекрасно выдерживает! Что касается комфорта, я имею в виду, что у него нет подушки, так что он не суперкомфортный, но дает мне место, чтобы сесть, и поддерживает меня, так что да, это вполне достаточно. Еще один хороший момент в том, что я высокая девушка, и этот табурет не такой уж низкий, как другие табуреты, где я щелкаю, трещу и хлопаю, когда сажусь, так что это определенно плюс. Он определенно стоит своих денег, если вам нужен портативный табурет.

source_doc: Photophobia no more. I am extremely sensitive and picky when it comes to lighting. If a room is too bright I can't stay in there for too long as I feel like a fish in a tank and can't think. A perfect room has a range of dimmable light options but unfortunately my desk space didn't. Desperate to find a solution that kept me from leaving my work space, I stumbled upon this simple modern looking option. I have used it everyday since receiving it. I hardly ever turn on the lights to my room and instead opt to use this little lamp instead. I love all the different options I can choose from depending on what I am feeling. I also love to use it to do my makeup as one of the settings resembles daylight. This versatile lamp is very worth it for the price point. I am glad I took a chance on it!

source_doc: Feels SO wonderful on my scalp! I have kinky/coily 4b/c hair. I have routinely oiled and massaged my dry scalp with my fingertips 2-3 times per week. I just received my massagers and washed my hair yesterday. Because my kinky/coily hair is VERY difficult to detangle when wet, I did not use while shampooing (YET! I plan to try that later). I wanted to try it 1st with my regular routine - oiling and massaging my dry hair. I began massaging 1st with my fingertips (as usual), then immediately switched to my new silicone massager. The feeling on my scalp was instantly different and wonderful. The massager felt so much better than my fingertips!  I finished at 5:10pm, it is currently 6:10pm and my scalp is still tingling from the excellent blood circulation results of the massager. NEVER felt this when used only fingertips. Also, I saw that one person gave a low rating, stating that the massager hurt scalp and tangled hair. I massaged my scalp gently and it felt SO GOOD! I also noted that, as with fingertips, I always have to detangle with my fingers after massaging. After using massager, my detangle process was about the same and actually seemd a little easier. I love the massager! I will send an updated review if/when I try on my wet kinky/coily hair.

source_doc: Most likely much louder than my ears would appreciate. Before I read the other reviews, I took 2 of these whistles to a park to test them out and I was not impressed, I could not get a good loud sound out of them, no matter how I blew them. After I read some of the reviews I realized it must be me and not them, but even so I couldn't make them whistle loud or even soft really. But after some time went by I went back to park with one and changed my blowing technique and it worked, they are loud, so loud in fact that I was annoying people at the park and my ears were not happy either. They do require some practice apparently to get a good loud sound out of them or just determination. I hope I can make them whistle loud if I'm ever in an emergency situation.

source_doc: There are 2 white wires. This is going to take some playing to determine which is the hot and which is the neutral. I have never seen any light fixtures with all wires being the same color.The light is pretty enough to look at. It's  a light for an RV, how pretty does it need to be? I bought it to provide light in a space with no windows.Having to wire one way and hope it works, then possibly have to switch the wires to make it work is stupid. A little tape or marker on the hot or neutral can not cost that much.Further, there are no instructions,  nada, zip, zilch. It's a good thing I just replaced 5 other lights in the RV or this would be going back. I'll have to mark a wire so I know which way I had it if it doesn't work the first way I try it.Also, there are 8 holes in the light for screws, but only 4 screws provided. They should be enough, but why put in 8 holes if you only need 4 screws?The light is led, so energy efficiency should be good. I don't pay for electric where I currently am, so I don't know how much savings there will be. I may update after I get this thing up.

source_doc: Engine power is reduced? This can be your fix. Ok, another Cadillac story, it has been showing "engine power is reduced" for as long as I got the car as a gift. I don't mind to work on it, and for 2 months I learned a lot. I programmed all the modules that I replaced, still, engine power is reduced...So the last two things I was going to do was to change the fuel, then change the accelerator pedal, since I already changed the throttle body, the accelerator pedal was one big thing on the DTC report. My friends thought I was wasting my money, since how the Accelerator pedal can cause that? Well, that part was under water...so...why not? I took my old pedal out, to my surprise it was really easy to get it out, basically just one screw! Then I opened it, it had some corrosion on it, I tried to clean the chip with contact cleaner and wire brushes, didn't work. So I waited till next day this delivered, replaced it. Turn on the car, the "engine power is reduced" message is gone!! I ran GDS and it didn't show any DTC code, so this was a successful fix!

source_doc: Works well for me. I have bought quite a few Camilla  hair barrettes.  I like the rubber on the clasp and I like the way they look.  Nicely made and hold up well.  I think they're worth the extra cost as you get what you pay for.  I do not have a lot of hair, very fine, medium length.  This clip holds my hair in a ponytail and because it's wider than a hair tie, I think it might make it look like I have more hair.  I think it would be too small or people with thicker hair.  They have plenty of 4" clips that would be better for really thick hair in a ponytail.  Of all the Camilla barrettes I have, none have ever come out of my hair, even with my hair being so fine and thin.  I even have some of the bigger ones and they work fine for me, but this size is ideal for my type of hair in a ponytail.  I would really like to see some models wearing their hair accessories so I could get a better idea of what they look like.

source_doc: I'm REALLY Impressed. At the beginning of pandemic, I was constantly on video calls/doing virtual presentations etc. I heard a lot of  other people in meetings where you could barely understand them, and decided that I didn't want that to be me. I decided to buy a Blue Yeti because I figured it's probably important that other people can hear you speaking.After a few months, I upgraded to the Shure SM7B. It was an incredible upgrade and I was very happy with it. If you can, start with the Shure as opposed to a USB mic.Fast forward a few years, and I'm doing meetings and hosting webinars at least once a day. I heard the Neumann U87 is what NPR uses and I wanted to up the professionalism. I couldn't stomach paying $3500 for a U87, so I decided to compromise and get the TLM 103. It's a huge step up from the Shure.Both are great, but the 103 is way less fuzzy and sounds a lot more like my actual voice. A bonus, is that now I don't have to use a $150 cloud lifter to get decent sound out of the Shure. I highly recommend this product. The price is still a kick in the teeth, but it's noticeably better than anything I'd tried previously.

source_doc: Works as well as the name brand. This product is very similar to the name brand purple shampoo and conditioner that I had been using. The shampoo seems like it is a clarifying shampoo and leaves my hair feeling a little rough, after I use the conditioner it is soft and moisturized. The directions are to leave the shampoo and condition on 3-5 minutes each. When I was using this I felt there was no scent to this product, no perfumes or unpleasant scent. It smelled like nothing at all. After I read reviews stating that it smelled of peppermint I went back and smelled it while in the bottle and I guess it does small vaguely of peppermint.The results are the same as the others, soft hair, but can't tell if either is doing anything. For reference, I had natural red hair, and the front is quite white, while the back still has red (dye) coloring at the ends, the new hair growth is dark, not red like when I was young. The white part of my hair is not brassy at all, nor is the new growth, and I have been using purple shampoo about once or twice a week. So I can't say if it's the shampoo or not, but my hair does feel moisturized with this shampoo.Very purple coloring, does not stain the shower or shower curtain.

source_doc: My dog loves them. I have a dog with heart disease that usually does not mind taking his pills but at times one may be too bitter so I got him these. As far as flavor, I have not tasted them but I can say that the hickory ones are the most liked by all my dogs. When I give my sick dog the pills, the others want the soft chew too, so I give them one  as a treat when they see me. Before I used to buy the chicken flavored ones and only my sick dog took them. The rest were not interested. They didnt smell. The hickory ones smell strong and like real human food. I almost want one from the smell. I like that they are soft and moist and do not crumble. For bigger pills, I cut them and put them in there and I can remold the little ball. Have not tried the peanut butter ones but I will stick to the Hickory as all my dogs love them.

source_doc: I can finally play the high notes. I am an adult casual learner of recorder. I started playing on a $12 yamaha plastic recorder and upgraded to a $30ish dollar wood recorder because I couldn't manage to play high notes. I like the tone of the wooden recorder for the most part but I have the same trouble with notes higher than "G" and couldn't really hit high "B" or "C" at all. With this recorder I am able to hit all of those notes. It's still not super easy but I'm getting better all the time, much less squeaking - the dogs are very thankful. I have read that the arched airway gives more "control" over pitch. As a beginner I can tell that this will be difficult for me as I can vary the pitch a lot unintentionally, would probably make an experienced player cringe. I downloaded a tuning app so I can work on being consistent with my pitch.I also really love the feel of this recorder. It feels more lightweight, refined and well built. I also like the snap on thumb rest. I am pleased with this purchase.

source_doc: I bought a bunch of these and so far, so good. I bought an air purifier for each bedroom in my house and I have a big Winix downstairs to help combat our outrageous fur and dust issue. I like these little ones because they are really really quiet on low. The high setting is a little much sound-wise so I have to agree with other reviewers that there should be a medium setting to move more air but still be quiet. But I do keep them on low and they seem to collect plenty of stuff so I can't complain too much. The color is a little odd, but pleasant if you like blue. I can't comment on the sleep mode because I never use it. I just leave them on low at all times instead. I don't use the light up function either because I like my bedroom dark when I'm sleeping. Overall, I think that for the price, they are a good deal and every little bit helps in my house full of cats and dogs. I also like that you can get filters easily and it's made by a big name brand instead of a small company overseas that could stop offering filters at any time. I think this a good buy and I like them.

source_doc: I couldn't consistently keep the remotes charging. I was really excited to find this product! I have the old Wii system and I have several remotes and I thought this was a great solution to be able to use that system again. However, the product was cheaply made and it seemed to be a wobbly docking station. Once everything was plugged in and remotes were set on the charger the slightest movement stopped the charging process on some remotes. I would mess with the remote on the station and it would start charging again. But, whenever I went back to check it always seemed like a few of them were not charging again. So, I would readjust it to get it charging again only to come back and find that some were charging and some were not. After 15 to 20 minutes of this I decided to return it. I have no idea what triggered it to stop charging. But, the slightest movement seemed to disrupt the whole base. And if you left it alone it still had issues with the position of the docking station and where the charger sat. it was too much of a headache. So I returned it.

source_doc: Very sensitive. I did not know that you're not supposed to use this before your baby's umbilical cord falls off. We have been attaching it off to the side of the umbilical cord. So far I think it's fairly accurate but I also know of at least one or two but I believe to be false alarms. It's kind of hard to tell the things like this. Ultimately I know it's going to give me peace of mind and it's much better than the snooze of because I don't have to manually shut it off under the baby's clothes I can shut it off with my phone. The temperature feature will be useful if little one gets a cold. I definitely think this item is worth the purchase. However I kind of wish that we had an owlette too. Which ultimately I can totally see myself buying the owlette to compare Head to Head. If you're on the fence about this item I say go for it it's better than a lot of other ones on the market and the rollover feature is really nice. I would say just to go by the manufacturer rules and wait for the umbilical cord to fall off. That way you can line it up better and not worry about false alarms.

source_doc: Best on the market. I am ridiculously happy with these under-mount rechargeable lights! I recently updated my master closet and installed two of these lights. They are perfect for what I need. The motion sensor is very sensitive. They turn on immediately as I walk in, remain on as long as I am there and shut off about 30 seconds after I leave.  The brightness is adjustable. There is a switch to turn it on, off, or automatic. The little metal discs that the light magnetizes to are simple to adhere to a myriad of surfaces. I applied them to a melamine shelf so I’m not worried about removal should I want to move them. I would be cautious of applying to painted surfaces unless you plan on it being permanent.These have been perfect in my closet for low light for nighttime or early morning when I don’t want the brightness of over head lighting. I love them so much that I am getting more under cabinet lighting in the kitchen. They would also be perfect for a dark cupboard or linen closet that doesn’t have its own light. Honestly, I need them all over my house!The battery life seems to be long lasting and charging them are quick and simple. You can’t go wrong with these lights!!

source_doc: Buy a concert instead. I bought an Enya Nova plus concert uke and liked it so much I decided to get the tenor also because of the metal frets. I sent it back the day after I got it. I did like the looks of it and the fret board with those rounded frets really looked nice but the action was so high I felt like I was having to chase the strings around. I think the price is high and I didn't want to have to pay to get it set up by someone else. It's also really heavy and the neck is thinner than most of my other ukes ( I have 14). And it feels kind of slippery. It just didn't feel comfortable to play. Maybe the non electric would be better, but I didn't care for the titanium strings either so all in all I think the concert is a better deal.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Himalaya Hello ZZZ’s supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I believe that it is because of the addition of Chamomile and Lavendar that has helped with the restless legs. The suggested usage is one capsule and since this bottle has 60 capsules this product will last a long time. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this product, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: Looks Nice, Quality Is Good, But... ...it didn't fit the dog I ordered it for. Did I measure wrong? I don't know, but I usually order a small or medium for my Chiweenie, this time I ordered a medium and it just doesn't fit. It's too small. The velcro straps barely touch when I put it on him, and it's too big to fit my next smaller dog.However, the quality is very good. It appears very sturdy and well made. I like that the velcro area on the strips is pretty big, so it really offers a secure closure, plus the 2nd closure option, the buckle, also feels sturdy.It's not adjustable in the sense that you can't shorten or lengthen any straps, but it is adjustable in the sense that you can adjust the velcro closure to fit.It's mesh and breathable and looks quite nice. The only thing I would see as a con, (instead of a "pro"), at least for me, is that it doesn't have a any stretch like other similar harnesses do. I feel like with a little bit of stretch, there's a little bi of give, so it doesn't hurt him if I happen to pull on the harness. Some owners may not want any stretch, so I guess this just depends on preference.All in all, I do recommend it based on quality, but unfortunately, it just didn't fit. Make sure to measure correctly!

Липучки едва соприкасаются, когда я его надеваю, и он слишком велик для моей следующей меньшей собаки. Однако качество очень хорошее. Он кажется очень прочным и хорошо сделанным. Мне нравится, что область липучки на лямках довольно большая, так что она действительно обеспечивает надежное закрытие, плюс второй вариант закрытия, пряжка, также кажется прочной. source_doc: Works for me and helps improve my sleep. I was a little unsure about this because I've tried a wide variety of supplements for sleep and not a lot has been effective.I bought these during a bout of stress induced insomnia causing me to wake up around 4-6 am, unable to fall back asleep. Or I would try to sleep early and would struggle for hours to fall asleep. I was exhausted and desperate.These tablets have seemingly helped to stabilize my sleep enough to where even if it's interrupted, I can get back to sleep quickly. I don't wake up feeling groggy like I do if I were to take something like zzzquil.I'm so happy to have these and will definitely always keep them stocked for those stretches of time where my sleep just won't cooperate.Edit: one caveat is these contain lactose. I do not recommend if you are severely intolerant. I have a sensitivity to lactose myself and sometimes I do get a little extra gassy/bloated from taking these, but not enough to where it disrupts my sleep. These are not effective for all situations but months later I still find them helpful most of the time.

source_doc: Highly recommend! I absolutely recommend this product and this company! I was hesitant to order something like this because I didn't want to spend the money if I could just throw a blanket over my daughter when she was in her stroller. Now that I have it, I'm so glad I finally made the purchase and the price is much more manageable than the stroller company options. This bunting bag is so soft, warm, and cozy. She also added extra holiday stickers that my daughter loves. I really appreciate the attention to customer service and the quality of this product!

source_doc: In The Stars. Sometimes it is hard to know what the reviews are referring to if there are multiple items to purchase. I bought In The Stars which has quickly become a huge favorite of mine. I bought it without smelling it first based on the description. This is not something I normally do but I’m so glad I did. The scent is clean but also sexy. It is light and not overpowering like some can be. I have the lotion so before bed I slather that on and follow with this spray. I feel wonderful and pretty wearing this and I also recommend the lotion that makes my skin feel like velvet. I took one star off because when I spay it on I can smell alcohol but I’m not  really mad about it. After a moment it smells sweet and wonderful. This scent would be good for anyone. It doesn’t smell like old lady or children at all. It blends with my body chemistry and smells natural on me like it was designed just for me! It is a unique and complex fragrance. I’m used to spending 10 times as much for products and honestly I’m throwing a bunch of them out. This is in my top 3 BBW scents and I highly recommend it!

source_doc: Great versatile lamp that gives off plenty of light. I mostly got this lamp because I wanted something we could use when the power goes out. We have high winds where I live and usually a few times a year they end up making the power lines where I live go down. Amazingly enough two days after this light arrived our power went out for about 3 hours. I was so happy I had charged this little lamp and had it to use. It gave off all the light we needed. I even put it at lower light to make it last longer since we had no idea how long the power would be out. The only thing the least bit negative is that it takes a long time for it to fully charge. I set it to charge as soon as I opened it and probably 4 hours later it was still glowing with the red light so I ended up leaving it on for the night. It was fully charged when I got up the next morning but I really don't know just how long it took. So far we have used it for maybe 5 hours all together and it's still going strong. I'm really happy with this light and I'm even thinking of getting another one to keep on hand for the next time we lose power. Definitely recommend this light.

source_doc: Great personal electrical guitar amp. First off, I knew that it was on the small side and I know how small audio amplifier circuits can be made because of my degrees, but I still was not expecting this amp to be this tiny.  If it was not for the battery pack adding on some size, I bet this amp could fit in my guitar case.  But I love how small this is, and yet how loud it can get if needed.  The only reason for 4 stars is I heard a hum on some of the strings as well as some of them are fuzzy, so I am not sure if this is the amp or guitar yet.  I did not hear this with no amp attached obviously.  I found out that electric guitars need to be setup and I don't think this guitar has been setup yet before being used as I was not told about it.  So once that is done, if the sound improves I will increase my rating, if not, well you know what happens then, but I will do my best to find the cause of the hum and fuzz that have been found now.

source_doc: Fashionable Diaper bag. Before I got this diaper bag, I got my self one of those other diaper bags that is abviosly look like a diaper bag. I tried a couple of those and none of them I was not a fan of.First, I didn't realize how heavy they are even with nothing inside. It's even more heavy when I put everything that my baby needs. I also find that they are very bulky and NOT fashionable.So, I got this diaper bag and what I like about this is that is SUPER SUPER LIGHT.Very roomy inside Not a lot of compartment though not like those Bulky diaper bag but I didn't mind that.I don't really need a lot of separate compartment for every single thing.Inside, it has 2 compartment for bottles one for laptop or for changing pad. The changing pad I got on my own as this bag did not come with one.It didn't come with one because the bag it self can be a changing pad but I didn't like that idea due to, I have to take everything out in order to use it as one.Any I really really love this diaper bag it's super light and FASHIONABLE at the same time.

source_doc: This is going to take some practice for all three of us! After getting a second puppy in our life, I wanted the ability to take them both out for walks together and have at least one hand free  When I saw this I thought how fabulous this would be!  It arrived and I hooked the three of us up.  My older puppy is fairly good at leading alone.  The puppy, is even better!  She is a natural heeler!  I thought it would be a breeze!  Yeah, didn't go as I expected.  I quickly felt like I was the monkey in the middle with dogs going every direction and pulling me in the middle!  Then the fun, I stopped to get them under control and they each wrapped around me like some kind of insane doggie butterfly cocoon!  I managed to get control of the beasts, unwind myself and grabbed those broncs by the short handles of those leads!  I proceeded to walk ourselves home to get the regular leashes and I will use the regular leashes on this fanny pack until they get the hang of it better.  I think it was the extra bungie stretch they had that allowed them to go insane!Positive note:  The pack, the leads and all components held up great to the insane dance these dogs put me through!  I like being able to carry their treats with me and the other pouch for potty bags, keys, etc!

I have been eyeing them for a long time before I ended up ordering them, and when I got them I was first a little disappointed because I expected them to be taller, but that is my fault- I should have checked the measurements. They are very light weight so a stronger wind will blow them over especially if they are not anchored, and since I keep them on my deck I can not anchor them. The quality seems pretty good and the light seem to last pretty well. I had them for about 6 months and I am very pleased with them.

source_doc: Cute. Ok, I don’t think I completely “get” ice rollers. Why not just use an ice cube or a cold stone? Why put fruit and things in your ice if the rest of the ice cube is just plain water? I don’t get it.None of this confusion was helped by the lack of instructions. The two molds came nested and I was trying to figure out - do you fill the inside one or the outside one? Do you fill the outside so the inside is like an ice-covered hollow mold?  I had to find the listing to figure out what to do.I like them, as far as I understand them. I still don’t get why this is different from just grabbing an ice cube. But whatever. They’re easy to fill and use. The chick one is really cute and I don’t know why I enjoy that as much as I do. The bigger one seems like overkill and I stilll haven’t figured out if I’m supposed to scrub my face with the ice inside, or use the cover as a scrubbie and then use the ice. Idk. In any case, they seem to do exactly as advertised.

source_doc: Does not fit well - too short. The quality is very nice, but it's not long enough to fit the key fob.  Because it's too short, I had a heck of a time putting the post on the end to keep the cover closed.  I finally got the pin through, but it's at such an angle that I cannot put the metal piece on the back end.  I had to leave the metal piece off and secure the pin with the key chain loop only.  It's a shame because it's a really nice cover.  I have a second one on order that I will end up returning because I suspect that the fit will be off as it is on the first one I received.UPDATE:  I ordered two of these, one of each color.  The review above is for the first one.  The second one was shipped from overseas.  After I received the second one, it turns out that the pin I mentioned above is much longer on the second one and it fits great.  If they had provided the correct pin on the first one, I wouldn't have had to alter it to get it to fit and I would have given them 5 stars.  Because I am stuck with one that has a short pin, I leave my original one star rating for all the time I put into it to make it work.  Apparently, you roll the dice when ordering these.

source_doc: Best deal ever !! I have been playing guitar since the early 1970's.  I ordered this guitar package  for my grand daughter for Christmas but it didn't get here in time so I gave her one of mine, she was very happy with that.  So when this came I carefully unpacked it with the idea that I was going to send it  back.  So I tuned it up and installed an old DeArmond pickup and plugged it in.  It blew my mind,  the sound was great and the action was super fast and easy to play.  I normally play my old 1972 Guild,  I can honestly say this guitar played as easy and sounded as good as the Guild (that was not easy for me to say)  and for this price which included a hard case tuner and strings , it is just an unbelievable deal.  If anything changes I will do an update,  for now I am very happy with this guitar and strongly recommend it.  I would like to know what strings came on the guitar, they appear to be very light but I do not know what brand they are.  (who ever set this guitar up knew what they were doing, the action was perfect)

source_doc: Good quality. At first I thought this mat was such a weird size; however it worked out perfectly for our 84 in x 84 in playpen. I had to buy 4 of them and they all fit. The product is consistent! I have purchased mats before and they weren’t consistent so each set of the mat was slightly different. I really like that there are no edge pieces but because of that I had to buy way more because I only needed a few extra middle pieces and I have bunch of corner/end pieces left. I wish it’s slightly thicker but overall the quality is really good. I ended up spending a similar amount that I would have spent for the house of hoa mats but this mat size fits perfectly for our playpen. I highly recommend this mat! Hope they eventually have different designs and color!

source_doc: Looks and feels great. I thought I'd try these in my old, 2010 Prius after having replaced the original leather with  cheap vinyl seating elements. The vinyl was cheap but professionally installed. It looked ok, but did not wear well. So, I thought I'd give these a try.  Now, I wish I'd known about Karcle before I replaced the original leather.  I'm more than pleased with this product; I actually learned something from the experience.Because my Prius has heated seats, installation was a little more difficult. I went through contortions securing the elastic ties that go beneath the seat and hold the bottom element in place. But if your seats aren't heated and there aren't a lot of electronics under them, you won't have this problem. In any case, after a brief struggle, I got both pieces on. They look great and feel very comfortable.  The material--nappa leather--appears very durable. It's supposed to be washable. Time will tell, but right now, I'm in love with these.  I didn't need to replace the rear seating because nobody every sits there.Update:  after a few weeks driving, I've come to love these seat covers. They look great and feel better than the third rate vinyl that was professionally installed. No, they're not as tightly fit as they vinyl, but they look and feel a lot better.Update: After a few weeks of driving I like these seat covers even more than I did when I first put them on.

source_doc: I keep coming back to this foundation. I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.I dislike spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.
hypos: Я всё время возвращаюсь к этой тональной основе. Я пробовал/а и другие основы за эти годы, но, похоже, всегда возвращаюсь к этой. У меня светлая кожа, и я использую оттенок L1 слоновая кость. Без аромата, не слишком жидкая (мне нравится некоторая степень покрытия для моей неровной кожи и небольших шрамов), но и не слишком густая. Она действительно очень гладко наносится с моим спонжем для макияжа. Легко распределяется вдоль линии волос и хорошо сливается с областью подбородка и шеи. Нет очевидных границ между цветом кожи и макияжем, так что я знаю, что это хороший цвет для меня. Мне нравится функция помпы для удобства нанесения на спонж (я никогда не наношу тональную основу пальцами), но мне не нравится оставлять продукт в бутылке, когда она заканчивается. Обычно я сохраняю "низкую" бутылку, а потом, когда моя следующая бутылка заканчивается, ставлю одну на другую, чтобы, надеясь, она капала в нижнюю бутылку. source_doc: Heavy Duty! This is awesome because it turns your wire rack shelves into solid shelves in seconds.  I hate it when I put something on the shelf and it wiggles it's way off. Or it doesn't stand properly because it doesn't fit across the shelf properly. No more! Now I have shelves that feel like they are solid.My only gripe is that I wish I had done these BEFORE I put stuff on the rack. I had to take everything off. Which was time consuming, BUT no fault of the manufacturer. And truth be told, it was like moving - I got to declutter some stuff that I probably didn't need any more.I'll know for next time. Buy liners BEFORE placing things on rack. If I buy a rack, will order liners before I build it.

source_doc: Great value for a cheap starter kit! This is the first time I've tried to pull dents out of anything but I have seen it done several times. So that being said, I think this is a very cheaply made kit, it's not meant for professionals at all. It is a good beginner-starter kit though. I used it on my clothes dryer where "someone" stepped on the lid and left a large dent. I used up an entire stick of black glue. I had better luck applying glue to the dryer lid first. When I applied it to the puller tab first it would stay stuck on the dryer which made the whole process much harder.  There's no replacement for experience though. The puller contraption itself is easy to use but made of very cheap metal so I'm not sure how long it will last. The glue gun works, but it heats up pretty slow. Cleaning up the glue that didn't come off the metal was a huge pain. Like I said before that can be prevented some by applying the glue to the metal surface first instead of the pull tabs. I did not get the dent completely pulled out but it does look a lot better. I just wanted to try it out on something besides a car first. I didn't need the little pry tools for anything yet, but I do a lot of car projects so I'm sure they will come in handy eventually.

source_doc: Handy multi-device car charger with useful voltmeter. I don't currently have any auto devices that need their own power port so the best thing about this charger for me currently is the voltmeter so I can always know the condition of my battery. I am hoping to get a dash cam soon though so perhaps that will need the extra power port. I like this charger a lot but it fits a bit too snugly in my van's power port, when putting it in and removing it I worry I could damage my van's power port. My first generation Toyota Sienna may have a slightly smaller power port than usual because I had that problem with another charger, I also read about another Toyota RAV4 owner with the same problem. If it weren't for the tight fit I would probably use this as my main charger so I could always know the condition of my battery. Another odd thing, but not a big issue is that since my port is low, when I insert the charger so that I read the port labels right side up, I am forced to see the fine print on what I consider the bottom of the charger, maybe that's a good thing in some situations. I like the soft touch on off switch.

source_doc: They've screwed up! They changed the design and have ruined the cups! I have ordered MULTIPLE sets of these cups over the last 4 years for my grandbabies. I LOVED them!! They were well made,came in fun colors, and are made from recycled material here in the USA. What's not to love?! I recommended them to a dozen people. They loved them too. Well, fast forward to a month ago when my niece bought some from Target. She took them home and tried them out. She told my sister I was crazy for thinking they were so great. Hers leaked. Well, she had bought me 3 the same day...and they leaked too!! Some from the spout, some from the edge of the lid. I took an older one from the cabinet and compared them. Well, the continuous thread has been replaced with these weird tabs which apparently keep the cup from sealing properly. I am so sad such a great product has been ruined. I even tried ordering another set from Amazon in hopes it would be the old style. No such luck. Every single one of them leaked as well. I guess I will just have to guard my old ones with my life and never allow them to leave the house. I once would have told you to buy buy buy...now I say skip them. So disappointing.

source_doc: Choking hazard for some dogs. My Boston terrier loves, loves, loves them. I noticed that many reviewers mentioned that these don't last more than a few seconds when they give them to their dog’s so, I tried to time Phoebe eating them. The first one I gave her, she took about 4 minutes to finish; which I thought was really good but then, the next few she ate quicker at around 2 minutes and it got shorter and shorter from then on. I will say that Phoebe also has those yak hard sticks to chew but now, she really only seems to chew those at night but, anyway, back to this product... One day I gave her one of these sticks as kind of a snack, they are high in calories for a snack but whatever; she must have been really hungry because, I noticed that she was acting like she was having trouble swallowing so, I stuck my fingers down her throat and dislodged almost half of the stick. Phoebe still gets them but now I hold them and she has to take bite size pieces. Phoebe really loves them and I actually do think that they calm an upset stomach so it is worth the grossness of the saliva getting all over my hand; I just wash my hand thoroughly afterwards. :)

source_doc: Check the comb for metal shards! One safety issue that I found concerning was that I found metal shards in-between the combs.  I found 3, removed them, and rinsed and soaked the removable comb piece in soapy hot water before even using it to be safe.This is an extremely cheap alternative to the popular FURminator descending comb, so I wanted to try it out.First thing difference I noticed was that this comb doesn't have the button to push out the hair like the FURminator.  That button you see on top is only to remove the metal de-shedding comb.For $3, this de-shedding comb is a fantastic deal, and does the job of de-shedding your pup like it's supposed to.  I do find it annoying that I have to grab the hair out after a few brushes instead of being able to use a single button to do it, but again for $3 bucks, I can deal.  I follow up with a brush down with my regular brush to catch all of the loose hairs that this tool doesn't pick up.It's a cheap tool, and I'm happy I have it.  I probably will purchase the FURminator again down the line, because I really do miss that button.

source_doc: Amazing mouse! I bought second hand and after a reset it works great! I own 4 mice, 2 cheapos a Corsair harpoon and this dark core. Only going to compare the corsair mice. The harpoon is light and easy to use. The the scroll wheel is very easy to use. I would rate this mouse excellent if I had never used the dark core RGB. The dark core is heavier which I actually like. And it FEELS so smooth I’m guessing that’s due to the 18,000 dpi optical sensor. The RGB IMO is awesome. I have it set to match my monitor or whatever is on display. The scroll wheel on the other hand is stiff. I find my finger sliding on it constantly. I have to adjust the pressure at what I use to move the scroll wheel. On the harpoon it’s effortless.I am using both wings on the dark core and I enjoy resting my fingers on them. It’s a nice feel/grip.Overall I love this mouse and it’s working great for me. Unfortunately I made the mistake and got them on qi charging version but I like it so much I don’t want to return

source_doc: Nice to be able to order the buttons without the entire assembly... I use Straploks on all my basses. I have three straps, and each one has the male portion of the Straplok system. On my main strap, I have four Straplok male connections so that I can achieve the correct playing position for different basses. Each time I purchase a bass, the first thing I do is to change the existing buttons to the Straplok buttons. Until recently, I thought it was necessary to buy the entire assembly, even though all I needed was the buttons. Now it is nice to be able to order just the buttons, but I believe they are priced too high. The entire assembly can be purchased for just $5 more than the buttons alone, which makes no sense, since the male portion of the assembly is much more complex to manufacture compared with the button portion. Still, I would rather pay $5 less and not have too many useless male portions just lying around. I think $5 or so would be a more fair price, not that Dunlop is listening to my advice. lol.
hypos: Приятно иметь возможность заказать кнопки без всей сборки... Я использую Straplok на всех своих басах. У меня три ремня, и у каждого есть мужская часть системы Straplok. All in all, I like these for sleepless nights and they will be my go-to from now on.

source_doc: Just okay... I purchased the JSAUX Stand Base for my Steam Deck and was a little disappointed with the overall quality of the product.  While it is compatible with a variety of devices, including tablets and mobile phones, I found that the stand itself was not as solid as I had hoped.The foldable design and adjustable features are nice, and the anti-slip surface is a plus. However, I found that the stand itself was a bit more flimsy than I was expecting, and I had concerns about it tipping over or not providing enough stability for my Steam Deck during play.  Good if you want to use it for a phone desk holder, but those can be picked up easier and cheaper.While I am a big fan of JSAUX products, I have to say that this stand was not up to the same standard of quality that I am used to. I was hoping for something more solid and sturdy that would provide the necessary support for my device during gaming sessions.Overall, the JSAUX Stand Base for Steam Deck is okay, but I was looking for something more reliable and secure. If you're looking for a basic stand that is compatible with a variety of devices, this one may work for you. However, if you're looking for something more substantial and durable, you may want to consider other options.

source_doc: Maybe I don't love these, but I really really like them. I take that back - maybe I actually do love these. I have about 300 miles now with these and have yet to find a deal-breaker with them.  I hike all types of terrain and haven't had any problems with them.  I never used poles before, but after tripping and falling last year when hiking some really difficult terrain, I thought it prudent to try something for added stability.  These Foxelli's have been great for me.  They remain locked in position for me and I haven't had problems with them sliding out of position, even in very cold and changing temperatures.  I can see how one might break them if they aren't paying attention - especially if using on really rocky trails where the tip can get caught between rocks and jam.  But that’s not the pole’s fault - it’s “operator error".  What I really like is the lower handhold which is sooo useful when going uphill in changing terrain.

source_doc: Not a fan of the built in XLR cable. The boom stand itself works great. It is a good value for the money. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the built in XLR cable it comes with. I am an Electrical Engineer and I tested this cable myself and can see that using a 150 ohm XLR preamp test on my desktop setup, I can see that my whole setup puts out a noise floor of about -100dB, which is extremely good. But it wasn't until I plugged in the XLR cable that my noise floor went up about 20dB. That is a lot for a cable and when I turned my gain up all the way to see if my hypothesis was correct, it was picking up radio interference from a local radio station, but barely could hear it. This means that the shielding on the wire itself has a fault somewhere or the wires themselves aren't balanced and not twisted pair. After I plugged in my own XLR cable that I had from a good source, I immediately saw my noise floor jump back up to -99dB and could hear no interference anymore. Just letting people know, that if you do expect to use this boom stand, make sure you also buy an XLR cable that is good quality. Now, I don't know if maybe I got a faulty cable, but it is something I wanted to warn people about.

source_doc: Hard to open—at first… I do a lot of traveling—and I mean a lot. I ordered this eight compartment pill organizer box in hopes that it would be helpful on my travels. The price is super affordable and I like to make sure I’m always stocked with the basics. I was really disappointed however, to find out that the individual compartments were nearly impossible to open. I struggled with them for several minutes, even breaking a nail before I decided to head to the reviews. Thanks to the angel who mentioned removing the silicone band, I was finally able to get the compartments open. Once they’re open and shut a few times they open much easier. Phew! I wish the compartments were a little larger because they really don’t hold that many pills and I need plenty of room for my overseas travel days. I still think I’ll use this, but probably when I’m traveling not as far.

source_doc: I like it. I’ve used myrrh essential oil in the past, when I made homemade natural skincare. But I’ve never before used it as something to ingest. I tried one of these capsules for the first time about a week ago. I’ve been in rather poor health, and I guess I hoped to discover a natural remedy. The first day I tried these, I took one and stayed attuned to my body to see if I felt different. After a bit, I did feel a subtle sense of relaxation and also some pain relief. A few hours later, I felt, ever so slightly, a sort of blood sugar type of jitteriness and irritation. I waited a day and tried it again, same way: one capsule. This time, I didn’t get any kind of jitteriness or irritation, as if I drank too much coffee. But I did feel mild, gentle pain relief….or, I should say, I felt as though “something” took the edge off of the pain I’ve been experiencing. Since then, I have been taking 1-2 capsules per day. Obviously, I feel that it may be helping me with my health issues or side effects. ..but I don’t know for sure if it’s these capsules of myrrh, psychological, or something else,…yet. I can say that I’ve been taking less aspirin and ibuprofen since using these myrrh capsules.

source_doc: Surprisingly comfy for a good night's sleep! This turned out to be a life saver on a recent camping trip. I was planning on tent camping but during the night the weather turned and I was pummeled by rain & hail. My tent is great in the rain, but I was set up in a low area and the space under the tent quickly turned into a lake and my tent turned into a giant waterbed. Since I had this in the car, I decided to inflate it and see how it worked. It was pretty easy to set up/inflate quickly and it was SO comfortable! I was honestly surprised at how comfortable it was. I'm 5'0 and had to sleep a little curled up, so if you're taller, consider how you like to sleep.The only downside is in my Mazda 3 I had to move the front seats all the way up to fit it, so I can't drive around with it installed. I could probably pull the pieces out of the footwells and angle the mattress a bit to push the seats back to drive, but haven't tried it yet. I do love the versatility this provides! Now I have another option for camping when I don't want to go through the hassle of setting up a tent for just one night.

source_doc: It’s okay. It’s a starter kit, so it will give you what you need for a quick start up. I purchased Quick Start and Stress Coat+ instead of using the conditioner provided with the tank and they worked very well. Within a few hours of adding those in and running the filter, my water was ready.I’m not a fan of the filter at all, it’s loud, creates a strong current, and it doesn’t do the best job of cleaning the water (the sole thing a filter is supposed to do). Based on previous reviews it’s not reliable so within a week of having it I decided to replace it with an inexpensive, but much more reliable, sponge filter that doesn’t create a current. Happy water, happy fish.The lights are decent, though I wish they were dimmable. There are cheap options for dimmable lights with a timer that can be submerged, and I will be using those instead.The instructions for this tank mention a provided heater. There isn’t one provided, which I think is better as I found a heater that reads the water temperature and it’s keeping my betta very happy.Overall, the tank is decent and a huge upgrade from the 2.5 gallon I had before. With the money I spent, I could’ve purchased a bigger tank since I replaced everything else but now I know for the future.

source_doc: perfect for daily powder supplements on vacation. These helped me bring 15 days' worth of powder supplements to make my morning smoothies while on vacation; I poured the powder from these directly into my wide-mouth "ShakeSphere" bottle and added drinking water to shake it up. My powders filled each container right to the brim (approximately 70cc I think, if I did my math correctly from all the various scoop sizes). I didn't like being forced to use the funnel top as the lid on the topmost container; I don't have a baby and I didn't need to use a funnel, so it was wasted space in my already tight luggage - I would have preferred a flat top lid. When closing be sure the pieces are securely tightened with each other, and strangely, when you use too much force, the pieces don't twist apart nicely; after I loosened my grip, then the pieces came apart smoothly. I used these for a 1 week trip to San Diego and now I'm packing them up for a 2-wk trip to Hawaii. I use these weekly at home too, because I love the time savings in the mornings of not needing to measure all the powders out each day (now I do that only once per week).

source_doc: Great lighting, excellent key feel. I had a Nighthawk X8 MAX keyboard I loved. It worked for years. Then the coffee happened. I tried many keyboards and eventually settled on this one. The lighting is bright, the keycaps have large letters and numbers, and most importantly, the keys feel "right". I am also pleased that is is a tenkeyless keyboard that still has print screen, etc. I would like for the caps lock indicator to be brighter, but that is the only complaint I have. I actually have two of these so I am ready when the Nighthawk I have at my office finally dies, or when I inadvertently kill the one I am typing on.

source_doc: Giving it a try. I just started using this. It arrived unsealed and the box damaged in transit, but I was confident by the look and feel of the pump that it hadn't been used. I'm using this as a toothpaste, but I may share it with others who have appliances. I think it is meant to replace toothpaste. It doesn't include fluoride though. One pump generously covers the toothbrush. Although it's mostly air, it does feel like enough product to do the job. The foam has an unpleasant alcohol-menthol taste. I didn't find it that intolerable though, and it dies down over the two minutes. I also think it helps give that clean feeling afterwards. Instructions are to use this 1-2x daily, expecting results in 1-2 weeks. I'm surprised that I think I feel slight achiness after one use, so I'm going to see if I can do once a day for a few days. I'll report if I see whitening. To be fair though, I've been using a lot of whitening products lately and am not sure if I can expect more progress from products. This claims to be up to a 4 month supply which seems improbable, but then again, it does dispense a lot of air. If it lasts nearly that long and works, it's certainly worth $12.99.

source_doc: He likes it just fine. I ordered this to add a little something to our dog’s kibble meals. I’ve used a similar name brand product before.This is powder. Not dry and fly away but a powder. That’s what I wanted when I purchased it but if you’re expecting pieces or chunks you’ll be disappointed. The package is easy to open, easy to pour out, and zips closed.I’m pretty careful about what I give our dog and usually stick to name brand products with lots of reviews. I checked out this company online and they’re based in the US. They have a website which you can order from. I can’t find any retailers other than Amazon. source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes.  It was three times the price of the NbN, but you pretty much get what you pay for.  I got a thick velvet carrying bag with the NbN, but wanted something more protective for a ceramic instrument.  Ended up finding a camera case that was just the right size.  I'm happy, my wrist is happy, so all is well!

source_doc: Learning How To Play at 66! I have loved Gospel Music since I was 18 years old!  I vowed that I would learn to play it at some point in my life. Well that point is here and after looking for the standard organ in Black churches, I decided that I didn’t need a Hammond and Leslie in our house.  After researching dozens of keyboards and reading hundreds of reviews, boom!  Here I am with this keyboard in my house and me practicing scales with proper finger placement!  This is an amazing keyboard. It is amazing how accurate the instruments are and it has organ voices that emulate the Hammond and Leslie, which is the main reason I bought it!  I am so excited about the feel of the keys and the ability for it to run off of AA batteries!!Now that I have no excuse, it is on to the included DVD and booklet and YouTube instructional videos for playing Black Gospel music and finally my next purchase of full size base pedals that plug into it. Yes, I have a headset so that my wife doesn’t need to endure what we endured when our kids were learning instruments. I highly recommend this amazing instrument. Top quality and design and a definite value for the money.

source_doc: The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom that it could eventually rip. I ordered this 2 pack of Tainehs Water Bottle Holders because I figured my bottle would fit inside it based upon the product page's measurements: 7.4" X 3.5", and my boyfriend could use the other bottle holder when we go hiking. The current price of $16 might be a bit high, IMO, but you do get 2 of them.

source_doc: Decent quality at a good price. I am one of those old retired guys that has been building at stuff for, well, since Kennedy got elected.  Anyway, I have so many types of bits it is crazy, but counter-sinks are something I never have enough of.  These are pretty good.  They are not the best you can buy, but they are well worth the money.  The actual bit is ok, but that does not matter a lot to me as I have a substantial number of titanium bits to replace them.  The counter sinks work well in wood and aluminum.  The taper design is something that can work very well, when needed.For the price and the value quality, I feel compelled to give them a 5.Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. In addition, I will try to include multiple images and or videos on each product, if practical.
hypos: Приемлемое качество за хорошую цену. Я один из тех старых пенсионеров, который строит вещи с тех пор, как Кеннеди был избран. В общем, у меня так много типов насадок, что это безумие, но countersinks – это то, чего у меня никогда не хватает. Эти довольно хороши. Они не лучшие, что можно купить, но стоят своих денег. Сам фитиль нормальный, но это для меня не имеет большого значения, так как у меня есть значительное количество титановым бит для их замены. Countersinks хорошо работают в дереве и алюминии. Конусная форма – это то, что может работать очень хорошо, когда это необходимо. За цену и качественную ценность я чувствую себя обязанным дать им 5. Примечание: я являюсь клиентом Amazon почти 20 лет. Я пишу все свои отзывы, чтобы отразить свои личные наблюдения и мнения о продукте. Не имеет значения, купил ли я товар сам или он был предоставлен мне для рецензии. source_doc: I have owned 7 house bunnies in a row!!! In about thirty years I have owned 7 bunnies, all who have lived inside and been treated very special.  Sometimes I have owned two at once, but in those thirty years never gone without at least one.  Obviously I am doing something right since several of mine have lived to be about 12-13 years old.  So in say that, I highly recommend this grass mat that I use inside their huge open door cage where I also have pet fur mats on the floor along with one of these mats where I sit there bowl of TIMOTHY pellets.  I notice that the bunny I have now will ignore it for awhile and then one day just start shredding it to pieces, so I make sure to keep buying them for her since she really doesn't play with any rabbit toys I buy her.  Except for loving empty toilet paper rolls this is her fav fun project!  I always make sure anything I give my bunnies is safe and healthy (note, always use timothy pellets, give them just the tiniest bit of fruit, no other carbs and tons of green vegies daily).  Rabbits love to eat but anything sugar or sweet will mess up their stomachs real easily...but back to this product, it is a big yes and I will continue buying them when needed.
hypos: У меня было 7 домашних кроликов подряд!!! За около тридцати лет у меня было 7 кроликов, все они жили внутри и к ним относились очень особенным образом. Иногда у меня было двое сразу, но за эти тридцать лет я никогда не оставался/лась без как минимум одного. Очевидно, я что-то делаю правильно, поскольку несколько из них дожили до 12-13 лет. Так что на это скажу, я настоятельно рекомендую этот травяной мат, который я использую внутри их огромной клетки с открытой дверцей, где у меня также есть коврики из меха домашних животных на полу вместе с одним из этих матов, где я ставлю миску с гранулами ТИМОФЕЯ. Я замечаю, что кролик, который у меня сейчас есть, игнорирует его какое-то время, а потом в один прекрасный день просто начинает разрывать его на куски, поэтому я всегда покупаю их для нее, поскольку она действительно не играет ни с какими игрушками для кроликов, которые я ей покупаю. За исключением любимых пустых рулонов от туалетной бумаги, это ее любимый проект! Я всегда следил/а за тем, чтобы всё, что я даю своим кроликам, было безопасным и полезным (учтите, всегда используйте гранулы тимофея, давайте им всего лишь чуть-чуть фруктов, никаких других углеводов и много зелёных овощей ежедневно). Кролики любят есть, но любые сладости или сахар очень легко портят им желудки... но вернёмся к этому продукту, я однозначно его рекомендую и буду продолжать покупать их по мере необходимости.

source_doc: Bought 3. 1 worked. 1 won't turn on. 1 wouldn't even charge my phone and won't recharge. Seriously. I was pretty excited to find something my wife and kids could just carry in their car that would jump start it in an emergency. So I bought 3 of them. When I got them I pulled them all out of their boxes and checked the charge. The first one was 3 of 5 bars so I plugged it into a usb charger overnight. Next day I tested it out on my RV with a V10 Ford engine that had a very weak battery and it cranked like the battery was new and started right up. Still at 5 of 5 bars.I checked the second one and it was at 5 of 5 bars. I plugged my phone into it and it took my phone to 65% over about 3 hours, and then it was at 1 of 5 bars. I plugged it into the same USB charger I had the other one in and came back a few hours later and it was still at 1 bar. I let it charge overnight and it's still at 1 bar. Flashlight won't turn on and won't start anything.I checked the third one and nothing. No bars of 5. Flashlight won't come on. I plugged it into the charger for a few hours and nothing. No bars, no flashlight.

source_doc: Lasted longer than I thought. I teach a sport that requires me to pack food for 14 hour days on the weekend. I try to pack as lightly as possible because everything has to be transported with my on a bus and then into schools, it's a whole thing. Since I'm on a special diet I bring all my food for the day but I try to fit it all in one lunch bag. That was not really possible with those hard plastic ice packs that I would typically use. However, with these, they don't take up as much space and they still lasted me at least 8-10 hours and still felt cold.Do I think these will work well for more than 8-10 hrs? I don't think so. But if you are using these for school lunches I think they would do the trick. Because of their size they don't take up a lot of room so I was able to use both of them to make sure I could be near more than one item in the bag.I'll keep trying these each weekend and see if I can narrow down exactly how long they last but if they're well frozen and in a decent lunch bag you should be good to go.Also, I love the color of these. :-)

source_doc: Super impressed, I love this bra! I love this bra way more than I originally thought I would. Unfortunately I don’t have a portable breast pump so I’m stuck to a machine every 3 hours and was extremely uncomfortable balancing the cups and not being able to do anything else. The flanges fit perfectly into the bra and stay put while I pump so I can be on my phone and do other things while I pump. As per other reviews I ordered a size smaller (usually a large I’m a 34DDD) and I got a medium and it fits perfectly snug where I feel like I have a great amount of support. Bra is also really soft compared to another nursing bra I have. All in all I would definitely repurchase!
