source_doc: Wish the Structural Part was Better Designed. I so want to love this bag for cloth diapers. It does very well with keeping the smell contained, looks nice, and I love the zipper bottom and how it fits with a hanger. However, the plastic pieces that provide the structure push themselves through the fabric during the washing process. I have mended it multiple times and they keep finding ways to push through...and the main one is difficult to put back in. The last time it happened, I decided I was done fixing it and got a different bag. The fabric near the ends of these plastic pieces needs to be reinforced. My other issue is that after washing once I left it in the washer a little too long and after going through the dryer on highest heat there were little spots that I guess I assumed were mold spots. I immediately washed again and made sure to move to dryer right away and they seemed to be gone. But they have come back over and over. I'm not sure how to dry hanging and keep these spots from developing, and the dryer makes the plastic pieces push through the fabric worse. If this bag was redesigned with reinforcements, I would consider purchasing again because I do like it apart from the two issues I talked about.

source_doc: Fizzy bath tablets. I had previously tried a Monster Bubble product by the same brand, in spicy citrus, that I really love, so I was excited to try this assortment pack. What I realized is that the Monster Bubble is the same bath tablet, but in a larger size. And I realized that I actually prefer the larger tablet, as there is more scent and bath ingredients (I’m a huge believer in using Epsom salts and other minerals in the bath, and I love going to the hot springs for the same reason, so I’m a fan of products that add minerals to my bath). However, though I didn’t find the scents to be offensive, I didn’t love them as much as I loved the spicy citrus scent that I had originally tried. Overall I still enjoy using these bath tablets. I have come to really enjoy the pop of color in my bath, as well as the fragrance. The color doesn’t stain my tub but does kind of lift my spirits. I never realized that I would enjoy color in my bath, until I started using these tablets. I definitely prefer the larger sized Monster Bubbles, but overall still really enjoy the regular sized assorted tablets in this set.

I still like the others a lot and will use all the products I bought, but I took another leap of faith and ordered some of this discontinued scent from the description and adorable packaging. I LOVE this stuff and stocked up like a maniac because I know when it’s gone, it’s gone. The scent is fruity without being childish, floral without being cloying. The vanilla and amber make it perfect. I swear I could eat it. I love these products and they came on time and packed well.

source_doc: Great idea. Does not work well. I love the idea of this device. I'm always looking for ways to do nordic curls and Spanish squats. I don't like using a strap for sit ups as I think it's too much of a crutch. However, I was excited about using this strap for nordic curls and Spanish squats. This does not execute at all. First off I am a small woman with size 6 feet and I feel like for nordic curls you need to have bigger (longer) feet to even remotely make this work on the shortest length. This did not work for me at all. It worked only slightly better for my very tall husband with huge feet but not even very well for him. As for the Spanish squat this is where the device works the best. I tried it for sit ups and it was impossible again due to my small stature. Didn't work great for my large husband either. I really wanted to like this but the design is not right. I followed the directions and I am a personal trainer so I thought I might be able to figure out an alternate way to make it work but I did not. On the plus side, the device does seem fairly well built. The foam of the pads is a little soft and dented on first use. The buckle and straps appear quality and secure.

source_doc: It’s all about THAT Bass. I recently purchased a Fender Aerodyne Jazz bass.  This particular bass has no fret markers on the fingerboard, which makes for a nice, clean look.  I normally don’t pay any attention to the markers on the fingerboard, so no problem.  Here’s the problem.  I’m visually impaired and I DO rely on the markers that are in the neck of the bass.  The Aerodyne came with tiny , white dots that I couldn’t see while playing.I tried 1/8” inch dots, but they were too small.  I then ordered these 1/4” dots and they are perfect.  They were easy to apply, and seem to stay adheres pretty well to the neck.  Even if I have to replace them regularly, it’s worth it.  I was about ready to return the bass, not because I didn’t like it, but because it was too difficult to play well.  These simple dots saved the day for me as I love this bass!  See picture for details.  No jokes about them not being straight cuz I already told you I can’t see lol.
hypos: Всё дело в этом басе. Я недавно купил/а бас-гитару Fender Aerodyne Jazz. Этот конкретный бас не имеет меток ладов на грифе, что создаёт приятный, аккуратный вид. Обычно я не обращаю внимания на метки на грифе, так что проблем нет. Вот в чём проблема. У меня нарушения зрения, и я полагаюсь на метки, которые находятся на грифе баса. Aerodyne пришёл с крошечными белыми точками, которые я не могу видеть во время игры. Я попробовал/а точки диаметром 1/8 дюйма, но они были слишком маленькими. Затем я заказал/а эти точки диаметром 1/4 дюйма, и они идеальны. Их было легко наклеить, и, похоже, они хорошо держатся на грифе. Даже если мне придётся регулярно их заменять, это того стоит. Я был/а готов/а вернуть бас, не потому что он мне не нравился, а потому что играть на нём было слишком сложно. Эти простые точки спасли меня, так как я люблю этот бас! source_doc: Great for any wide mouth water storage jug. Since we had my daughter and the ridiculous amount of distilled water we used for her I bought a home water distiller so I didn't have to go to the store all the time to get distilled water.  The only problem was I was only able to do a gallon every three hours and when I was just using it for the kid that was fine but since we have hard water I've started using it for my humidifiers, coffee, tea, basically anything that water quality matters on so I needed to find a way to store it.  I got a couple of empty jugs and an electric pump to get the water out with, the only problem is sometimes I need to charge the pump and I don't want to leave the water open to our air which is why I got these.  They fit on both of my 5-gallon and 3-gallon just fine and keep the air out while I do whatever I need to do.  I don't have any gripes about these and they work as expected.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

source_doc: Best value for the price. I like the Old Mother Hubbard minis.  They're the perfect size for rewarding my dogs (I have large dogs).  I appreciate that the ingredients are better than many of the comparable treats, such as Milk Bones, and yet the price is more reasonable than brands like Blue.  My dogs are eager to be treated with them, so they must taste good.  As I stated, I have large dogs, so we do go through them somewhat quickly.  For this reason, I buy the 6lb boxes.  I get more for the cost.  I do feel like these could be better packaged.  The box isn't tightly sealed, just taped along the middle.  The biscuits are in a large plastic bag inside the box which isn't sealed either.  I do worry that these could easily be contaminated by their surrounding environment.  It would not be difficult for a mouse to crawl under the flap of the box and get inside the bag of biscuits.  Definitely something I think the manufacturer should consider.  When I get mine, I fill the treat jar and then store the remaining in the deep freezer until I need them.  (My German Shepherd is allergic to storage mites, so this helps me negate that issue.)

I'm not really sure if maybe I'm not supposed to feel any difference & I'm just supposed to wait & hope that I see it in the longevity, I don't know but I don't think that I would actually recommend this since I can't actually feel any difference.

source_doc: What a relief! I didn’t know that such a device existed, however, I will now share my new discovery with friends! For many years I found myself constantly readjusting my seatbelt while driving. I added a pad to the belt hoping it would project my neck from the rubbing seatbelt. It only reduced my discomfort slightly.This product appeared as I was looking for something to help me install a dog booster seat in my car. It was a spontaneous purchase. While I’ve only used the device for two days, I am pleasantly surprised by the comfort it provides. The seatbelt now feels like a good, personalized fit for me and my atypical body.I marked down the “ease of use” because I am still trying to figure out how to keep the device on the seatbelt when I leave the car. The belt doesn’t fully retract when I leave the device on the belt. My hunch is that I need to develop a new habit of consciously tucking the belt beside the seat as I’m leaving the car so I don’t shut the door on the belt.My biggest regret is that I didn’t discover this device years ago when I was doing more cross-country road trips!

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.

source_doc: Headache relief!! Sometimes I need 2-3 ice packs for my head when I have a bad headache. I usually use the eye mask kind but stretch it across my forehead, but then I can't get relief across the top of my head when I have tension headaches. I just tossed this pack into the freezer. I forgot about it and expected a block of ice, but wow. This head wrap was still soft and pliable, not frozen at all. It was cold like it was frozen though! I slipped the wrap over my head and immediately realized this product is way better than everything I used before. I can get relief in all areas of my head and eyes, unlike all of my other packs. The material is soft and silky like a fancy eye mask. I will be ordering more to switch out since I usually need more than one pack. I'm really relieved to have found a great product to help me deal with my tension headaches.

source_doc: This stuff is amazing. So, I buy the 8 oz concentrate. I like that I can vary the amount that I use. This stuff is magic. I have two puppies that like to step in poop and then run around the house leaving poo prints everywhere. Also, the mat I keep by the balcony doors can obviously get a bit dirty. If I can’t see something, I use a black light. It’s crazy how you watch spots instantly disappear under the light. I let it sit for a bit and then blot. I also use it for the balcony pee pee pad right after they go. Literally zero foul smells. Also, the hand towels I use to soak everything up used to smell so gross in the wash as I was waiting to fill up the machine. Now that I use this instead of other cleaners, the wash smells nice and I don’t get grossed out walking by it lol. I have used it on carpet, different fabrics, my furniture, and toys. It has done a wonderful job on everything. It’s expensive, I will say that. But I’ll be a lifetime user of this stuff. Oh, and the smell is amazing! I love how authenticity orangey it smells :)
hypos: Это средство потрясающее. Я покупаю концентрат в 8 унциях. Мне нравится, что я могу варьировать количество, которое использую. Это средство волшебное. У меня есть две щенки, которые любят наступать на фекалии, а затем бегать по дому, оставляя какашечные следы повсюду. Также мат, который я держу у дверей балкона, может, очевидно, немного загрязниться. Если я не вижу что-то, я использую черный свет. Сумасшедшее, как пятна мгновенно исчезают под светом. source_doc: Doesn't irritate. I bought another brand of these, and they were just awful.  The velcro attached between the toes and it always scratched and was very uncomfortable.  I threw them away.  So I was on the hunt for something different and so I bought these.  The velcro on these don't attach between the toes.  It attaches on the outside so no more scratching and irritation between the toes.  So far these have worked really well.  I only have one foot with a bunion, so I wish I could have gotten 2 left ones.  I have no use for the one for the right foot.  I wish they were a tad bit smaller.  I only wear this at night.  It would not be comfortable with shoes.  I would buy these again.

source_doc: SHORT style great for people 5’9” or taller DID NOT SWIVEL & WOBBLY. Preface: I am female…weigh more than I care to say…(229lbs)…and I am 5’7”. I purchased this for guitar practice as I have read many, many people have. So let’s cut to the chase……Maybe I received a dud…who knows. I do know that 1) it was wobbly with no means of adjusting it. Well…I guess I could put a matchbook under one of the legs to level it out…you know, like in the old days! 2) Maybe my definition of “swivel” is different than most…seat barely even moved when I wasn’t even sitting on it and had to strong arm it. 3) I researched like crazy to find the “perfect” stool. I read several reviews that stated it’s good for people 5’7”….. um…nope. I couldn’t put a foot on the floor without sitting so close to the front that it was quite uncomfortable on my woman parts. Again…I might have received a defective item. I have learned through all my research that roc-n-soc is extremely well made and very popular. I just purchased the r-n-s nitro drum throne so I’ll let ya’ll know how that one is. I’m super stoked!

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Absolutely Beautiful!! As an avid, long time bass fisherman, I am quite used to paying, what my wife considers to be, big money for a good reel.  I use only bait casters for my bass fishing and relegate spin casters for light stuff like crappie and brim.I really didn't expect too much considering the price of the reel.When I took it out of the box and unwrapped it, my chin dropped to my chest.  This reel is beautiful.Once I got past my initial surprise, I started to inspect it closely for the features that I would pay big bucks for.  I found all the features of my more expensive reels and more.  I would normally change out the crank handles for the ones with soft, grippable rubber handles.  This reel already had those.  I got the owners manual and read it from cover to cover and found it to be the most comprehensive and instructive manual I have ever seen.  It explained every single thing about the reel in very understandable English.I have yet to fish this reel, but if it works as good as it looks, I won't be dissatisfied in the least.I highly recommend this reel to serious fishermen everywhere.  I am considering buying another for my flipping rod.

source_doc: I used these to protect my chicken runs. These are great!  I actually bought several after the first one impressed us.  Last year, my first year with chickens, I got expensive, opaque, heavy plastic and put around the runs (I have 4).  It did the trick, no issues there, but I had to staple it on.  Taking it off was tedious since I wanted to save it, given the price.  I saw these and ordered one to see how we liked it.  The rivets meant we could screw it into the wood (or use cable ties on the wire runs), making removal and reuse next year much easier.  The little "block" design allows more light inside the runs, which is great because the chickens do need light to stay healthy.  It's a toss up - light vs. keeping wind and elements down so they don't freeze.  I feel like this does a good job at both.  The tricky part came when I had to use them side by side because, while the screws were fine, the cable ties left a gap. I fixed that by using Gorilla tape, which sticks well in inclement weather.  Overall, very happy to have found these and I got them at a good price, which is awesome since my pet chickens cost more than any other animal I've ever had in my life!  They're spoiled, but I wouldn't have it any other way.

source_doc: great stabilizers and super pretty!!! OMG! I LOVE these rings! I purchased a set of 6"-12" crystal bowls from Amazon. I really enjoy them, as does my kitty Olivia who regularly totally blisses out listening to them! (The root chakra bowl is her favorite, in case your interested!) The only problem was that the tiniest bowl, the crown chakra bowl, was seriously unstable. I found it super difficult and frustrating to play. The problem may well have been that I have the bowls on carpet. I don't know, although I did try setting it on a stone coaster. (Desperate, I know!)  But it got frustrating enough that I eventually replaced it with an 8" bowl. I needn't have bothered! The new ring perfectly, absolutely, 100% stablizes the bowl, perhaps because it raises it above the caarpet. I don't know! I DO know that these rings are much thicker and actually  hug the bowl. Also, unlike the rubber rings which seem to come in only 2 sizes,  these are individually sized to fit each bowl. The bowls aslo seem to sound better. The carpet issue again?? They are also color coordinated to each bowl and are readily visible, so they are super pretty, I mean, really pretty! I am thrilled with this purchase.

source_doc: Solid basic arm. Honest review! Bought this because i wanted a basic simple arm for my mic. Easy to install and works as advertised. It is a little clunky and the motion is very meh. But for what i paid for it… Come on. I don’t get any metal ringing through recordings if i hit the stand slightly like in some others i’ve had. The medium sized one was perfect for what i needed. The large would have probably been returned. If i had to pick out one thing i love and hate? I LOVE the base that goes to the desk. Very solid and makes me feel confident in it. The thing i HATE? This arm would be 10/10 if they made a simple design change on the mic holder. I want it to be able to turn full radius. Up, down, left, right, ect. It’s a little limited. Up and down only. Now I KNOW i can buy a separate piece to make that happen and it is probably designed for that. But it would be a game changer if it just DID THIS TO BEGIN WITH. 4/5 stars good

source_doc: Hard to press keys. source_doc: disappointed! I just gotten an 8-month-old English Cream Golden retriever and she was not responding to the training that my trainer is help me with, so we talked about a shock collar. I read reviews and decided on this one and was thinking this will help me with my ECGR behavior problems. Well came and I followed the instructions, and it just wouldn't pare up the remote would not charge. So, I did a return and not a replacement. I mailed it out the very next day and went to a shop in my town and purchase a more costly shock collar something I didn't want to do because I would only be using the collar for a short time, but I needed one to start our training and couldn't wait on a replacement and then it not work. Then I checked my emails and seen I received an email from Amazon on a replacement for the shock collar. I recommend if you are thinking about purchasing a shock collar don't pick a cheap one, because they will only last 6 months dispending on brand.

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

source_doc: Finally, the perfect heating blanket! I've been looking for a heating blanket for my bed, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a last go.I am very happy I did. Only setting number medium  on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if it’s on high. . Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

source_doc: Very disappointed, and had to return. As someone with MCS - multiple chemical sensitivity- any fragrance can make me extremely ill. Someone can walk past me wearing perfume or fabric softener or lotion, and I can become so ill. I will have to be in bed for two or three days. People don’t realize how toxic things are, or are to others around them. Therefore I use products that are natural and clean and pure as far as fragrance goes and have always had good luck with Mrs. Myers products. So I purchased these bottles of hand soap. However, I had a reaction to this fragrance. This does not smell natural. It smells more chemical I used it for about three days in a row to be sure that it truly was this product. I was reacting to, and without a doubt, even after using it, and with the fragrance lingering in the air, I could not enter the room.  Therefore I will no longer use Mrs. Myers products as I cannot trust the source of their fragrance. I do not react to natural essential oils so if the source is truly a natural fragrance, I’m usually good, but not with anything that is chemical. This fragrance does not smell at all natural and smells more chemically derived. I absolutely cannot recommend this product .

О, и ремень, который можно надеть на ручку чемодана и который фиксируется на липучку, когда не используется. Я уверена/уверен, что её также можно использовать как дорожную сумку на выходные или для спортзала. Я ещё не использовала/использовал все карманы. Мне очень нравится ключница в одном из больших карманов сверху. Два меньших кармана на молнии идеально подходят для телефона. Мой большой iPad Pro помещается во внешний карман. Сумка идет в комплекте с пеленальным ковриком, на котором сидит моя кошка, и милой тканевой салфеткой, которой я очищаю экран. Представляю, что они отлично подойдут для использования в сумке для подгузников.

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.

source_doc: Love it! I honestly don’t know why I haven’t tried a silicone insert for my air fryer sooner! Washing the air fryer basket is a nightmare and I can never seem to get it a clean as I would like. If I had been using one of these wonderful inventions a long time ago, I would not have had this problem. I absolutely love this set! They fit my Ninja air fryer basket perfectly and clean so easily. Removing the silicone insert from my air fryer is easy as I just take a pair of tongs and pull it right out. Since these are collapsible, storing them is a breeze when not in use. I can hand wash these or run them through the dishwasher. I haven't used them other than in the air fryer, but I can certainly see many other uses as they can withstand heat up to 450°. The only time I probably would not use these is the air fryer is if I am cooking bacon since I want the bacon to drain and not sit in its grease unless it's just one or two slices. These will certainly last a very long time and I don’t see that I will ever need to replace them. Since they come as a set of two, I will always have one handy!  Great quality!

source_doc: An honest review. I initially really like these lights. Three come in a set, so I put two in the kitchen and one in the living room closet. I purchased these on January 5th and as of today March the 18th, one light is not working. The particular light I am referencing, seem to need to be charged faster than the other two lights. I thought maybe I had the brightness set too high and I charged it and placed it in the living room closet where it only needed to turn on when the doors open which isn't often. I also made sure for the directions, that I had the right setting. Went to charge it the light was red and when the light was green I tried to turn it on and it did not turn on. Overall, I would purchase these again.

source_doc: Excellent nest holder but no instructions; Khaki color looks like a pasta nest. First of all this Khaki colored nest looks like some sort of edible pasta that has to be cooked. It comes with absolutely no instructions either when received or online. I almost was going to throw this out. However, after manhandling it for a few minutes, I had to strongly pull it apart. Once I opened it like an accordion, I understood how to use this.I have short to medium fine curly hair and I was able to roll my hair up in a  bun and then close this over the bun while holding my hair with the other hand. This then formed a nest. I tried unsuccessfully to take photos of it in my hair, so I only got a photo of one side. However, it holds exceptionally well because it is very strong.If using this with a ponytail, I recommend holding the ponytail with an elastic first and then pulling it through and clamping this over the hair. This is both unique and a wonderful hair implement. I do not love the khaki color, but I love the design. It also appears to be well-made. I would have rated this 5 stars had it come with instructions.The current price of $4.99 appears to be competitively priced for such a unique design and strong holding hair nest.

source_doc: Really happy with these pump dispensers. I wanted some nice soap dispensers for my sinks because I got tired of the expense of buying the much more expensive individual soaps I have gotten for several years. I saw these and I really liked the simple look of them. I like that they are actually glass and not plastic. They came with a silicone funnel which I really didn't need since they have a large enough opening to easily fill with the large soap refill I got. The pump works really well and I am completely happy with this set of two. The labels that come with them are really pretty but I chose not to use them so I appreciate that you can use them or not. I wouldn't want ones that came with labels already attached. I can easily recommend these.

source_doc: Cable works great, Operator is clueless. A few decades ago I was a techie and computer programmer. I found information on line on how to connect and started the process.  I found the required software, App in today's vocabulary, and loaded  it on my laptop. I think I need to find a seven year old to teach me or find the Youtube that I haven't found yet.

source_doc: It IS lower tracking and lower dust than the other bags, but I'm not sure I'll continue buying it. The litter is made into much larger granules; this is why it tracks less and has less dust. At first, I was not impressed. I was not expecting this kind of dramatic change, so it threw me off guard. However, I gave it a chance, and I like it okay. My cats are fine with it, and it does do what it says it will do. I like that it tracks less; however, I still need to sweep every day because I like my floors litter-free. And I like that it has less dust, but it still has some dust.The only problems with this litter are:- I can imagine it might hurt my cats feet a little more, kind of like walking on gravel instead of sand, but maybe that's not the case (I haven't asked my cats how it feels).- The litter scoops I have don't sift it very well because the slots are a little too small for these large particles.- The clumping ability is still pretty great, but I think it clumps just a little bit less well than the other bags.This is still a 5-star cat litter, but, for me, I think I'm going to switch back to the other bags. It's worth trying, for sure, and it may be better for you depending on your situation.

source_doc: So Easy. You just put the clips on them and they are ready to learn. I have a liftmaster + security. I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.
hypos: Так просто. Вы просто ставите зажимы на них, и они готовы учиться. У меня есть LiftMaster + система безопасности. Я посмотрел на открыватель гаражной двери на свисающий провод, снял крышку лампы и увидел красную кнопку. Это моя кнопка обучения. Я долго нажимал на II и III, пока светодиод не загорелся, потом мигнул немного и погас. Поскольку моя кнопка обучения была красной, я нажал на кнопку I 3 раза. Затем нажал на одну из других кнопок (II или III). Затем я нажал на красную кнопку обучения на открывателе гаражной двери и немедленно нажал на кнопку I на новом пульте. Я услышал 2 щелчка. Моя лампочка перегорела, иначе, вероятно, она тоже мигнула бы 2 раза. После этого я нажал на кнопку I на пульте, и дверь открылась. Затем я нажал её снова, и дверь закрылась. Очень просто для меня. Если то, что я сказал, не ясно, обратитесь к инструкциям, которые находятся в коробке. Кроме того, ваша кнопка обучения может отличаться. Недорогой способ получить дополнительные пульты или заменить сломанные.

source_doc: Perfect exercycle for me! I love this little stationary bike! And the price point is incredibly reasonable!! It's sleek, compact, cute, sturdy and tucks into a corner of my living room. It's SO quiet!! I can't believe it! I can listen to music, TV, read or watch Youtube while riding. My last recumbent bike made lots of noise, so I couldn't cycle if anyone else was around. I love the simple display that gives me all the parameters I need, including pulse - which at my age, is a good idea to watch when exercising. I target my heart rate. I had to have my husband put it together for me because of the few electronic parts. I didn't want to mess it up. I suppose if I HAD to have done it myself, I'd have eventually gotten through it. It really wasn't that hard to do, my husband said. All the parts were clearly labeled, well packed (in spite of the box arriving opened and smashed). Nothing was broken or smashed. Instructions were clear. Seat is comfy. I LOVE IT!! I'd buy it again in a heart beat! :)

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

source_doc: DIY, Save the mony. The detailer's wanted $1300. I watched 15 different YouTube Videos then decided on Adams. I do have a Quick Jack which made it a bit easier with the car lifted. It was easier than I thought ( I did do my homework). I took my time, started in a less noticeable spot and off to the races. I did have another advantage the car was freshly painted, I waited 3 weeks for the paint to gas off and I was done in 4 hours. It is a Miata MX5 a bit smaller than most cars. I left it in the garage for 24 hours before driving it. The first wash left beads of water and I dried the car with a 550 CFM leaf blower. Didn't even need a towel. I save me some big bucks and felt really good doing it myself.

source_doc: Fender Mexico Surprised Me. I have another Mexican Starr I bought many years ago but this is a huge step up in quality. It seems many higher end manufacturers are moving some of their production to Mexico which I think is driving competition. I bought this as used but in very good condition. Very pleased. I had bought the same guitar from Musicians Friend which they sold as a New instrument which was returned. That one was abused so I returned it and was happily surprised when Amazon had one left. The finish is great and I find no faults in quality so far. I also have several American made Strats which surprised me that Fender had an anniversary model made in Mexico but don’t let that fool you. The only big difference I find is this doesn’t have the nitrocellulose finish. I wish they had shipped it in a hard case but I’ll get one for it anyway. The gig bag is their better one but I prefer to protect my favored guitars. Overall I’d say this was a great purchase!

source_doc: After a year of trying, I'm over it. I was gifted the Gaming Mouse during the December 2021/ January 2022 holiday season. This item was purchased via Amazon.The mouse started randomly dying and coming back. By that I mean my PC would say it had disconnected, the mouse LEDs would turn off and it the mouse would not respond. Upon research and inspection, it appears that the power cord connection is faulty.There is no stress to the cord, there are no pets or children around to have damaged it. I emailed the seller on Friday, Apr 8, 2022 to inform them of the issue. At that time, I had not had the mouse long enough to consider this routine wear and tear. I love the size and shape of the mouse so I would much rather get a replacement than simply returning it. I received not response. I rigged the mouse together and just focused on controller gaming. It is now January 2023. I loved how big the mouse was so I really tried to like it but its stupid to try and make this work. Please do not buy it. "Lizsword" has a way better mouse. Equally affordable and lasts way longer. My husband has had that brand for years so I should have started with that one.

source_doc: Not a clear wipe. I guess I am old, but I remember replacing wiper blades quickly and easily. I have a 2014 Pathfinder and somehow the driver wiper (26") cracked. Still worked fine, but I noticed a slight scratch in the glass. I had a 17" replacement for the passenger side a few weeks ago. I thought I bought the same. Duh. That one is great(Rain-X 5079283-2 Latitude 2-IN-1 Water Repellency Wiper Blade, 17") put on by mech at last oil change. This one hat two other adapters, and I finally removed the one on it as I had the old hook style. Slid on easily, but the cover at the end would not snap shut. I redid it three times. Anywho. at the center of the blade under the connection there is water that is not cleared, and when it hits the water on the right ( next to the rear view mirror) pushed by the passenger blade it hardly wipes it. I am about ready to reorder another like the 17" and keep this for emergencies.

source_doc: I use the conceal and perfect foundation and.. So I wanted to love this. I was like "ooh yay, a peach colored product for my eye bags". I wear NC25 in MAC.This was far too sheer. The applicator is ok but you're going to want to use a brush to pinpoint areas if that's what you're looking to do. Look.. I know hollows can't be fixed unless I get a bleph or filler. I don't have the money or sucrose father for that yet. So color corrector and concealers are the best I have. But this might be best for someone with very mild darkness and doesn't need a lot of makeup.

source_doc: It has built in gloves and I feel so cute. After three years of pandemic and quarantine and wfh, which also included a pregnancy, I had very few pieces of clothing left that fit and suddenly I was being forced back into the office. It's January and cold, so I decided to treat myself to a cute new winter coat to help with the transition back.This coat is everything.It is cozy and warm without making me overheat and it doesn't feel heavy. The sleeves have built in fingerless gloves which I love because I always forget my gloves. The pockets are deep but they don't bulge when full. I can easily fit a 20oz waterbottle in the pocket and hardly notice it is there.Literally the only downside I've experienced is that I can't get to my smart watch because of the gloves, but I'm sure if I really wanted to I'd be able to.This coat made me feel cute for the first time in three years and I am so glad I got it.

source_doc: Wow just wow. I bought a Grote 335 style guitar a few years ago and am extremely happy with its quality and performance. Because of its price, I thought it might be a fluke. Last week I decided to buy the LP Grote. This guitar arrived in less than a week. I picked the purple tone. I don’t care that it’s a printed front. It’s stunningly beautiful. I am a guitar tech and luthier but I haven’t done a set up to either Grote’s I own and they sound decent right out of the box. That being said, if you are hitting the road or doing studio work I would recommend doing a pro set up on these guitars. I love the amplified sound of the 335 style Grote I own so I expected the same when I tested the new one. when I plugged in the LP I was blown away at the warmest sound I’ve heard in years. No pedals or effects, just amp. This 199.99 guitar was boasting a 1000.00 sound. I would recommend any guitarist who doesn’t have a large budget to look at Grote. If you have a large budget, still look at Grote and spend the rest of a great amp.

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing.  I just tightened the screw on the light bulb gripper onto the mop pole and it worked.  I haven't tried any of the other grippers but am looking forward to seeing if it will work on the flood light bulb outside.

source_doc: Good support for every day activities. I received this item quickly. I bought these due to laxity and history of sprains in both of my ankles.  I wanted something that I could wear if on my feet for extended periods of time that wasn’t as restrictive as a brace.  I wouldn’t recommend these if playing sports or doing an activity where a lot of support is needed.I find the material comfortable and great quality, while being reasonably priced.  I ordered a small, which is the size I usually wear.  I found them true to size.  They are not easy to get off, but I wouldn’t expect them to be, given they are made for compression.  I have washed them on the delicate cycle in my washer machine and line dry them and they have held up very well.  I would recommend these for anyone looking for ankle support for every day activities.

source_doc: Had for 10 months, ghosting bad. I've never experienced ghosting keys, but I bought two of these as I have 2 computers in my office that I use often. These are not cheap keyboards so I expected it to be better but the touch sensitivity of the keys is too much, multiple rr's (see what I did there? :D)  show up as well as other letters. I type a lot of for both of my jobs that I use these computers for. I previously had mechanical keyboards but they wore out some keys so rather than buy another one I tried this because I wanted something wireless for keeping a tidier desk so I felt like this was a good balance of wireless with responsive keys but am starting to consider what my next option will be.

source_doc: Dressing up the stairway. I had been looking for ideas to dress up the risers on the stairs going to my second floor and was thinking stencils, or different paint, when I came across YouTube videos where diy shows were using this type of dress up for that project.  I had been looking around for awhile for some pattern I liked and came across this one.  It's neutral colors of beige/taupe and blue/grey that should blend in well.  It has a variety of patterns so each stair riser would be different and I like that idea and the look.  Haven't started that project yet as I have to prep the area.  It takes me awhile but I will get to it and I am excited to see how it turns out.  I will post an update when I get to that point.  The strips are a little over 7 inches wide and about 40 inches long.  There are 15 pieces, each a different pattern, all in the same muted shades.  Each piece has backing to protect the sticky side.  Feels pretty sticky so should adhere well.  I believe well worth the $$ if I can get this project done with my time and $40!  We shall see.

source_doc: Best pillow I have purchased! Oh my-I really do not where to begin. I purchased a Rainmr queen size bed pillow for myself. We have a king size bed so naturally you buy king size pillows. No matter how hard I tried I could not sleep on this huge pillow. I  knew I had to find something else. Upon receiving the Rainmr queen size pillow I was so pleased how cool, soft & comfortable it is. It comes with it’s own cooling pillowcase. The memory foam they use doesn’t have a strong odor which is something I liked. I am a side sleeper. I was amazed how the pillow keeps it’s shape. To sum it up the cost of the pillow is worth every penny I spent. If you are looking for a pillow that keeps it’s shape, and stays cool while you sleep-this pillow is just what you need. I would highly recommend this pillow.

source_doc: Had to return controller but ordered another because I love the controller layout. So I love the controller and the buttons on the back are in the best spot on any controller I’ve used. Unfortunately, I had to return the first one I ordered. When I plugged my headset into the controller and talked to teammates in any game I played, my teammates would say that my voice was coming through awful and I sounded muffled. I tried to find any solution by playing around with game settings, system settings, and troubleshooting the controller but to no avail the issues with voice communication remained. When I plugged my headset into other controllers, my headset and voice were perfectly normal so I knew it had something to do with the powerA controller. I returned the first one I ordered and have ordered a new one hoping it was just a lemon. I love what the controller has to offer just need the mic problems not to happen! Fingers crossed with the next one I’m waiting to be delivered.

source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: Worst piece of fitness equipment I own. Not going to lie, I wanted something for the wife that was just easier than grabbing a bar and bench in limited basement space.  I have all types of equipment down there, and this was just going to supplement workout routines.  I had high hopes when I got this thing.  Then I started to try and out it together.  Let me tell you, the hardware us not marked, the instructions leave a lot to be desired, and holes do not line up (had to ream out two holes).  Sturdiness after being assembled is questionable, and the design is severely flawed.  There are two hooks that insert downward and attach with nuts on the back (floor side) of the platform.  We'll, these hooks protrude further than the feet of the platform and hit the ground more than the supposed platform feet.  Let me tell you, I was pretty upset when I discovered these hooks had dug themselves into my floor and sratched it all up!  I had to grind these protrusions down and tape them to ensure they wouldn't scratch anything.  I tried the system after I assembled and do not feel confident that it will last more than a month.  Everything is cheap!  I am super upset that this thing is like this, and feel cheated.  Honestly, this is the worst piece of equipment I now own!!!

source_doc: Works great for wigs, too! I ordered this Pantene Pro-V Salt Texturizing Hairspray to give my wigs a bit of oomph and hold. Because I don't have a lot of bio hair, I wear wigs whenever I leave home. Some wigs are quite flat, and I like a little more volume. This spray works well to scrunch it in, give it volume and hold in the areas I want, and it smells nice. The sprayer on the first bottle I opened does not seem to spray out in a mist, so I have to spray it into my hands and scrunch it into place. It only takes a little for what I need, and I can reactivate it with water, when needed. It works great on my wigs, and I'm certain that it would work wonderful on natural hair, as well, and I would definitely recommend it!

source_doc: Great Faucet - everything else?  Meh. I wanted a Heavy Duty utility sink for the basement.  I liked the look of this. The only positive I can come up with is - the faucet is great - I hope it lasts.  The tub comes with clear and urgent directions on how to assemble it without breaking the tub.  I followed those instructions to the T and the tub broke in three of the four leg attachment locations.  Clearly a bad design.  It's ok though - the faucet seems great so I went ahead and continued the install with the broken - yet still functional - tub.  The p-trap and drain plumbing supplied is hard and brittle.  I needed to cut the drain pipe down about two inches to fit the existing drain - drain pipe shattered not once but twice while cutting it.  Thankfully I was replacing a utility sink so I could use the old plumbing pieces.  There is almost no backsplash on this unit  - so I'm still trying to figure out how I will secure it to the wall - as securing the legs won't help because of the broken tub.  I'm wishing I kept my old tub and just replaced the faucet.  Still looking for a better solution.

source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. source_doc: very moisturizing, non greasy, little goes a long way. If it seems greasy, then you used too much. Comes down to preference. I find this lotion to be very hydrating yet not greasy. Scale back. This is very rich, and takes very little to cover the hands.The scent is a tad off putting to me. I normally like both essential oils, but this is just "OK" to me. I think it is because it reminds more of a mans body wash. I dont need it to smell "female", I just prefer something else scent wise. It IS pleasant enough, and really comes down to personal preference.Salt and Stone has quality products at premium prices. I dont rate on price. I have no issue with the quality. I have used a variety of Salt and Stone products over the past couple of years and have been pleased with it. I love the clean, classy look. Has a neutral appearance that makes is appealing to anyone.4.5 stars

source_doc: For me not that great. I have 2 kitties. I was using littermaids corncob. I loved it. I switched to littermaid after using tidycat. For me tidycat was too dusty for my cats and my asthma. Plus tidycat was no longer clumping for me. Id pick up the supposedly urine balls. It just fall apart. Littermaid corncob clumped really well. It is lightweight. I had no issues with odors. But it was becoming harder and harder to find. So when i needed litter i chose to try this. So i got a bag from here. Urine balls didnt clump at all. I picked it up it fell apart. It mixed in with the clean. Odor control is non existant. I can smell the urine and stools from my apt door. I may have smelly cats in the stool dept. But i shouldnt be smelling urine too. Very disappointed. I dont ķnow whats going on with littermaid. But i sure do miss it.

source_doc: Compact, easy to use and nice carrying case. The BOOKOO jump starter is great to have in case of you need to give yourself a boost or help someone else out with dead battery. It’s easy to use. I have not had to use this particular one yet I do keep it in my boat in case my cranking battery dies or one goes bad. I feel confident this will boost when I need it to!I have multiple BOOKOO boosters and used one with less mah to completely jump my truck. I wanted to test it out so I unhooked my battery completely from my truck so it would be as if my battery were COMPLETELY dead and I hooked up the BOOKOO booster and it successfully started my 5.4 l pickup multiple times! I didn’t test how many times it could jump without having original battery even hooked up but I did at least three times and I know it had mor juice left. I was just happy with those results so I unhooked it and recharged it and put in in vehicle for use when needed. I now keep one in every vehicle we own.I’ve also jumped a 4 wheeler with the BOOKOO booster no problem.

source_doc: Best price to features for this type of product. I looked at others similar to this, Hart, Dewalt, Milwaukee, Bauer, etc.  I liked the Hart and this one because I have batteries for both of these.  The Hart was near 2x the cost, so I took a chance on the Meliff.  Two days after I ordered this, I found a Hart tool marked down due to a damage box - funny but it was actually cheaper.  I got this one in first, it worked well.  Quick to inflate, I liked the auto shut off feature.  Then I got the Hart in.  I tried the Hart out and it works well but has no cut off feature.  You have to hold the trigger the entire time.  Both are equal in speed and battery life.  Both weigh about the same and seem equal in construction.  The Hart is a little prettier in cosmetics.  End of the day, I prefer the Mellif and will be ordering another (they've jacked the price up 12% in past two weeks).

source_doc: Love this play mat. I got this play mat for the kids playroom and was pleasantly surprised. This was a perfect addition to our playroom since we have hard wood floors. Sitting on the ground was not comfy for me when I was playing with the kids but it was also a safety concern for me not having padding on the ground for my daughter who was doing tummy time, rolling and crawling. The mat is very sturdy / durable which is 100% necessary when you’re working with toddlers. I wasn’t sure if would last long but for the price I was willing to give it a shot. I was not disappointed. I wish I had it when I had my first child. I love the material because I would let the baby just lay freely so if she went potty it was an easy clean up. Even in general I was able to clean / sanitize the mat when necessary! Great buy.

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: I wish I had known about Keychron before I bought my Ducky One 3 Daybreak. I bought my Ducky one 3 daybreak back in January of 2022 when I started to get really interested in keyboards. I wanted something with hot swappable switches and a variety of keycap options. After using that for about year the keys started to double type. I did everything from updating the firmware on the KB to replacing every individual switch after cleaning it out with compressed air. Unfortunately I concluded that it was a PCB (printed circuit board) issue, and none of it ever worked and so it's been sitting on my shelf since October.The Keychron Q6 is a breath of fresh air. I was hesitant to spend over $150 for a KB again after my previous experience but wow am I glad I did. Almost immediately you can feel the quality in this absolute unit of a KB. It is heavy, I cannot emphasis enough with how heavy this KB is. The sound is rich and comforting using their lubed reds. I thought I'd miss an illuminating RGB experience but I've gotten to the point to where this subtle south-facing RGB is perfect for my needs. The customization is endless using the VIA software that it recommends.I will absolutely 100% recommend this if you want something built on a proper platform with room to grow in whatever direction you so desire.

source_doc: Cute Starburst Lights. I have wanted some of these starburst lights to add to my holiday decor.  I ordered these because they can be used outdoors and could be used for different holidays like Christmas and the 4th of July etc.  I haven’t quite managed to get them shaped like the picture but will do a better job when I am ready to hang them.  I like that they are battery operated because that will mean I can hang them just about anywhere.  My plan was to hang them in the large tree in my front yard.  The quality seems to be good but I don’t know how long they will last.  The only thing that disappointed me was the size.  They are very small.  I put a pen next to it in the photo for reference.  Based on the size, I don’t think they will work for the look I wanted, especially since the tree is so large.  I also think the price is a bit high based on the size.

I feel like I don't have keep adjusting as it covers my habitual sight range. My only concern is that the frame is a bit light which I think is fine for the price point, but I do wonder how long it will last.

source_doc: Great for a toddler. I needed a 2 pack so she can have 1 by toilet and 1 by the sink (she being my 3 year old toddler). For reference, I already own a similar stool by IKEA and it's basically the same stool. I do not have an IKEA locally so would have to pay to ship it, since I didn't have anything else I needed from them I chose to just buy this set on Amazon instead this time. It's exactly what I wanted and I liked that I could get white with gray instead of having to get the white with green, which is IKEA's only color option. If you did purhcase this set in the white with green it'd probably be just like the IKEA stools. I would never use this for an adult but I see in the reviews some people are. This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: Only oil I use. I am glad that I have been able to buy this oil from this same vendor for years. You just can't find it in stores and if you do it is almost twice as much per quart or higher in some places if you can even find it. This is the only oil I will use in my zero turn Skag. I have been using this oil in my mowers for 30 years. I always change oil, OEM Kawasaki oil filter and air filter before start of every mowing season. Have always been able to get many hours of mowing out of my mowers without a problem. Might have to add very little at the end of mowing season. As far as I am concerned this is the best oil to use in warm and hot climates being how I live in Texas and it gets very hot in the summer. I might add that this is a residential property and I mow 2 acres once a week and I mow an additional 5 acres three times a summer. If you mow commercially you will have to change oil and filter more often.

source_doc: More than just a vase, this is a piece of art! I was expecting to like this vase but I was blown away with seeing it in person. I was thinking it would be much smaller than it actually is. It's large and so beautifully shaped. I love the primitive look of it. To me it looks kind of like an ancient cave wall drawing brought to life. I love that it's got a really nice, somewhat rough, texture to it. I wasn't sure I would like the black and was thinking I may spray paint it but the black really does work. I'm still deciding how I want to use this piece. It's not really a vase for fresh flowers at all. I have several different types of dried floral and pampas grasses I am going to try out to see which look I like best. I am really happy with this art piece and it's quality and I can happily recommend it!

source_doc: Absolutely Awesome! I needed to fine away that I can have my dehumidifier in my basement run consistently without me having to remember to empty the bucket. In the summertime, my dehumidifier will fill up a 70 pint bucket every day! Since I don't go down to the basement every day to empty the bucket, I wanted something that can empty the water itself. I noticed one of these pumps on my fathers central air unit in his basement. He told me that this pumps collects the condensation until it gets full. Once it's full, it just pumps it out a hose into the back yard. Unfortunately I don't have the ability to run a hose out to the back yard but I do have access to main sewar line in my basement. I mounted this to the side of the table that holds my dehumidifier and ran a hose from the water outlet tube to the inlet of the pump. I connected the hose from the pump to a threaded barb fitting I mounted on a 2" PVC cap that screws onto my main sewar line. This setup has been running for months and I has worked flawlessly!

source_doc: Quality seemed fine, but a major, unique screw was missing . . . . . . as it was "two-ended" with a smoothe surface in between that was required to hold the basket between two of the poles. Because China was the likely place I would've had to wait to receive it from, a return was suggested. I bought a larger one from a different company and all the hardware was there. I will say about the one I returned that you have to place four of the poles inside the cubby-hole portion, and it was impossible to see and get the screws lined up to screw into the poles inside, especially at the back area, as I kept thinking I'd gotten it, only to discover that I had not. I became frustrated after trying too many times in two different intervals, but I finally succeeded, only to realize that my efforts were futile due to that unique screw missing. The one I returned it for had the same requirement, but I had no problems with it, either due to a better design or due to the cubby-hole being differently shaped. Anyway, I suggest you read more reviews besides mine before deciding whether YOU want to give it a go.

source_doc: Mixed feelings. The 2 star is for THIS mat I bought. I must admit, it's taken me 5 years to write this review.  But I just used my OLD Jade mat and thought I should write this review.  I have mixed feeling because I bought a Jade mat at my yoga studio and have used it for many years. Great mat! I love it.  It was getting kind of dingy, so I thought I would use that one at home and buy another one for the studio.  So I bought this orange one. After about 2-3 months of uses, and past the return, it started to deteriorate.  I'd find orange specks all over my pants, as it was visibly breaking down. Life was busy so I just shoved the new crappy one in a closet and went back to using my old mat, which is over 10 years old and holding up.  I can't get it sparkling clean looking, but at least it's not falling apart.  I'm still disappointed that I wasted $80. Why was one mat great and durable and the other one crappy?

source_doc: Really attractive candle holders. I got these because I really like the look of them. I was trying to decide where to put them in my house when my husband told me he wanted to put them outside on our house on our back patio. He put them up and they look so nice back there. There is only one issue I have with this set. I love that it comes with the flameless candles. I love flameless candles and I have many of them. The problem with these is I wish they had come with a remote to turn them off and on much easier. When they are hung up outside and you have to reach inside and get each one to turn it off or on that gets kind of old. That was one of the first things I thought of when I was wondering where to put them inside as well. I had a place I wanted to put them but it would have been annoying to have had to reach up to take them out to turn on and put them back in. Every set of flameless candles I've gotten have come with remotes. I couldn't believe that this set didn't. I took a star away for that reason.

source_doc: Don't fall for the same bait and switch I did. I had decided that I was going to purchase the carpet One, non-Pro version. When I pulled up the page, I was looking at prices and the carpet One pro had a $100 off coupon available. This made the price $499 which was the same price as the non-Pro version at the time, so it seemed like a no-brainer to me. A couple of days after receiving it, I went back on Amazon to see what current prices were and I was  let down. The non-Pro version is now selling for $349. They had obviously raised the price to get people to switch just like I did, probably because they needed to unload some. I contacted them about being upset about being duped, and their solution was to offer me a free bottle of cleaning solution. I felt that was rather insulting. The carpet One pro is definitely not worth the extra money spent. The Wi-Fi function is pointless. While the LED screen is fancy, it doesn't do much more than what the non-Pro version does. I do feel like the sensor showing how dirty the area is, or the sensor showing how damp the area is, are both gimmicks. I have not noticed any consistency with either of those functions. I do feel like it is a good carpet cleaner, but definitely not for more than $349.

source_doc: Meh. I was really excited to get this car charger adapter for my spectra. Well, my excitement was short lived once I started using it. Once I plugged it in and turner my pump on, I could clearly hear the motor of the pump struggling. This adapter doesn't provide enough power to give my pump what it needs to function properly. As a result I need to pump longer, on higher settings/vaccum and my output is less than half of what I usually can get. I use this once I day while at work on my lunch break and as soon as I get home I have to pump again because I still have milk left that needs to be extracted. Is this adapter great for relieving pressure- yes. Would I recommend it for a reliable addition to your pump for every day use- that would be a no. Other than that, it's a sturdy item that came shortly after it was ordered and packaging was nice and cute.

source_doc: Great pants but order the right size. I really like these leather pants.  It’s hard to find leather pants in a store unless you go to a motorcycle store, but those pants are more about protection in case of a fall or crash.  The other place to find leather pants is at a kink store but those pants are very expensive.  I decided to order online, but when I read the reviews they all said to size down.  I followed their advice, and it was wrong!  I normally wear a size 36 in Levi’s, so I ordered down like everyone said and ordered a 34.  That pants was too small and too tight.  I then thought maybe I should order a size bigger so I ordered a 38, and that pants was too big.  Finally I ordered a 36, and it was perfect.  My advice is order your normal Levi size, and you should be good to go.  Just so you know I weigh 220 and I’m 6-1 who wears size 36 in pants.  Hope this helps someone out there.

source_doc: Surprising results. I finally got a chance to try these dual lavalier microphones. I will admit that I was a bit skeptical but after I used them as advertised, I am happy to report that they work rather well. First, they are well-built. I did not notice any defects and even the pop-up foam blockers fit well. They are a bit bigger than expected, but nothing too excessive or distracting. They clip nicely on any piece of clothing and do not easily fall off. I appreciate the nice graphite-looking case, which houses both mics and accessories.I tested the microphones and recorded some content, and the audio came out surprisingly full and clear. There was a little bit of bass and very few pop-ups. I still would use my microphone while sitting in front of a screen, but if I need to move around, these mics will work nicely. The best opportunity to test them was during an online family meeting. I put the mic on myself and my wife. I then hooked up the laptop to the TV. The microphones came in loud and clear. We were about 10 feet away from the TV (it is 75”) and experienced no issues whatsoever.In the end, I found the BerrysParadise mics to be a very good value and I feel very comfortable recommending them.

source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. source_doc: These may be overkill for what I ordered them for. I'm a little paranoid.  I recently started making my own soap and the first time I did I got a small granule of lye on my foot and got a teeny, tiny chemical burn.  But now I'm paranoid and every time I make another batch I feel like I just bathed in lye and it is all over me.  So I thought getting some good gloves might put my overactive mind at ease.These definitely do the trick as far as protection.  They o all the way up my arms and make me feel ready to take on nuclear waste. I appreciate the elastic on the top to help keep them in place.  Relatively soft and flexible.  I don't have any issues measuring and dumping lye out of the bottle when wearing them, but they do still interfere with my dexterity so I wouldn't want to try and do anything that requires precision and delicacy in them.But as far as providing the protection they are meant to do, two big (blue) thumbs up!

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!

source_doc: Surprised. I've often worried about my Shady being warm enough, especially this winter where it's been so cold. He mainly sleeps with me but he still feels cool to me. So when I came across this product, I put it in my wanted list. I felt it was a little expensive. And I have bought blankets and beds and he ignors them all. So am I going to spend this much money for him not to use it?As the cold days keep coming and not letting up, the more I was concerned about him not being warm. The last thing I wanted was for him to get sick. So I purchased the mat. I no more unboxed it and tossed it to the area on the bed he likes to sleep when not on me. He jumped on the bed and walked over sniffed it and laid down! I was shocked, I didn't have to put catnip on it to get him on it! As I write this he is laying there on the mat sleeping!I couldn't be more impressed.Thank you for easing my mind. I know he will be warm now.

source_doc: So far, so good. I hesitated quite a while before I bought this.  I don't have spam that often, but when I do I could never get the slices evenly cut.  Shouldn't be that big of a deal, but the thinner sides would always get overcooked while I finished the thicker sides.  This little gem has solved that problem.  Plus, all the picture I had seen had sliced the spam across the long side, giving smaller cut pieces.  I prefer slicing it the other way to get a piece that fits in a sandwich better.  I wasn't sure if I could do that with this slicer, but I can.  It's a tight fit, but it can be done.

source_doc: Not safe. I wanted to love these, and I saved them for when I got a new car. When I put them in they were fine, until I did the test with the carseat and no matter what I did to tighten down the carseat, they still moved substantially with these protectors underneath them. I could move the carseat more than 2 inches side to side, and I grabbed my kids dad to see if he could tighten them more and it didn't change much. With that movement and my kids car seats, I won't be using these. There are also standards I didn't know about when I first ordered these... any accessory meant to go with or under a carseat (even harness strap covers) must be crash tested and approved. I could find no evidence that these had been crash tested and approved.
