source_doc: NOT ACCURATE! As usual, you get what you pay for. After wearing the watch for a few weeks, I can say that I am totally disappointed. It DOES keep good record of temperature, time,  blood pressure and oxygen levels, but TOTALLY FAILS in calorie count and steps. I am extremely active and I am AMAZED at the calories burned and steps taken. I jog at least 2 miles a day and I am up and down stairs all day long I have always had at least 10,000 to 12,000 steps a day. This watch has measured 4,000 on the best day and shows my calorie count as no more than 395 in a day. If that was all I actually burned every day, I would weigh about 1,000 pounds by now.  The calorie count and steps are really the most important things to me, so the watch is really useless. I am wearing the watch right now and have been running around the house since 5 AM. It shows only 105 steps and 3 calories burned. Uggg 3/10/2023 I am updating my review. I stand by my original statements, but I have to report that the seller has been harassing me every day asking to compensate me in exchange for removing my review.  Apparently Amazon has not been able to make them stop, as it is still happening. It is getting creepy

source_doc: Brilliant self tightening design. I bought these chains to "keep in the truck" so I would be legal. Didn't think I would need them with 4x4 and snow tires. Sure enough, ended up in a blizzard leaving Yosemite national park while towing a trailer. Roads got really bad, really quick.  I pulled these out and was pleased with how easily they went on. Basically there's a notch for where your tire meets the ground, so you just slip it around. No pulling forward or backwards.  The chains weren't perfectly centered when I put them on, so I just drove 100 yards down the road and rechecked them. Sure enough, they have self centered and the tightening mechanism had taken up the slack on its own.  They stayed nice and tight and didn't slap around as we drove. Removal was ALMOST as easy as installing.  I was genuinely impressed.  I will be more likely to slap these on early when conditions deteriorate now that I know how easy they are. I will be buying a set for any car I own in the future.

source_doc: Cute but slows gameplay. These are so cute but unfortunately they do affect how I interact with the Joycon buttons. This might not be the case for everyone (hence the good reviews), But I found after nearly a week of using these buttons, they did noticeably impact my gameplay. The buttons themselves do not feel bad, they are smooth enough that they are not uncomfortable on your fingers, but because they are hard plastic, they change how quickly you can press down on the Joycon buttons. I did not realize they were hard plastic until after they arrived, I ordered them thinking they were silicone button covers. I put them on anyway because they were really cute but after several days, I noticed that when I would press the buttons on the right joycon, the reactions with my switch were slower. Even worse, when I pressed down on one of the arrow buttons on the left Joycon, the hard plastic button cover would push down on multiple buttons at once. So if I used the down arrow on the left joycon, my switch thought I hit the right arrow instead. It actually changed how I played games on my switch.

source_doc: Amazing at first and then all the issues came. Great customer service and replacement BUT. I really wanted to love this automated cat litter box.  A friend highly recommended it so I took a chance and spent over $500.  It was amazing for the first 6 months and then the issues started.  First, the waste bin kept saying it was full even after I emptied it.  I did everything to try to fix it but couldn't so I asked the company how to fix it.  They sent me a new litter box.  The 2nd litter box was great for 4 months then unused litter kept filling the waste bin.  I couldn't fix it and don't understand why this started happening.  I messaged the company again but this time I had a really hard time sending the information and the video clip.  Now the odor removal sensor keeps telling me there is no liquid even after I fill it. Well, I guess having this automated litter box for a year now has spoiled me so I need to buy a new one that works!  Any suggestions?

source_doc: Great keyboard, but not for beginners. TL;DR: I REALLY like this keyboard, especially once you add different switches and keycaps, but it didn't work out because my accuracy sucks. Definitely not for beginners.Long review: I got the optical reds with this keyboard and it's definitely not for me since I'm a heavy typist. It's just too sensitive so I got the orange and bananas (yellow) optical switches to try them out. I do like the oranges but the ping on some of the switches is too dang loud and annoying so I settled with the bananas (yellow).Once I got them to my liking, it's time to test drive the keyboard. I'm not a typist per day but I can type. Not 100% accurate though, and that's where my problems arose. When I do make a mistake, I will almost 50% of the time would hit the "page up" instead of the backspace.. I do use "del" a lot as well and would hit the light switch instead.. If you're competent and have 99% accuracy when you type, it may work for you. Otherwise, get the K1 DE (what I did instead).
hypos: Отличная клавиатура, но не для новичков. Суть: мне REALLY нравится эта клавиатура, особенно когда вы добавляете разные переключатели и клавиши, но у меня не получилось, потому что моя точность ужасна. Определенно не для новичков. Долгий отзыв: я получил оптические красные переключатели с этой клавиатурой, и это определенно не для меня, так как я много печатаю. Она просто слишком чувствительная, поэтому я попробовал оранжевые и банановые (желтые) оптические переключатели. Мне нравятся оранжевые, но щелчок на некоторых из переключателей слишком громкий и раздражающий, поэтому я остался с банановыми (желтыми). Как только я настроил их под себя, настало время протестировать клавиатуру. Я не типограф по профессии, но могу печатать. Хотя не на 100% точно, и именно здесь возникли мои проблемы. Когда я делаю ошибку, почти в 50% случаев я нажимал "страница вверх" вместо backspace.. Я также много использую "del" и, как правило, нажимаю вместо этого на переключатель света.. Если вы компетентны и имеете 99% точности, когда печатаете, возможно, она подойдет вам. В противном случае возьмите K1 DE (что я и сделал вместо этого).

source_doc: Really Good Quality. I ordered this sink mat because I am having a new farmhouse sink installed and want to make sure it is protected from day one.  I have seen the metal ones but it seemed to me that those could scratch the sink so silicone makes more sense.  It is also easier to remove to clean it and the sink.  This silicone mat is good quality and feels like it will hold up well.  I like the cutout for the drain so I will be able to use the stopped if I want to without having to remove the mat.  I like the ‘teeth’ on the bottom too that allow the water to drain.  They are a sufficient height.  After I got it, I decided to order another because I realized I could put a drying mat under it to use as a dish drain when I hand wash larger pots etc.  It will also be good as a heat mat for larger casserole dishes.  Good quality and the price is good..

source_doc: A great stool to have around. Just the right size. I first bought one of these when I was one of those 'demo dollys' one finds in a store touting something new. I was supposed to stand at my table for like four hours but just couldn't  This stool was just the right height so I could take a load off my feet yet still be upright enough to be attentive to the shoppers I was demonstrating too.Now I have one in my kitchen. I am getting older and would rather not stand for any length of time if I don't have to. It is great for waiting for the microwave to finish when I'm fixing a meal. And when I don't need it any more it folds so easily - just release the catch and jurk upwards on the seat and it folds right up small enough to slip into that space between the fridge and the wall. I don't remember what the weight limit is supposed to be, but I weigh 265 lbs and it has no problem supporting me.

source_doc: Secure and comfortable. I like these better than my name-brand ones I use for my cable machine at home and the ones available at the box gym I used to go to. The reason I like them better is because they are way more secure. The ones I have are all velcro and if you are hooked onto a heavy cable then the velcro has come off before. These ones do not entirely depend on the velcro because they are made with the two metal rings that close and then you clip to the machine with those. Much better and safer. They are padded so they are comfortable. The only thing I don't like is that I can't get the circumference small enough to tightly wrap my ankle so they are loose (I have small ankles). However, that's not too big a deal I still prefer these over the other ones. Additionally, they did come with a chemical smell which I do not like but I will leave them out in the open to air out. If it doesn't dissipate I will report back, but I anticipate that the smell will dissipate.

Причина, по которой мне они нравятся больше, заключается в том, что они гораздо более надежные. source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. The bin I used to have for the toys is no longer big enough, so I needed something bigger. This basket is quite large, and is the perfect size for his toys. It's pretty deep, so I don't think it would be great for a small dog. Hank is really tall (I'm 5'7" and he is almost as tall as me when he is on his hind legs), so it's easy for him to reach into the deep basket and get his toys. The material seems sturdy, so I think it will last a while. But, even using a hair dryer like they suggest, it's not really keeping its shape. Since I ordered this for my dog's toys, that's not a deal breaker for me. For what I wanted to use it for, it's perfect. It's also more of a dark grayish/black, but again, that doesn't bother me for what I wanted it for. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: I absolutely LOVE it. I love this thing.  Got it on a lightening deal and so glad I took the plunge.  It took a while to put it together, but if you follow the directions exactly (something hard for my hubby to do), it goes together perfectly.  It was also very easy to hang.  It has a lot of space, and just what I needed in my laundry/half-bath.  We wanted to keep a few first aid items in there, and I also have a good place to store extra toilet paper.  I love the little open shelf.  I put an extra hand towel and I will also add something decorative as soon as I find something that fits with my decor.  The only thing wrong was on my part.  I thought this was mission style doors, but they aren't.  My fault for not paying better attention.  I really don't care because I love it so much.  Oh, and I changed the knobs only because I wanted it to match the rest of the cabinets in the laundery room.  If not for that, I would have left the included knobs because they look really nice.  I would most definitely buy this again.

source_doc: Probiotic toothpaste. I am a huge fan of using probiotics for all types of products, so I was happy to try this product. It has a more delicate flavor than the toothpastes I’m accustomed to using, from America. There’s a subtle mint and sweet flavor, I found it refreshing. I don’t expect it to whiten my teeth… I use whitening strips for that, and even with those, it requires regular use for my teeth to get whiter. I like using whitening toothpastes though, sort of as daily maintenance. But I’ve never tried a whitening toothpaste on its own that actually made my teeth whiter.One thing I did notice is that I have a sensitive spot on my teeth that I started feeling after using this for a few days. I normally use Sensodyne because of tooth sensitivity. And the sensodyne definitely keeps that at bay. So I probably wouldn’t repurchase this for that reason, and also because it’s pretty expensive (currently $49 for a 3.52oz tube). But I did enjoy the other aspects of this toothpaste.

source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: clean tasting water for myself and my dogs. I can taste difference between my tap water and this water. I bought this to use for my dogs water bowl. We have a water filter system as part of our fridge, but takes too long to get a few good size bowls of water changed out every day. Sometimes I would buy spring water, but that adds up. My other filter pitcher I gave away because it was old and I could not find the filters for it. So forward to me deciding to buy a new pitcher all together. I chose this based on reasonable price for the pitcher and future filters. I liked the size, the handle, and that it overall has good reviews. Now I can add mine to the mix.It filters quickly. I can keep some water in the top water reservoir and dont find that it spills out while pouring. I am just careful. I like that I can fill water bowls with ease. My dogs still love a good drink from the toilet, but they are perfectly happy with the water from this filter system. Side by side I think they like the gallons of spring water I was buying for them best, but isnt doable long term.Pitcher and handle feels durable.

source_doc: Awesome!!! This pole is awesome I've never fly fished before because it seemed to be expensive and took some practice/skill to do butt this pole is super simple. I watched a bunch of videos then took a practice fly out in the yard setup a coffee can and started to practice before I new it i was able to pop that fly into the can with easy its all on the wrist. I like that the pole is all self contained i did get a line holder that attaches to the rod just above your hand so when collapsed you can just wind the line around it slip it in the tube and be on your way. I dont know that Ill every want to buy a fly rod I have several lengths and weights of tippet lines and most of the small streams and brooks I fish are tight quarters so your not able to cast a country mile anyway. I suppose on the bigger lakes you would want a fly rod too but the portability of this rod is awesome I would recommend trying one out especial if you already have the fly gear its quick to setup and be on the edge of in the water with 13 ft and a 12-16 ft  tippet you can get a decent amount of distance and accuracy. I think its a great setup for beginners or pro's its just another style of fishing.

source_doc: Simple versus Stanley. Simple modern every day hands-down! I bought this one because it had my football team logo on it even though I received a Stanley for Christmas. I have since bought two more simple modern tumblers.My simple modern is light weight and holds ice until the next day. It is perfect for my iced coffee. My ice does not melt down and water down my product. Of course no tumbler is spill proof when there is a straw involved however, it does not leak when it spills over unless it comes out of the straw when it’s been completely flipped. I found that out when I hit the brakes and my lunch bag went flying from the car seat to the floorboard upside down. With a Stanley, it does not seem to keep ice as long and I do get the water down effect and it is heavier. also when it tips it doesn’t leak not only from the straw but the straw hole in the sides of the lid. I do have the new Stanley H2O.Another great thing about the Simple Modern is the price.  It’s affordable and I definitely use it. There is a $10 price difference between this and the Stanley.I absolutely love this and and I am definitely more hydrated and I noticed that my skin does not look as dry. I would recommend this cup.

source_doc: Buckwheat pillow for life! I have no other buckwheat pillow to compare this to, but I can say that using this pillow has eliminated neck and shoulder pain. I have not woke up with strain in my neck since I started sleeping on this pillow. Feels odd at first, as the granules collect in places and lump up, but I got used to having to shift them around to create the areas of support I need when I first lay down. Once you shift and mold the pillow to suit your neck and head, it feels like a supportive hug whilst you sleep. I use this pillow on the couch as well, as throw-pillows do not seem right after using this. There was extra buckwheat that i had to remove and I am going to make an airplane pillow out of it so I do not wreck my neck whilst flying.. BONUS!!

source_doc: everything is just wrong. I went to install it and took all the parts I needed off and out of the way then  I put one of the brackets on with ease thanks to a friend. but shortly afterward noticed an issue with the second bracket. the one that attaches to the transfer case bolts wasn't fitting right. I went and read that some needed to cut their brackets to get it to fit, instead of cutting the bracket I cut the bit off that was in the way with a Dremel and it fits perfectly afterward. then I went on to try to put the shifter in and attach it to the 4WD lever and I tried for nearly an hour and it wouldn't work. I went to look up if I was doing something wrong but I found out I was given the wrong bracket altogether. so I spent half my afternoon taking my car apart and now I need to go to B&M for customer support and hope they can help fix the mistake.

source_doc: A solid and well-made gate. I have pretty much the same gate (different company) but without the cat door. I didn't know they even made gates with cat doors! I was thinking of all sorts of different things I could do to create a safety barrier but not lock the cats out. I didn't want to actually have to install a door and then cut a whole and install a cat door. I was excited when I ran across this product, and was hoping it was something of good quality (like my other gate). I was pleased when this arrived as it was quite heavy (a good thing) and is made with some sort of solid metal (can't be bent). I like that the cat door can be left open, or it can be locked. I admit when I installed my first gate it was a bit confusing as I wanted to get it right, but the manual that this came with is really helpful in it's detail and pictures. It helps I've already made an installation like this before, but even if I hadn't I appreciate the instructions. I will still use them. I don't remember how much I paid for the non-cat gate, but it was definitely more expensive than this. I'm glad they make a product like this!

source_doc: Exactly what I needed. These are great! I started woodworking and whittling as a hobby and the gloves are the best. I recently burnt my thumb while cooking and was still worried I'd stab my thumb while working. Sure if I intentionally tried to make the knife go into the glove it will happen, it's cut resistant not stab resistant. I have accidentally stabbed a few fingers but there was enough padding for it to cushion it so I didn't bleed or get seriously hurt. I mainly use whittling knives, though.The bumpy grip stuff is great. I have arthritis in my hands and sometimes things slip my grasp, but not with these.Make sure to order a size down because like the other reviewers say: they run big. I would fit a medium by the charts standards but I fit into a small. I have no problem with the finger length since I have "piano player length" fingers. Your hands will get sweaty if worn too long but isn't super horrible, I wear them for 3-5 hrs at a time.They don't wear down too fast. With what I do and judging by the one month I've had them, I could see them lasting 3-4 months before needing to replace them.I give all 5 stars cause it's exactly what I was looking for.

source_doc: Ordered 2 new monitors. One was already opened. When I opened the first shipping box, I saw that the product box inside was not sealed. The tape appeared to have been cut or torn. I thought maybe i had cut it when opening the outer box, or maybe the tape had split. It wasn't until I started opening the second monitor's box that I realized the first one was used. The second one had a padded bag around the speaker. The first did not. The second one had the volume knob turned all the way down. The first one had it turned all the way up.I would have rated these 5 stars, easily. They sound great. But sending used products to people paying new prices is unacceptable. I don't know how much it has been used. I don't know if it was abused. I don't know if someone else registered the serial number, which could cause me issues if I have a warranty issue down the line. I would not have ordered these if I knew I would be getting a used one. So I'm knocking it down to 3 stars.

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

My only criticism is I couldn’t fit 10 lbs no matter how hard I tamped down the rice I used to fill it- I could fit 8.5 lbs of rice. Maybe I should have used another fill material - and I guess the weight is close enough to the 10 lbs it will work- but I do wish I had been able to make it a full 10 lbs

source_doc: I WANT TO WEAR THIS LIKE A BURRITO IT IS SO BRILLIANT GET IT GET IT!!!! Okay, I can't believe I am reviewing a blanket - but this one deserves it.  A bit of history - I love blankets and the supersoft thin ones made out of recycled coke bottles or whatever are all over my house.  But my favorite blanket has always been a BERKSHIRE one I got years ago and I went on Amazon looking to see if they had similar by that brand and found this.  I cannot believe I lived without this blanket for so long it is sheer perfection!  Both lightweight and super warm - I have been wrapping myself like a burrito at night while I read and I am perfectly warm and content.  I may never leave my house again.  Just brilliant - love it!! Mine hasn't been shedding which I see others say - but that may be because of the color?  I don't know.  I am buying more.  I will spend this winter as a happy warm burrito.  You should too!

source_doc: Tire marks..avoid this sealer! I purchased with high hopes based on excellent reviews...sadly I've had nothing but issues since I sprayed it on my paver driveway. I applied the product as per the instructional video and after waiting 48 hours, I parked on the driveway. Over the past several weeks I've accumulated over 20 tire marks on my once clean driveway. I tried to scrub off with soap and water, but it made little difference. I contacted the manufacturer and they told me that the tire marks must have been on the driveway before sealing (definitely not the case) and after submitting several photos they sent me a .pdf explaining how black tire marks will happen with this time of "film forming sealer." Their recommendation was to soap/scrub and then pressure wash the marks off. I sealed my driveway so I wouldn't have to scrub it and pressure wash it frequently...but this low rate sealer all but guarantees I will have to repeatedly power wash on a regular basis to get rid of the tire marks that keep appearing. If I had a time machine I would go back and warn myself not to put this sealer on my driveway no matter how good the reviews were. Avoid this product for your driveway unless you enjoy frequent cleaning and the depressing feeling that you just paid nearly $300 for a product that will make your driveway more of a headache to keep clean. Zero stars if I could!
hypos: Следы от шин..избегайте этот герметик! Я купил/а его с большими надеждами на основе отличных отзывов...к сожалению, у меня были только проблемы с тех пор, как я распылил его на свою брусчатую дорожку. Я применил/а продукт согласно обучающему видео и, подождав 48 часов, припарковался/лась на дорожке. За последние несколько недель на моей когда-то чистой дорожке накопилось более 20 следов от шин. Я пытался/лась оттереть их с помощью мыла и воды, но это дало мало результата. Я связался/лась с производителем, и они сказали мне, что следы от шин, должно быть, были на дорожке до запечатки (это определенно не так), и после того как я отправил/а несколько фотографий, они прислали мне .pdf, объясняющий, как черные следы от шин могут появиться с таким типом "герметика, образующего пленку." Их рекомендация заключалась в том, чтобы мыть/скрести с мылом, а затем под давлением смывать следы. Я запечатал/а свою дорожку, чтобы мне не пришлось часто очищать ее и мыть под давлением...но этот герметик низкого качества практически гарантирует, что мне придется регулярно мыть под давлением, чтобы избавиться от следов от шин, которые продолжают появляться. Если бы у меня была машина времени, я бы вернулся/вернулась назад и предупредил/а себя не наносить этот герметик на свою дорожку, независимо от того, насколько хорошие были отзывы. Избегайте этого продукта для своей дорожки, если вам не нравится частая уборка и угнетающее чувство, что вы только что заплатили почти 300 долларов за продукт, который сделает вашу дорожку головной болью, чтобы поддерживать ее в чистоте. Ноль звезд, если бы я мог/могла!

source_doc: Decent, feels like you need a lot though. Thus works a lot like your average face masks. You definitely see a brightness to your skin immediately after use. I want to add, that it seems like I need a large amount the couple times I have used this, and I'm not sure if this is just me and battling the different texture it is, or that I really do need more than I do with other masks. Still, it does work as good as your average ones. My face feels and looks radiant after use, so for me, this is a value for price review. The amount I get and use vs the price compared to other masks, is a bit steep for my liking. I have found 8 dollar ones of different brands that have 3 times more, and work the same as this, so the value just hits in the middle for me. source_doc: Better than I thought. I got this microphone for my phone to cut down background noise mainly for zoom meetings but also for a bird identification app called Merlin as traffic is very loud. I am usually a stickler about apps but this said it didn't require one. Much to my surprise it actually does not require an app or anything. I have a galaxy S22 ultra and I plugged it in and it just worked. I didn't have to change any settings or anything. It worked for every app even ok google. While playing with it i did open a decibel meter and took notice of how much of the background noise was being cut out. I live full time in a Class A RV so the noise level can be pretty high inside. I put 2 screenshots in to show it does decrease the background noise a bit. I think the actual bonus comes from the microphone being much closer to you though. I only used it on my phone so not sure about the other things.

source_doc: Love this kit, would love to buy another, but don't try to take throught TSA checkpoint. I bought this to tune my piano and my parents' piano; theirs was way out of tune, and I had not tuned a piano before.  I watched a youtube tutorial or two, got the panotuner app, and ordered this kit.  I was able to get my parents' piano sounding much better in just a few minutes.  Unfortunately, I tried to carry the kit through the TSA checkpoint, and it would not go (the tuner device is a tool more than 7 inches) so I had to ship it to my parents' house, and I left it there.  My piano is also slightly out of tune, but I am hoping they will restock and I can get another kit like the one I got my parents.  Otherwise, I will be shipping that tuning kit back to me in a few months.  Much cheaper than hiring a piano tuner, and just as effective.

source_doc: Decent size for all the info. I found that the personal touch from the CEO with this letter and description of the company was beyond what I expected. Also its rubber and so easy to put on her collar that unlike a metal one it wont tarnish, like her previous one did because of her water bowl. So even though I just got it and Oreo seems to approve, because its not bothering her yet, I would say that I would recommend it.Oreo approved!!! Lol.Side note: I think whoever had it as an example that said "Only indoor cat. If I'm out I'm lost" is genius because I put it on hers!!!! Love that about it.

source_doc: Didn’t Work. I bought one of these quite a while ago and never installed it. I finally got around to installing it. The concept is great, mine just didn’t work. I tried it on two different Leviton switches thinking that perhaps the contacts just didn’t quite line up on the first switch I tried to install it on. I made sure the switch (on the SnapPower faceplate) was in, power was in to the switch, and I covered the sensor/switch to test it. Nothing. I removed the SnapPower faceplate, inspected it, and tried again. Same result. I tried another switch, and same result. I had an extra Leviton switch, so I checked to see whether the SnapPower contacts line up with the screws. They do, not perfectly, but certainly enough to make adequate electrical contact that they should work. So either my SnapPower face plate is defective, or it doesn’t work if the hot and return wires are connected to the switch using the push-in connectors rather than the connector screws? It has been too long for me to return this one, so I’m stuck with an overly expensive spare faceplate. I’m pretty handy and technically savvy, and these are ultra simple, so it’s definitely an issue with the one I bought.

source_doc: Well made pullover for someone with an athletic build. I ordered this pullover because I was intrigued by Tom Brady's name attached to the item. I didn't know he was endorsing a line of athletic wear. I figured if Brady was willing to add his name to the product, it must be high quality. The pullover is indeed well made with quality materials. It is extremely lightweight, and great for moderate temperatures around 50 degrees. I am in my mid-50s, 5'9" and about 170. I run outside about 4 times a week and do strength training 2 times a week. I am certainly not an elite athlete, and I find myself walking up steep hills these days when out on a run. Usually a large is about the right size or just a little big on me. The large Brady pullover I ordered was definitely meant for someone with Brady's athletic build rather than my middle-aged build. There isn't any give when getting the item pulled over my head, so it isn't the easiest pullover to put on. However, while the fit is snug, once on it worked great for a warmer than usual January run. It kept the wind away and was surprisingly flexible for as difficult as it was to pull on. I would order again, but I would order a larger size.

source_doc: A pleasant surprise! I have to admit to being skeptical about this head wrap. I fully expected it to feel too tight or too heavy, but I was pleasantly surprised by how comfortable it is to wear.While it does feel heavy when you hold it, I didn’t find it too heavy when it was on my head. And though it’s tight, it wasn't too tight. It stays in place well, so if you choose to be up and about while wearing it, it shouldn’t slip down. It’s possible to pull it down over your eyes or leave it above your eyes, whatever best suits you. Personally, when I have a headache, I want the cooling relief over my eyes.Since it’s winter here and was below zero when my package was delivered, even though I took it from the drivers hand, the head wrap arrived cold. I’ve realized it always feels sort of cool to the touch, but I keep in the freezer as I like it colder. I haven’t tested it in the microwave since I don’t intend on using it that way.

source_doc: Like that I can feel the water. I have a set of speedo hand paddles and I wasn't sure if I had made the right choice as I just started swimming again so I wanted to try these out as well.I wasn't sure what size to get because I have bigger hands and the information didn't really explain what size to get so from what I read I decided to try the medium. These were a little tight on my hands but comfortable. I did like the bigger hole in the middle so I could feel the water, the speedo ones have a really small hole in comparison.The big difference for me between these and the speedo ones is that these are flat and the speedo ones are slightly curved. It turns out that I prefer the slightly curved ones as a beginner but I have a feeling these flatter ones are going to prove useful the more I use them.

source_doc: This continues to be very popular!  Three dogs, and they love it. I was dubious about how this would hold up, or that it would keep my dog's interest, but after three months it is still a hit!  I mean, I know it's the FOOD that makes them interested, but they all will keep moving around, finding every last piece of dog food out of it.  It takes some time to load, but I've found that I can just sprinkle regular dog food (small bite sized) while I'm spreading apart the folds and it goes pretty quickly.  I expected that with two puppies and an adult dog that they'd start chewing up the polar-fleece type fabric, but they haven't done that at all.  It's big enough that it doesn't slide around, since they're typically standing on at least part of it, and I like that I can just fold it and then roll it up, with the built-in strap holding it together like a small sleeping bag.  When I want to use it, I just unroll, load the kibble in, and then I let the dogs in from outside and watch them just go at it!  They're busy, busy, busy, with their tails wagging the whole time.  I love it!

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. My first steps after getting up were pain free, and I can't remember the last time that happened. I'm definitely sold on these insoles. Though the packaging says it can take two to three days to get used to them, my right foot was completely comfortable immediately. The left not so much. I won't call it UNcomfortable, but definitely more noticeable. That's a "me" issue, though.My feet were slightly more sweaty when I took off my shoes after about four hours, but not annoyingly so. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

I was a little confused that the box said it was the small size strap because I didn't have a choice of sizes when I purchased, but they still fit very well and don't slip around.

source_doc: Unbeatable great value cable. I got this as a temporary cable while I wait for an actual high quality one to come in. For those, you must either pay big or you wait a month to get it. Enter this cable:Less than 15 bucks, arrives the next day (for me,) and works great. The price and availability are unbeatable. How does the cable perform? I haven't been able to to detect any noise on the video or the audio. If there's audio hum, I geneuinly haven't noticed it. These are cheap so I'm sure they're hit or miss and I doubt the wires are individually shielded. But the one I received murders the composite cable I was using. I would even say it surpasses perfect s-video quality. It's sharp colorful rgb video.The cable feels and looks cheap, but it IS cheap. And you're definitely rolling the dice on the build quality here, but I can at least vouch that you'll potentially receive a solid cable that looks a million times better than composite.I might come back later and compare it to a high quality scart cable to note the differences, but I would say go ahead and give this one a try if you want to save some time and money. Bottom line: the cable I got looks great.

source_doc: Best keyboard I have ever had! I have a laptop but I never use the laptop keyboard as it is not comfortable to me. I love this keyboard and I have had many in the past. The palm rest is perfect (as I usually have my keyboard on my lap) and I was thrilled with the weight of the keyboard. It is very sturdy. The fact that there is no cord (to charge) and has a battery along with bluetooth makes it just that much better. The touch on the keyboard is light and works perfectly for me. I used to have the Logitech 800 with backlit keys but I have to say I don't miss it at all! I cannot say enough about how great this keyboard is. I have a second laptop coming and believe that I will be able to link this keyboard to both laptops which will be so much easier! Everyday that I use my new keyboard I fall more in love with it!

source_doc: Only includes 1 round banister piece. I bought this for the top of my stairs where there are 2 round banisters. When I started installing I noticed there was only 1 round spindle piece. It came with a note saying if we want a second round spindle piece we need to contact them. So I tried emailing them using the email from their customer service website but that email address doesn't work. So now I have to find time during business hours to call them cause their customer service line has limited hours. Very annoying. On top of that, I went ahead to put it together as much as I could (to make sure it is worth contacting them) and found that the one spindle piece included is WAY to big. In order to get it to stay at the right spot I had to wrap my banister spindle in a ton of cloth. Oh and one of the mounting straps broke when I was tightening it (it wasn't super tight either). So overall, not a good experience. I think I will return it, but will call them just to see if they can fix these issues.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. source_doc: First Canister Vac - So Pleased. I have gone through three stick vacuums in the past 5 or 6 years. I have had Dyson, Bissel, and Shark. I have three pets - 2 dogs and a long hair cat. My entire house is ceramic tile. The stick vacuums would clog horribly with pet hair. I had to take them apart about every week to deep clean just to get a lackluster clean on the floors. This vacuum, whoa! I have vacuumed my entire house, furniture, door and window frames. The attachments are fantastic, and the vacuum is just stellar so far. One caveat for which I didn't deduct a star, if you have never used a cannister vac like myself just understand that it takes a minute to adjust how you vacuum. I felt like everything was awkward and too big the first two or three times I used it. Like I said, first canister vac. After that, I have had zero problems. And I really do love it.

source_doc: Programmed fine but a bit concerned with other comments. This is a nice smoke alarm that I was able to program with no issues.  However, after reading some of the comments, I'm a bit concerned with where I planned to install it.There were a number of posts about false alarm posts.  There are so many positives that I still plan to use it, but it's not going where I wanted it, my living room ceiling.  I need a taller ladder to reach the ceiling and hearing about false alarms in the middle of the night is very discouraging for me to install where I intended.My thought at this time is to place it high enough in the room so that it's reachable with a step stool and, if I have no issues with false alarms, put it where I originally planned.  I burn a lot of firewood and the LR is right next to the garage so I wanted an alarm that would add some protection in those areas.I love the idea of getting an alarm wherever I may be but I certainly want a true signal.

source_doc: Works perfectly for what I need. I just moved my toddlers into their own bedroom. While I do have a Ring Camera in there which sends motion alerts, I was needing something that would alert me of sound in real time. This monitor does just that.Set up was super easy. I literally just plugged them in and they paired instantly. It picks up every sound so I can even hear when they move. I like that the volume can be adjusted so I can lower it down while they’re settling to go to bed and turn it up when I myself am ready for sleep.I do not use the cordless feature as the parent monitor is plugged in to sit on my nightstand and the one in my kid’s room is also plugged in so I can’t comment on the battery life.The night light on the kid monitor is a really nice touch and I like that whenever there’s higher sound the parent monitor lights up orange to alert.When we have our next baby I will definitely be purchasing another one of these. They are really simple but work perfectly for what I need. I wish I bought them when my little ones were in the baby phase to help when we put them in another room for naps.

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.

source_doc: Strong, lasting fragrance...& rash. Update:Although I washed this off soon after because I couldn't stand the smell, I broke out in a rash on my arm where I tested this.I love the convenience of a spray sunscreen, but I couldn't tolerate the fragrance added to this one. While I detect the coconut and maybe it's the shea, it's overwhelmingly a chemical, plastic, perfume smell that reminds me of something you would spray your car with or buy in the dollar store. I only sprayed it on my arm, and it's giving me a headache. I can't imagine how awful I would feel if I sprayed it all over, not to mention on others around me. The spray is very strong and generous and dries quickly. I do like how lightweight it is. I also like the twist lock cap. Each of the bottles was sealed, and they were in a resealable bag. The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Problem Solver! I cannot tell you how many times I have battled with trying to remove stripped screws!  The most recent was when I was trying to remove my bathroom cabinet doors to repaint them.  I spent well over an hour trying to get a damaged screw out and ended up having to repair damage to the actual cabinet as a result.  I have tried most of the methods I looked up on the internet but nothing worked easily.  When I saw this set of screw extractors, I seriously did a happy dance.  I don’t know why I never saw this when looking up ways to remove damaged screws but this is genius! source_doc: Works great, no problem pairing but your camera App might not allow external microphones. If your video App allows you to select an external microphone, this will work very well. Any problems I had with this were the result of my smartphone, and the included Camera App and, not the fault of the product. When I first plugged this in and powered up the microphone, the two immediately paired. However, try as I might, I could not get my phone to use the microphone. Yes, my Motorola G7 has OTG and has worked with other products like endoscopes, Wallabot and other products. However, when recording video, the phone always used my internal microphone.Today I found out that the problem lays with my Camera APP that came with the phone. So, I downloaded an App called "Open Camera" from the play Store and, there is a selection to use internal or external (if plugged in). Once I selected "external" this wireless microphone has worked flawlessly.  I walked to the edge of my property (about 110 ft) and it clearly picks up me whispering and, the sound quality is as good, or better than my internal microphone. The nice thing about this particular app is that there are no adds at all so far.It took a bit to figure out but, I am now totally pleased. I just wish I did not have to use a different App to video something.
hypos: Работает отлично, без проблем с подключением, но ваше приложение для камеры может не позволять использовать внешние микрофоны. Если ваше видеоприложение позволяет выбрать внешний микрофон, это будет работать очень хорошо. Любые проблемы, которые у меня были с этим, были результатом моего смартфона и приложения для камеры, а не недостатком продукта. Когда я впервые подключил это и включил микрофон, они сразу же сопряглись. Тем не менее, как я ни старался, я не мог настроить свой телефон на использование микрофона. Да, мой Motorola G7 поддерживает OTG и работал с другими продуктами, такими как эндоскопы, Wallabot и другие. Однако при записи видео телефон всегда использовал мой внутренний микрофон. Сегодня я узнал, что проблема заключается в приложении камеры, которое поставляется с телефоном. Поэтому я скачал приложение под названием "Open Camera" из Play Store, и там есть возможность использовать внутренний или внешний (если подключено) микрофон. Как только я выбрал "внешний", этот беспроводной микрофон работал безупречно. Я подошел к краю моего участка (около 110 футов), и он четко улавливает мое шептание, а качество звука такое же хорошее или лучше, чем у моего внутреннего микрофона. Хорошо, что в этом конкретном приложении пока нет рекламы. Потребовалось немного времени, чтобы разобраться, но теперь я полностью доволен/довольна. Я просто жалею, что мне пришлось использовать другое приложение, чтобы снять что-то на видео.

source_doc: Can I give this 3.5 stars? I wish I could. I really wanted my cat to like these. They came well packaged, in individual pouches. The ingredients list is impressive. My cat is getting on in years and the bone/joint support sounded promising. My cat is finicky about her food - she loves her greens, her Fancy Feast Medleys and her Temptations treats. But she also LOVES her Churus, especially the Chicken and cheese flavor. I thought this would be a great substitute for Churus and so I tried to entice my cat 2 ways: I placed a pouch of this (like I would her Churus) in a bowl and placed it where I put her treats. She tried it… and quickly dismissed it. I thought maybe I should have mixed it? But I tried again and was still unable to grab her attention. I then tried this as what the brand indicates- as a topper for her food…and my baby didn’t even touch her plate… and it was her FAVORITE canned wet food flavor. So although I wanted to like this, kitty didn’t like it and so I’m stuck with several pouches of a topper my cat will not eat… Serving size is 1 pouch for up to 8lbs cat weight. Price at the time of this review is 47 USD, which is inline with the quality of the ingredients but for my cat not in line on flavor.
hypos: Можно ли поставить этому 3.5 звезды? Хотел/а бы я это сделать. Я действительно хотел/а, чтобы моя кошка это полюбила. Они пришли хорошо упакованными, в индивидуальных пакетах. source_doc: Works well on my very fine, thin, and fragile hair. Not a mist... I love TRESemmé products, and this TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist it's no different, other than one thing. It is definitely not a mist, and cannot be sprayed directly on the hair evenly. I spray it into one hand, rub my hands together, and then apply it to my hair, starting at the root area. I don't have a lot of hair, so it works well for my fine, thin, fragile, and rather curly hair.Whenever I go out, I wear wigs, but I still want my natural hair to look halfway decent at home. Not only does it work well on my natural hair it also helps to keep my wigs in place. For what little natural hair I have, it doesn't take much to do the job. If I blow dry it, it gives it quite a bit of volume, but most of the time I let it air dry. It starts out a little crunchy, but once I finger comb it out, it has more volume and looks much thicker.I wish the product sprayed out in a mist as its name suggests, but I still like it for my natural hair, and for my wigs, as well. For those reasons, I would definitely recommend it!
hypos: Хорошо работает на моих очень тонких, хрупких и слабых волосах. Это не распылитель... Я люблю продукты TRESemmé, и этот TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist не исключение, за тем исключением, что он определенно не распылитель и не может быть равномерно распылен непосредственно на волосы. Я распыляю его на одну руку, растираю руки вместе, а затем наношу на волосы, начиная с корней. У меня не много волос, поэтому он хорошо подходит для моих тонких, хрупких и довольно кудрявых волос. Каждый раз, когда я выхожу на улицу, я ношу парики, но мне все равно хочется, чтобы мои натуральные волосы выглядели хотя бы нормально дома. Он не только хорошо работает на моих натуральных волосах, но также помогает удерживать парики на месте. Для тех немногочисленных натуральных волос, что у меня есть, не нужно много продукта, чтобы выполнить свою задачу. Если я сушу волосы феном, они становятся довольно объемными, но большую часть времени я позволяю им высыхать на воздухе. Сначала они немного хрустящие, но как только я расчесываю их пальцами, они приобретают больше объема и выглядят гораздо гуще. Хотелось бы, чтобы продукт распылялся туманом, как это подразумевает его название, но мне все равно нравится он для моих натуральных волос и для париков. По этим причинам, я определенно рекомендую его!

Хорошо справляется с моими очень тонкими, хрупкими и слабенькими волосами. Это не распылитель... Я обожаю продукты TRESemmé, и этот TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist не исключение, за одним нюансом. Он определенно не распылитель и не может быть равномерно распылен прямо на волосы. Я распыляю его на одну руку, растираю руки и затем наношу на волосы, начиная с корней. У меня не так много волос, поэтому он отлично подходит для моих тонких, хрупких и довольно кудрявых прядей. Каждый раз, когда я выхожу на улицу, я одеваю парики, но мне все равно хочется, чтобы мои натуральные волосы выглядели нормально дома. Он не только хорошо работает на моих натуральных волосах, но и помогает удерживать парики на месте. Для тех немногих натуральных волос, что есть у меня, требуется совсем немного, чтобы добиться нужного эффекта. Если я сушу их феном, они приобретают значительно больше объема, но чаще всего я позволяю им сохнуть на воздухе. Сначала они немного хрустящие, но как только я расчесываю их пальцами, волосы становятся более объемными и выглядят гораздо гуще. Хотелось бы, чтобы продукт распылялся в туман, как это от него ожидается, но мне все равно нравится он для моих натуральных волос и для париков. По этим причинам я определенно рекомендую его!

source_doc: Native DualSense touchpad on PS4 with new firmware. I love my DualSense controller, it's amazing, and I don't own a PS5 primarily being a PC gamer.  Recently dusted off my old PS4 to discover that I was running firmware 8.5, and thus could jailbreak it on 9.00, breathing life back into the old device.  The DS4 controller is good, but it's no DualSense, so I set out looking for a way to usef the DualSense on PS4.  I had previously purchased a Magic-NS a couple years ago to use it with a Switch, so I looked into Mayflash devices again.Enter the Magic-S.  All around it was exactly what I was searching for.  I could pair the controller to the device and then move it between the various platforms I game on without having to repair it.  Only setback was touchpad wasn't fully functional.  However I contacted the developers, discovered there is a way to do gestures on it, but it was clunky.  Well new firmware came out a day or two ago and now there is native touchpad with DualSense on PS4!  Freaking amazing!Highly reccomened if you are looking to use your PS5 controller on a PS4 or other devices.  And superb communications when I bumped into pebkac issues.  Thanks!

source_doc: Might work for others, but not for me. I am an older lady.  I have a small, older car.  It will probably be the last car I own, too.  So I wanted to try to protect the seats.  The problem is, I didn't think about how I get into my car.  Because it is a small car and I am older, I open the driver's door, turn away from the driver's seat and then lower myself onto the seat.  THEN I both turn and pull my legs into the car.  Because of how I pivot by turning and pulling my legs in, these lay-on-top covers just get all twisted beneath me!  You really think I want to try to lean up in the seat and fiddle with this tangled/twisted seat cover beneath me???  SMH...for this price these should be way better than they are.

source_doc: (Almost) Perfect! I just got a new sports car, and I hate to have things flying around. Plus I just really like organization. I like to keep a few things like a small box of Kleenexes, hand wipes and an umbrella in the cabin of my car, but I don't want to have it look messy. Plus I like that this keeps them close at hand and that I can easily take everything out and move it to the trunk when I have passengers. This fits exactly in the space behind the passenger seat and meets all my criteria. I also like that it has a divide in the middle and several elastic netted holders to keep the things more organized. If I have something small but I don't want to have tip over I can put it in the second compartment. It's not the most durable thing given that it's only made of cardboard. But I've had it for several months and it still looks like the day I bought it, and I love it! I definitely recommend it.

Мне также нравится, что у него есть перегородка посередине и несколько эластичных сетчатых карманов для лучшей организации. Если у меня есть что-то небольшое, что я не хочу, чтобы перевернулось, я могу положить это во второй отсек. Это не самое прочное изделие, так как оно сделано только из картона. Но я использую его уже несколько месяцев, и оно по-прежнему выглядит так же, как в день покупки, и я его обожаю! Я определенно рекомендую это изделие.

source_doc: I was really hoping for more than it delivered. UPDATE...After a lot of trial and error I have found the Mustang Micro to be much better than my original review. I have used it for recording and the results were very good.I have had a Fender Mustang V for a few years now and I record with it often. When I saw this device I thought it might be another recording option. Technically I can record with it. However, in the very short time that I actually tried it plugged into my 1970's era reissue Strat it sounded very overdriven. In every mode I tried. Don't get me wrong, I do like some nice overdrive. But this is too much. To the point of having a crunchy sound. I tried my 2010 Teloecaster. Same thing. Then my Epiphone Dot. Same. I tried other amp models, effects, EQ, different volume settings. All of them super crunchy. Which knocks this down from a possible recording amp to only a practice device. And even then the tone is highly unsatisfying. So if you are curious and you have an extra $120 lying around then give it a try. Maybe it's just what you are looking for. But if you like good tones coming from your guitar then move along. This is not for you.

source_doc: Unplayable. I really wanted to like this game.  Visually its a very appealing game and the background music is good.  However the controls are way too sensitive and combat is clunky.  These are things I think I could have gotten used to over time.  However what I can't get used to is the horrendously long respawn times after you die.  It consistently takes over a minute for the game to load back up after you die.  I even timed it and the load time was 1m 05s 95 seconds.  This is completely unacceptable.This game was free with Playstation Plus, but I will be deleting it because I can't even enjoy it when most of the time is the stupid loading screen.  Months ago, this game was on sale but for some reason I decided not to get it. Knowing what I know now, I'm glad I didn't waste my money for an unplayable game.Thanks EA for reinforcing a decision I made nearly 15 years ago to never buy games at price, if at all.

source_doc: Works great for me! I have read many articles regarding turmeric extract and decided it was time to give it a try. I have had many surgeries and now suffer from arthritis because of it.  I don’t want to take pain pills, so I am always looking for a natural remedy and I believe turmeric is the solution. Within a week of starting this supplement I was noticing less pain in my back and less pain in my knees.  I am encouraged by these results, and I will continue to take this turmeric supplement. I received two jars each containing 120 capsules. The manufacturer recommends taking 3 capsules a day preferably spread out through the day. I can’t seem to remember to do that, so I take two in the morning mixed in my juice. I have not had any adverse side effects and I highly recommend this product.

source_doc: Comfortable but not slippery, cute steering wheel cover. This is my first time having a steering wheel cover. I have a 1st Generation Toyota Sienna. I measured my steering wheel and it was close to 15", so I figured this would work. It was a bit of a struggle getting it on but not too bad, I didn't need any help or tools. I do wish I would have given more thought to where the seam on the cover would be, because I didn't and it ended up being on the right toward the bottom which isn't as bad as if it were closer to the top, but I think I would prefer if it were in the middle at the bottom as a clear point of reference. It's a pretty thick seam. I don't want to have to remove the cover and put it back on though, it was a tight fit. I chose this Bohemian design because I think it goes pretty well with my old and ugly brown interior. The cover does make the steering wheel quite thick, which, I guess, is easier to hold onto. The fabric has a tooth to keep my hands from slipping, but it still feels pleasant to the touch. I'm picky about how fabrics feel on my skin, and this feels pretty good.

source_doc: i think it is great and fits my needs really well. for this price i was surprised that this sounds as good as it does. here is my use case: i live in a townhome so i had the idea for my band to plug into a mixer (e-drums used) and everyone wears headphones. that way we can crank it up and not anger the neighbors. lots of headsets, wires, headphone amp... i put some time into planning it out. what i did not account for was the guitars sounding like hell - i am running a line out from the headphone out of the amps directly into the mixer. so i started researching cab simulators, IR loaders, etc. to try and replicate the sound of a mic'd amp. the sonicake does this really well - it sounds authentic. i wasn't expecting a lot for the price, but i was happily surprised. if you have similar needs to me, i would highly recommend that you use the XLR out on the sonicake. i noticed a large difference in sound quality between that and the 1/4 inch out.

source_doc: Comparable to other standard wipers but is definitely not premium. I was fortunate in the fact that I got to utilize the wipers in the rain and slush right away on a 10 hour drive across state (California 2/24/2023) and it happened to rain 9 out of those 10 hours too. The wipers I would say were very quiet and I did not hear any noise from them what so ever, however they do bend a bit at the top tip when moving across the windshield which makes me question its longevity in terms of quality. The wipers were also labeled as premium and they are definitely not. I did get steaks on one of the wipers as it moved back into the down position and it did it every time throughout my drive but while going back up, it cleared it. For the price, I would say its worth buying and should last through the season I hope. Would I buy them again?... I most likely would not. On a side note, I did buy three sets for all my cars and none of them came labeled with the sizing so I had to measure the lengths to determine which was for which vehicle.

source_doc: Very impressed with the quality of this microphone. I have to say I was pretty blown away by the sound and quality of this microphone. Out of the box, I saw that it was modeled after the Sennheiser series which I own. This allowed me to do a side by side comparison. Now it does come with it's own cord, but I tossed it aside as for using this mic you will in fact to get the best results want to use a full XLR cable. To be honest, I could not tell the difference. The WEYMIC has just as much warmth and presence as my mic. Weight, construction, looks exactly like my own mic, so needless to say, I was very impressed. Since I was at band practice, I let the other guys listen while I tried both and they also could not tell the difference. Just so you know, the WEYMIC microphone is now on my stand and my previous mic is with my guitar player who also shares vocal duties. This works out great since both mics match in sound and quality. I couldn't be happier with this and have hopes that in the future I'll be able to try out some of WEYMIC's other products. This mic well earns 5 stars. Thank you.

source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: So glad I found this!!! I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

source_doc: Very easy to use. I bought this for my front door because I noticed light and cold air leaking through where the door meets the frame.  I must admit that I am not very handy and a bit of a diy dunce.  I really thought this would be a good temporary fix until I could call a handyman.  Much to my surprise,  it actually works great and I didn't need any help at all with it.  The whole process is fairly simple,  but don't skip the preparation steps.  Simply measure out how much you need and cut it to size.  Clean off the area first.  I used rubbing alcohol because it dries so quickly.  This helps the adhesive stick to the surface without getting messed up by dirt or dust.  Peel off the backing and stick it in place with a fair amount of pressure.  I let it cure for 24 hours before I used the door again.  That might be excessive,  but I wanted to be extra cautious.  The D shape is really neat because it expands into the little gaps.  Nothing is getting through now.

source_doc: GREAT PRODUCT. This is a great product. I couldn't be happier with my purchase. I only gave it 4 stars for sturdiness because even though there is a metal support under each wooded step... the wood itself feels a bit vulnerable. It feels pretty good under my 22O pounds... but if I were closer to 3OO I think that they might possibly crack or split under such weight. I am sure that the metal will hold 5OO pounds... but I am not sure about the wood itself. Which could be replaced by something a bit thicker if necessary. But otherwise I am so happy that I bought this unit rather than any of the others. As this unit looks great... works great... and I can easily pick it up with one hand... if I want to move it and use it elsewhere in my home. This unit can also be easily painted if desired.  I have a lot of Elfa shelving over my full bed lengthwise for my large CD collection. These steps allow me to easily step up onto my bed mattress to access my CD's. For children at a sink... or pet's accessing a bed... it would be perfect... as it is for my needs. This is a great product at a really very decent price. Somehow it is both light weight and sturdy at the same time. Buy with confidence as this is definitely a quality product which will last.

source_doc: Awesome AirPods Max stand. I LOVE my Airpod Max headphones! I already had what I had hoped was the perfect AirPods Max stand, purchase as a kickstarter and I waited for 9 month to get it... it was minimal and came with a mag charger set-up that automatically start charging when you set the AirPods into it... I LOVE it, and it has one fatal flaw: It does not sleep the AirPods. I am always having the AirPods pick up calls when I answer the phone. I spent twice what this cost for that and I had to stop using it for that reason.That said, I received this stand totally broken. Amazon seems to have sent me a returned item and once I contacted the seller they politely, quickly and efficiently sent a new one. The second stand is flawless and works perfectly. it is attractive and sleeps the AirPods immediately when set into it. The padding is perfect to not mar the beautiful finish on my AirPods. I do wish there was a more perfect charging solution, but I am very happy with this and recommend it wholeheartedly. It feels premium for premium headphones.

source_doc: Good but misses keys. I have had this keyboard for a while. About 2-3 months after I got it, I started having issues with the buttons on the far right not working (the enter button, the 9, 6, 3 keys. I have to try to hit them multiple times for them to register. Sometimes my 2 key sticks and does the number twice when only hit it once. And the D key doesn’t always register. It started off mild at first and kept getting worse. It’s now at the point that I can’t deal with the issues anymore. I deal with a lot of numbers on a daily basis and this keeps slowing me down. I need to get a new keyboard. I want to try this one again, but am worried about the same issue happening again. I love the colors and the quickness of the buttons (as long as they work) I would give it 5 stars if I wasn’t having issues with the keys reacting. This keyboard was exactly what I was looking for with speed, sound, touch and responsiveness. Hopefully won’t have issues on next keyboard

source_doc: I am impressed. I have never purchased anything that has impressed me more than this.  I have a 130 lb yellow lab that sheds a pound of hair a day.  I am constantly chasing hair bunnies and sweep my floor daily.  He has very thick hair but this works great, I filled the bin the first use.  I have brushed him everyday and no longer have hair everywhere.  The best part is that he loves it.  I pick up the hose and he comes running.  The only down side is that my arms get tired before he does.  The best purchase I have made in a really long time.  I even used it on our cat, she was not as happy as he was but did let me brush her for about 10 minutes before she flipped her tail and left.  I could never brush them in the house because hair would fly everywhere I spent more time cleaning up after brushing than I did brushing. This brushes and vacuums at the same time which is wonderful, no mess to clean up.  It is amazing how much hair is in the bin.  My only regret is that I didn’t buy it sooner.  I am happy and the dog is thrilled that he gets brushed everyday.  The noise is low so it doesn’t bother him.  I highly recommend this product

source_doc: Love i. I have never used to sleeping bonnet for and after trying this for a night I really like it. I have curly hair that tangles easily. I usually put it in a ponytail for the night. However, putting my hair in a ponytail tends to pull the curls so I’ve been looking for a solution to that problem. I bought the sleeping cap in hopes that it would help keep my curls and also help with the frizz I usually have in the morning. This sleeping cap did help, but came off at some point in the night. I thought I had it pulled tight enough, but I guess I didn’t. So considering I only had it on for half the night and it still helped to keep my curls nice in the frizz down, I think it did a pretty good job. Definitely would recommend.

source_doc: Defective Tool From The Start. The first time I used this wrench to torque some wheels, it locked up and displayed gibberish on the final wheel. I rebooted the wrench and it seemed to work. I used it again and it seemed to work so I just took a mental note. I recently used it and the display locked up again and rebooted itself in the middle of trying taking a measurement. I finally accepted that this torque wrench was defective. I called the manufacturer who referred me to a company in WV. They said to send it and they would fix or repair. At this point, I wanted to switch brands. I didn't feel like shipping on my dime so I contacted Amazon. They said they would do a one time refund since it had been 4 months. I was ecstatic. I printed the UPS label and shipped it. I was then notified of the refund amount which was $30 less than the purchase price. I researched and found that you only get 80% back if the return is over 1 month. My future large purchases will be from local stores and I won't buy another Gearwrench torque wrench.

source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Game changer for keeping the kitties hydrated! I was a bit leery about purchasing this, but boy-oh-boy am I glad that I went for it! It is better than I even imagined. We have a bit tight living space and I needed something that could fit in a small space. I was tired of carrying a full water bowl over to the cat’s “dining area” to then have one of them nudge my hand and then spilling the entire bowl of water on the floor! Plus I could never seem to be able to tell when their water bowl was empty. This unit has been a blessing. It didn’t take them any time at all to use it—they weren’t intimidated by the new look at all. I also discovered that the lid will screw onto a soda bottle also, so if there is a time when we need to leave more water out for them, I feel confident that I could use a larger size bottle if we will be gone for an extended amount of time. It will also be useful if for some reason the original bottle cracks (which I’m hoping it won’t). I would love to find another stainless food bowl for this unit so that I can have a clean one on standby when I want to wash the included bowl in the dishwasher. The extra ones I have are either too large or too small. This was a great buy!!

source_doc: How the...I LOVE IT. I LOVE IT. Basically, I have 5 tanks and at first was using really amazing usb pumps. source_doc: Pretty good lemon flavor, better when mixed with water. I've been trying to live a bit healthier lifestyle and have been trying drops like this as I see them so when I saw this I thought ok ill give it a shot.  The package came just fine without any leaks or cracks in the bottle.  Opening the bottle it doesn't really smell like anything and I was a bit worried but I shouldn't have been.  I took the dropper and put a couple of drips on my tongue and it was a sweet lemon flavor, kinda reminds me of lemon drops but didn't linger.  I tried this mixed with water also and with 2 drops per 8 oz I couldn't even notice the flavor at all so keep that in mind if you aren't 100% sold on the flavor.  As I have just started trying it I have not seen any results but I have not seen any negatives and that works for me.  All in all, if you like sweet lemon and want to try it in liquid form this is pretty good.

source_doc: Perfect. I will absolutely buy more of these hinges when the time comes for me to replace the other hinges I need to replace.  For now though, I bought this set in order to replace a cabinet door that was previously there but had since been removed for I don't know reason, but I had to put a cabinet door back on this small opening because our cats decided that being able to go in there to hide was going to be their favorite hiding place and normally I would not have had an issue with this had it not been for the fact that I have a lot of things I put down there and use on a regular basis and having to remove cat hair from my trays and stuff constantly is not my idea of a good time.
