source_doc: Stays in place all night! I ordered this sleep cap to try to keep my long hair from frizzing since I toss and turn all night. I adjusted the cap to be tighter with the adjustable strap inside. I honestly thought the cap would fall off during the night, but every time I woke up, it was still on my head. I sleep with a pillow over my eyes, so I’m used to something being on my head while I sleep, but having this cap on was still a little different for me. I think I will get used to it quickly. When I woke up in the morning and took off the cap, my hair was still smooth from the night before, so I believe this product works as intended. The cap material itself is really soft and smooth, so I can see why this is gentler on hair than a pillow case. Bonus, if you don’t wash your hair every day, this cap will keep your hair products from rubbing on your face and causing a breakout. I am excited to see if putting this cap on will preserve my curls to where I don’t have to completely recurl my hair the next morning.

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!

source_doc: Almost impossible to play as it came. The guitar looks beautiful and I was very happy until I realized the strings had never even been tensioned....meaning the neck could easily warp.  So I got to work on it, I'm very familiar and used to setting up acoustic guitars.  First the sound hole hex key adjustment is one I've never seen...bizarre...they provide a very long and difficult to use adjustment hex....and it barely works.  This guitar came with action so high it could not be played really.  I play out fairly regularly and have some very high end guitars, even affordable Alvarez guitars I have came setup and easy to adjust.  I have no idea right now what I was do.  I know a good luthier and will get his opinion.  I'm extremely disappointed.  This instrument is not well thought out in terms of design of the neck tension system at all and the copy I received had very little care before it was taken out of a very beaten up box...perhaps it was one sent back.  But this is unplayable.  I may send it back, I wanted a jumbo that I could take out to play and not worry about a super expensive guitar...I've seen half the price guitars that are better than this one...but the finish etc is nice...what a shame the rest isn't.

source_doc: Stopped working after a the first time using.  I paid for shipping on the replacement. I got this as a present so that I can have radio with my partner whilst biking.  I received it for Christmas and live in a winter wonderland so I only tried this once and it worked fine.  Then the weather finally got bearable to bike and low and behold it did not work.  It was passed the time to return it to Amazon so I had to try to get a replacement from Senna.  After a few weeks of back and forth I finally received an RMA but I had to pay shipping.  Maybe this is standard but it is really disappointing that I have to pay out of pocket for a product that is defective.Sound quality is not good but I guess I should have expected it.  No base and only really good for the spoken word.  It tells you to download the app but the only thing the app is good for is the instructions.The helmet itself looks nice and fits comfortably.If I could do it all again I would choose a different company.

source_doc: I use this for my dog and cats. This camera is decent for what I wanted it for. I actually got it so I can monitor my cats and dog, while they hangout, or play, on my fenced in porch. The camera isn't rated to be outdoors, but I have an overhang that keeps the camera dry, and then I just move it inside at night. Since setup is super easy, it's easy for me to move it back and forth as needed.If my animals had it their way, I would be hanging out on the porch with them the entire time, which I don't mind doing, but unfortunately, I have chores to get done. So, this camera gives me the ability to go back into my house and do a little work while they hangout. I can monitor what they are doing, and if they are misbehaving, I can call their names through the two way talk, and it's clear enough that it actually will stop them in their tracks. The picture quality isn't fantastic, but like I said, it's a decent monitoring camera for what I intended it for.

source_doc: Cheap upgrade. I am fairly new to the sax and I bought one of the cheap Eastar $200 altos. I won't knock my Eastar, I LOVE that in 2023 there's such a thing as a $200 saxophone (didn't exist when I was a kid), but I COULD NOT hit those altissimo notes! Obviously I assumed it was because I was a beginner and I needed to practice my embouchure, and I could hit a very squeaky high F# maybe 30% of the time (the lowest altissimo note). It's been a couple months now and I was starting to get the feeling that the problem wasn't me, it was the hardware. I just got this Yamaha 4C in the mail today, plugged it onto my cheap sax, and hit a perfect high F# first try! I swapped back and forth between the mouthpieces and the Yamaha notes sound noticeably smoother and clearer.TLDR: If you've got a cheap sax then this is a cheap way to instantly improve your playing.

I thought maybe dog food got stuck but my cat food is small and will not come out. What happens is my cats then knock the bowl over trying to get the food out and you guessed it, it all hits the floor along with the water, which is also another problem. The water will not come out unless you pushed down on the top of the bottle. I guess I have not been able to train my cats to do that. :( It is also made very lightweight so knocking it over is not a issue for my cats. I am very disappointed in my purchase and the fact that I spent $30.00 on this. My window to return has now closed and that's my own fault, but I buy a lot on Amazon and can say this has been one of worst purchases.

source_doc: Work great. Good quality. I switched my trailer axle from a 7500 lb to a 2000 lb axle. I just don't need that big of one way overdone. I went to a couple local places to try to get the u-bolts in the plates but just couldn't find the right size.These are for inch and 3/4 round axle. I think I'm going to need to replace the leaf springs because there's four leaf springs. I need a little softer ride. The trailer is only going to be maybe 1500 lb so I need to switch out those as well.But what I'm getting at for the leaf springs is it fit around four leaf springs and the axle?. After I cranked and tighten the bolts, the bolts are nylon. No washers. But the fact that I have four leaf springs. The bolts barely make it through the nut. Just kind of flush with the top so once I replace the springs I should have a little bit more thread on top of the bolt. I think it would be fine even with three leaf springs.As for quality, definitely quality product, the u-bolts the plates, the nuts, even the coupler that goes between the shock leaf and the axle high quality. I definitely recommend it but it again it is for a inch and 3/4 axle or the 2000 lb load?.If this fits your axle, it's a good product. Get it.
hypos: Работает отлично. Хорошее качество. Я поменял ось своего прицепа с 7500 фунтов на 2000 фунтов. Мне просто не нужна такая большая, это слишком много. Я походил по нескольким местным магазинам, чтобы попытаться найти U-образные болты для пластин, но так и не нашел нужного размера. Это для круглой оси 1 и 3/4 дюйма. Думаю, мне придется сменить рессоры, потому что у меня четыре рессоры. Мне нужно немного более мягкое движение. Прицеп весит, наверное, всего 1500 фунтов, поэтому мне также нужно заменить и их. Но к чему я веду относительно рессор, так это что они подходят к четырем рессорам и оси?. После того как я закрутил и затянул болты, болты нейлоновые. Без шайб. Но тот факт, что у меня четыре рессоры. Болты едва проходят через гайку. Просто на уровне с верхом, так что, когда я заменю рессоры, у меня должно быть немного больше резьбы сверху болта. Думаю, это будет нормально даже с тремя рессорами. Что касается качества, то это определенно качественный продукт, U-образные болты, пластины, гайки, даже соединитель, который идет между рессорой и осью, высокого качества. source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

source_doc: Nice half cup size for baby and toddler food. I got these to have a set of same-sized containers for when I make baby food, and I really like the 1/2 cup size.  Currently I’m putting the food in various containers I have, and I am wanting to be more orderly.  I like that the lids are sunken in the middle so one container can sit on top of another without sliding off.  Because these are plastic, they are lightweight if I need to take them on a day trip.  I like the various colored lids for sorting fruits, veggies, and meats. I have also found that the screw lids are leakproof, which is necessary for traveling.  I will say that they are indeed plastic, not brittle thin but not super thick either, so I do not expect them to last forever.  If they get too close to the dishwasher heat element I suspect they would melt. These state that they are microwave safe but I would not do it.  I would purchase glass ones if you need to microwave.

source_doc: A very nice inexpensive Irish whistle! I have some experience with Native American flute but am new to the pennywhistle. The first thing I looked at was craftsmanship; this whistle was flawless from what I could see; solid paint job on the brass tube, no little scratches, etc; holes were drilled cleanly; mouthpiece well-formed.  The first time I played it there was a lot of screeching; I was trying to overlay how I play NA flute onto this new little whistle. The second time I played it I tried to let go of my NA flute experience (except the basics like making sure all the holes are well-covered) and let nature find it's own way re breathing, ... ; here came the solid and clear notes! Since I do have a few other Irish whistles to compare to, I can say that this Feadog Pro D definitely has it's own voice, and it's a very pleasant one. I'm glad I added it to my instruments; it's fun to play.

В первый раз, когда я играл/играла на нем, было много визгов; я пытался/пыталась наложить то, как я играю на NA флейте, на этот новый маленький свисток. source_doc: Do not overtighten the bolts. I bought this about a year and a half ago based on the features and reviews.  I don't run a windshield on my cruiser, so my phone gets hit with direct wind when I ride.  I have gone 75+ mph with no trouble at all and no concern that my phone would come loose.  I do occasionally have to re-tighten the knob, which shouldn't happen but isn't a big deal.I only rated it 4 stars (debated about 3) because I had to remove it today and the aluminum mount snapped in half next to one of the bolts when I was attempting to reinstall it.  I didn't think I had cranked on it too hard, but maybe I have some of the blame.  I'm just glad it didn't break while I was riding.  I just bought another one, so that should say something about the quality.  I will be more careful not to overtighten the bolts when I install the new one and see what happens.

source_doc: Finally I can see the road. After driving around at night with old foggy zero visibility headlamps for the last ten years, I came across these. Wasn't really interested in high-tech LED lights as they are not in character with my truck. I found the only hard part about installing these was the lower screw positioning which is right behind the bumper, a real pain to get to...  So I improvised I drilled a one-inch hole into the bumper as you can see in the picture, a service hatch, to get to the screw which I will stick a plug into later.  Maybe I got lucky they seem to be in the exact spot, light-wise, so I have not needed to adjust them.  The only issue with them is because they are not two-part lenses like the stock type if you have to remove the indicator bulb you will have to basically remove the headlamp screws and pull the headlamp forward, which I discovered when I noticed the indicator bulb was out. It is also a bit of a tight squeeze to get the headlamps in. Overall for the money, you cannot beat them. And I would buy it again if needed.
hypos: Наконец-то я вижу дорогу. После того как последние десять лет я ездил по ночам с старыми туманными фарами с нулевой видимостью, я наткнулся на эти. Меня на самом деле не интересовали высокотехнологичные светодиодные огни, поскольку они не подходят к моему грузовику. Я нашел единственную сложность при установке этих фар, это расположение нижнего винта, который находится прямо за бампером, к которому реально трудно добраться... Поэтому я improvisировал и просверлил в бампере отверстие в один дюйм, как вы можете видеть на картинке, сервисный люк, чтобы добраться до винта, в который я позже вставлю заглушку. Может быть, мне повезло, они, похоже, находятся в нужном месте по свету, поэтому мне не пришлось их настраивать. Единственная проблема с ними в том, что, поскольку это не двухкомпонентные линзы, как у стандартного типа, если вам нужно снять индикаторную лампочку, вам придется в основном удалить винты фар и вытащить фару вперед, что я обнаружил, когда заметил, что индикаторная лампочка перегорела. Также немного тесно вставлять фары. В целом, за свои деньги, с ними невозможно не сравнить. И я бы купил их снова, если понадобится.

source_doc: Easy to use, feels professional. I must admit I was skeptical about buying this because of it's price! I wanted this model because cortado is one of the presets, and I had red good reviews about the milk recipes.My previous machine is a Nespresso latissima plus, which I still think it makes decent coffee, and maybe more coffee crema that I have been able to get with this Gaggia.Can I go back to nesspreso... No way!I like how this machine looks professional, my guests enjoy selecting a coffee from the display, so it has become an entertaining device.Coffee quality is good, but I'm learning that very dependent on the coffee beans I get. So many options to try now.. I like that!A more manual espresso machine may give you better taste or more crema...... Maybe.. I do not know and I do not plan to find out, manual is just too much work! I think this is a great combination of quality and ease of use.I'm saying goodbye to nesspreso.

Я думаю, что это отличное сочетание качества и простоты в использовании. Я прощаюсь с Nespresso.

source_doc: It works great for holding towels. I don't have a large linen closet so I've been keeping hand towels and other extras on a shelf here or a drawer there... When I saw these storage baskets I thought they may be a solution and, as it turns out, they are! I was able to hang the baskets on a over-the-door hook on my bathroom door - it can easily hold the weight of the baskets and towels.I have to say that I expected the baskets to look a bit more "straw-like" - more like real woven basket texture... I know they are described as cotton rope, but the word "jute" was also in the description so I guess that's why I expected it to look more like straw. They are still attractive - just not exactly what I expected. Also, the 3rd/bottom basket hangs at a weird angle - it tilts forward (see photo). I tried to adjust it but nothing I did made it straighten up. It's not a dramatic tilt or dip, so I don't think anything would fall out of it, but just something I observed. I removed a star for those two small things (jute in the description is misleading and the bottom basket tilts forward). But those are tiny things I can certainly overlook and I like the baskets a lot - they are a nice looking solution for my lack of linen closet storage.

source_doc: This gadget is freaking amazing! As it would happen, if things can go wrong, they will.  The day before I received a positive COVID test that not only knocked me on my ass, but the very next day the master bath toilet backed up.  I plunged and plunged, and plunged, and plunged to no avail.  So, I turned to Amazon and found this gadget. I thought it would be a rinkydink, use a couple of times before tossing into the garbage but to my surprise I was wrong.  I’m rarely wrong :).  In my now full on COVID ravaged body I easily assembled, pumped it up (29 pumps to be exact) shoved the gadget into the tank.  I kinda felt like Rambo as I pulled the trigger!  Yes, there is actual trigger.  To my surprise, the recoil felt like a shot a baby shotgun!  What I didn’t know is that I should have tried to cover the bowl because along with the recoil, a bunch of toilet water splashed back on me and the floor.  After I got over that shocker, I flushed and Wallace.  Whatever was stuck was gone.  It probably got blown to smithereens!  Run, and don’t hesitate to make this purchase!

source_doc: Very nice! I am replacing my G910 spectrum. the G910 started double typing letters I could have replaced the bad switches but after reading about this I decided to sell the 910 and buy the G513, I do lose the multi media keys and the "G" keys along the left side but I honestly never used them.this is very comfortable to type on and the blue clicky keys feel real nice. I did look at some of the ten key less models, but I work from home often and need the keypad. The g513 comes with some replacement keys which I did swap out the "wasd" I did like the way they felt on the G910 and they offer a positive engagement for me when I play games. I do recommend this keyboard in any switch type but for me I like the click sound.

source_doc: This is the leash I never knew I needed. I bought this to use with my dog's therapy dog vest - I need a 4' leash when working.  I also wanted the short loop so I could have the dog fully in control.This is very nice.  It's quite light, but strong.  Excellent quality clasp. My dog is on the small size (18"), and this is just perfect for when I am working him in places where I need really close control.  I usually use a 6' leash, held in my right hand, with the left controlling the shorter length.  However, the second handle just makes it much simpler - one less thing to juggle and more solid control.My dog's vest is red with black, so the black leash with the red flashes looks sharp.  I use it with the vest (like harness), with his standard collar, but also with a Gentle Leader when we are doing therapy work.  The light weight is important with a small dog with the Gentle Leader - I did not want to put weight on pressure on his delicate nose. I may change out the clasp for a slightly lighter one just to relieve some of the weight.Good product for a working dog - light but well made, well designed, and it seems durable.
hypos: Это поводок, о котором я никогда не думал/ла, что он мне нужен. Я купил/а его для использования с жилетом терапевтической собаки моего пса - мне нужен поводок длиной 4 фута, когда я работаю. Я также хотел/а короткую петлю, чтобы иметь собаку под полным контролем. Это очень приятно. Он довольно легкий, но прочный. Отличное качество застежки. Мой пес маленький (18 дюймов), и это просто идеально, когда я работаю с ним в местах, где мне нужен действительно близкий контроль. Обычно я использую поводок длиной 6 футов, держу в правой руке, а левой контролирую короткую длину. Однако второй рукоятка просто делает процесс намного проще - одна проблема меньше, и контроль более надежный. Жилет моего пса красный с черным, поэтому черный поводок с красными акцентами выглядит стильно. Я использую его с жилетом (как с шлейкой), с его стандартным ошейником, но также и с Gentle Leader, когда мы занимаемся терапевтической работой. Легкий вес важен для маленькой собаки с Gentle Leader - я не хотел/а оказывать давление на его нежный нос. Возможно, я заменю застежку на немного более легкую, чтобы уменьшить вес. Хороший продукт для рабочей собаки - легкий, но хорошо сделанный, продуманный и, кажется, долговечный.

source_doc: Great product and great company. I got this high chair for my 2nd baby. It converts to a little chair when it’s not needed to be a high chair anymore. It can also attach to a dining chair which is great for space saving. I’ve had the chair for over 2 years now. As you can see my son picked at the face, Chewed it and all that. It had started to bubble up on the fox face before he picked at it. I think from his head being warm and rubbing on it. Anyway I was dissatisfied because I wasn’t happy with how it looked but I kept on with it until it got to the point of the picture I posted. So I went to the manufacturer and told them about the problem and asked if they had any replacement parts I could buy. They emailed me back, asked for details and that was the last I heard from them when I sent the email back. Well today 6-8 days later I got a new replacement part sent to me for free. I love when a company listens and goes above and beyond. I’ve had this chair so long I was fully willing to pay for the part but they just made it happen. The chair is durable and easy to clean and it’s cute. I would buy this again and again.

source_doc: It worked great till it didn't. I have to say I don't have any complaints about this unit, except for the tire inflator. My first one I received wouldn't hold a charge and was sent back. This unit is still like brand new, and has been well kept. Everything else still works, and I can use it as an alternate power source. I am not happy that it doesn't inflate anymore, but I can still find uses for it as another power source. So there is that.

source_doc: Fantastic , portable amp. This is my second positive grid amp, I also own the the bigger 40 watt version. This one is much smaller, easier to carry and just as easy to use as its bigger brother. I love that it has a built in battery and charges via usb C. I haven’t charged it in almost a month and it still holds a charge. Given, I don’t play very often. I would say about 2 hours a week. So I imagine you’d be charging it more often if you play a lot. It only has a couple of built in presets, so you must have a tablet or smartphone to get the best use out of it, but that isn’t a huge deal for me. I like it. I like being able to search an almost infinite library of tones that people have shared. You can also play music and jam along with the app. I love it! I can even Connect my wah or flanger pedal to this without a hitch. I don’t regret buying this. It’s perfect for home jam sessions. If I had to pick between this and it’s bigger brother I’d go with this one, just because of the built in battery and usb C port.

source_doc: Water tastes great! I love this filter! I’m new to RVing and I noticed all the neighbors have this on their water supply so I researched it and I knew I needed one! I immediately noticed the chlorine smell was gone. I use bottled water but I occasionally run out and I hated using tap water because of the toxins it contains. I also worried about giving it to my dogs to drink. The installation was a breeze but there were no instructions that mentioned the black water that comes out at first. I was alarmed but I found their website and read that it’s carbon from the filter and it isn’t harmful. I made my first pot of coffee this morning (without my regular dread) and it was far better than regular tap water! The only thing that I don’t like is that it leaked from the water source. It comes with a rubber ring but it didn’t work for me. Luckily I had others on hand and now it doesn’t leak. Best purchase I’ve made in a very long time!

source_doc: My teeth squeak all the time now. My teeth squeak all the time now. Not in a cheesey mouse way or a "squeaky clean", but whenever I eat anything they start squeaking. It is the most uncomfortable thing ever and I only used two of the packets (one of the rapid ones and one of the normal) two weeks apart. Basically feels like the equivalent of nails going down a chalkboard but with your teeth.My teeth were never very sensitive and I would die for them to be super white so when I saw the deal on Black Friday, I HAD to cop. I was super excited to potentially see results, but after the two I used that obviously had no results, I was hoping that I could at least keep using them to try to get them to lift. However, for some reason a few days after my last strips I craved almonds. And that is when I first found out how teeth squeaking feel like. I thought I was going insane and looked it up and sure enough, almonds do make some people's teeth squeak. But it wouldn't stop after that. Just eating certain foods will make my teeth squeak and it made life a little more unenjoyable. Literally would have felt a little better if my teeth lifted a little bit. Thanks, Crest.

source_doc: Perfect for portioning out my slabs of salmon. I buy a big $40 slab of salmon at a club warehouse every time I go, then use a nice set of heavy duty kitchen scissors  to portion it out, so I can freeze what I won't use right away. Recently the selection has not been what it was, and getting it skinless isn't always possible. I needed a knife that would slice through that salmon like butter, not only to portion but also to remove the thin skin (I think it makes the fish taste fishier).This knife feels good in my hand and yes, slice through and gets the skin off like it's going through butter. I didn't know I needed this knife, but now that I have it, I can't imagine working in my kitchen without it.  I also see that there's a Mama's Great bread knife and oh my, I think I might need it too.

source_doc: Great console organizer! Even better with a few modifications! I got the one without the coin holder and USB ports! I did this for several reasons:1. I want to use a rapid charger for my phone2. I've read reviews about the coin holder being a knuckle buster when putting the car in park3. The USB ports could break later on meaning you'd need to replace the entire unit4. Better utilization of space to not have the USB ports taking up space in an already small compartment.So i made a few modifications to an already great console organizer. I used my dremel to cut a square in the top to allow the console light to enter the top compartment. I also cut 2 holes in the back of the organizer to allow me to run my apple charger through any compartment that I wanted. I chose the small upper right corner for my ear pod charger. Check out the photos.The unit fits tight and snug like a glove. I really don't have any complaints about this unit although it would have been better if it already came with the modifications that I did. Overall I'll give it 5 stars and I would highly recommend it!

source_doc: Screw holes not machined well and doesn't fit handlebars or steer tube perfectly. I bought two of these. The first one broke as I was installing it. One of the handlebar screws popped out as I was screwing it in and the threads in the hole completely just stripped out. So I got a refund and wanted to give the benefit doubt to the product so I ordered another. It lasted me roughly 9 months and as I was removing the stem to take my fork off, the bolt hole snapped and stripped out again. For the price it isn't bad. If you don't intend on ever taking the stem off and you carefully install it, I think it could be good. But I travel with my bike and this happened as I was traveling so it nearly ruined my trip. Luckily it was just one hole so I was able to make due with it temporarily but I will not be buying this stem again. Another weird thing about this stem is that it didn't fit my handlebars perfectly and there was a gap between the front plate and the stem. It also didn't fit onto my steer tube very well and it  took a lot of effort to remove/install.

source_doc: Wanted to like these but it doesnt work for my Jeep. I was so excited when I saw these because I was very ready for a different look for my TJ's tail lights and I liked the sort of modern look these gave. Unfortunately these don't work with my TJ because I have Rugged Ridge's heavy duty hinge kit for my tailgate and the tail lights are shorter in depth than the stock lights. I thought about cutting a 1/2 inch thick rubber sheet to shape but that also didnt work because the bolts didnt end up being long enough to also reach through the body with it. When I did test fit them though, they were bright and worked like they should so that's why I gave them 3 stars. I really liked them but I just wish they were similar to stock in depth so I could have used them.

source_doc: This thing is wild. I have used a variety of TENS units and have really enjoyed them.  This thing is much more powerful so be advised.  I do wish that there were lower levels as I find 1 pretty powerful.  I have not been able to increase from level 1, but I am sure with time I will get used to it.  I'm just taking it easy in the beginning.  I like that is adjustable with a variety of modes.  The pucks that drive the system are easy t use and attached and I like that one cable will charge them all. The charge lasts quite some time as well.  I have mostly focused on toning my stomach and I know I need to use it for longer to see more results, but I am excited about the journey.

source_doc: Pickleball is tough but fun.  This set is great for beginners learning how to play. I used to play tennis in high school, and I loved it.  Over the years I've not played tennis nearly as much as I wanted to given work and life schedules.  Pickleball is something that I had heard of a couple of years ago but never really looked into it.  Now, it's the newest sports fad, and this set from Deerfamy is one that I ordered to get me back into something that is like tennis.  This set comes with two lightweight pickleball rackets, two indoor court (orange) and two outdoor court (yellow) balls.  There's also a carrying case that everything fits into.After my first attempt at playing pickleball, I have to say it's a tougher sport than I thought.  If you're familiar with tennis, there's a LOT of fast-paced volleying.  That was the part of tennis that I hated and the main reason I stayed back on the baseline.  I'm not a net player, but pickleball sort of forces you into that.  The equipment from Deerfamy was good at helping me practice.  It's lightweight and had a nice grip on the handle.  I had control of the racket when swinging, so I can't blame the racket.  I'm just not good at pickleball.... yet! :)

source_doc: Works great for pets. I am using this item to secure my dog's car seat/booster seat. The lap belt of my rear seat hooks into her car seat. I liked that I could actually lock the belt nice and tight so in case of an accident, her seat would be as immobile as possible. This way, in an accident, I know the lap belt is locked, and I don't have to depend on seat belt locking itself.l Also, the lock mechanism for the belt release button is also handy in case I am in the back seat, wrangling groceries and packages, and accidentally hit the belt release buttons. This is a great invention, and I wish I would have found it when caring for my grandfather who had dementia. I can't tell you how many times I would slow down the car to park, and he would be releasing his seat belt and trying to get out of a still moving car. I did have a little trouble getting the belt locking clip on my seatbelt. (I have a 2018 or 2019 Buick Encore). I took a little trial and error, but after about 5 minutes, I locked it where I wanted it.

Также механизма блокировки кнопки освобождения ремня также удобен на случай, если я нахожусь на заднем сиденье, борясь с продуктами и пакетами, и случайно нажму на кнопки освобождения ремня. source_doc: My hair drank this up. I don't use a whole lot of product in my hair but every so often I think it's good to get shampoo like this just to strip out any gunk that has got deep into my hair. I was surprised at how much I had to use as my hair just drank this stuff up like it wasn't even there,  which tells me that my hair definitely needed a product like this.  It rinsed out just fine and I noticed after drying my hair that it felt super clean.  All in all, I really do like this product, maybe not be an everyday type of thing but I will use it at least every week, I do wish it had come with a pump handle but I was able to manage.

source_doc: Nice, but I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well. I had a really nice electric toothbrush, but it stopped working. I decided to give this one a try. I have super sensitive teeth, so the different vibrations of this one bothered me at first. I guess I've gotten used to it now, though. The bristles are super soft, which I think I like. I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well as my old one, though. I've had to use this one longer at a time to make up for it, and hope that it doesn't make me end up with cavities. I brush well at least twice a day, floss at least once a day, use a flouride mouthwash every night, and go for my cleanings every 6 months. (I'm also careful with sugar and take vitamins.) Cavities are still a struggle for me, so I don't know if I'll keep using this toothbrush and take the risk. If I didn't have to be so careful with my teeth, I'd be happy with it, though. It works well otherwise and it looks nice and durable. I also love that it comes with 8 replacement heads. Those can get expensive with other brands.

source_doc: sprays evenly, beachy aroma that lingers like cologne, light coverage, pretty good overall. Pleasant aroma, sprays well, no irritation.I use sunscreen all year round. I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. Currently dark and snowy in NY with no real use for body sunscreen, but I gave this a cursory try. It should be good for body use when the time comes. I buy the sprays for the ability to cover my back to reach places that a lotion cannot.Since I use sunscreen copiously, and spend a lot of time outside which warrants it, I tend to prefer a higher SPF (I dont down rate for this because I can clearly see what I am ordering; no suprises), and I also prefer healthy sunscreens that are good for body and environment. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. The other set I ordered came with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.

Я использую солнцезащитный крем круглый год. Я светлый/ая и у меня есть чувствительность к солнцу. Учитывая, что я принимаю несколько лекарств, которые усугубляют это, я просто одеваюсь. В данный момент в Нью-Йорке темно и снежно, и нет реальной необходимости в солнцезащитном креме для тела, но я быстро попробовал/а это. Это должно быть хорошо для использования на теле, когда придет время. Я покупаю спреи за возможность покрывать спину и доставать до мест, до которых лосьон не может. Поскольку я использую солнцезащитный крем обильно и провожу много времени на улице, что этого требует, мне, как правило, предпочитается более высокий SPF (я не занижаю оценку за это, потому что я четко вижу, что заказываю; никаких сюрпризов), и я также предпочитаю здоровые солнцезащитные кремы, которые хороши для тела и окружающей среды. Я могу получить гигантские бутылки дешевого продукта, что нормально в крайнем случае, но для повседневного использования, несколько раз в день.. я выбираю разумно. Учитывайте, что это ароматное. Другой набор, который я заказал/а, пришел с освежителем воздуха с этим ароматом. Это пляжный и приятный, но также немного парфюмированный. Если вам нравятся одеколоны и подобное, то вам, вероятно, понравится это. Мне это не мешает, но я осознаю это, когда ношу.

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.

source_doc: Like my 100W so much I might be upgrading my main tank. I actually got this to warm water change water, but I love the features so much I might get a 300W for my main tank.  Mostly I liked that they external reader tells the temperature of the tank which I wanted so I could tell when my water was ready for changing into the tank.  Now I wish I had that feature in my main tank.  I also like the peace of mind that there is an automatic shut off.  My son lost his whole tank to a shorted heater that cooked his fish.  I hope this will prevent that from happening to me.And the kicker is that I paid about the same for my heater without the temp readout.

source_doc: Works very well. Works very well to track steps, calories, distance and work outs. Data is accurate and battery life is excellent. I wear it 24 hours and the sleep data has been very helpful. I also use the smart wake feature so an alarm doesn't wake my partner since I get up a couple hours before him. The smart wake sends vibrations which buzz the arm. It works surprisingly well. Even though there is a water lock to allow user to wear in shower or swimming, I have not tried it yet, but plan to. The sensors on the sides are easy to use for the EDA scan and heart rhythm scan. I would prefer to have the apps in a different order but that is just a personal thing. The only other issue I have had is the phone app occasionally acts up and won't allow me to sync data. It self resolves but can be annoying. I chalk it up to consequence of having so much tech these days.  I am glad I chose the 5 over the 4 version for the built in GPS & water lock capabilities. I also recommend getting the fitbit premium account if you are serious about getting your health better. It has additional insights and data analyses that you won't have access to without it. Overall extremely happy with the Fitbit 5 and I do recommend it.
hypos: Работает очень хорошо. Отлично отслеживает шаги, калории, расстояние и тренировки. Данные точные, а время работы батареи отличное. Я ношу его 24 часа, и данные о сне очень полезны. Я также использую функцию умного будильника, чтобы будильник не будил моего партнёра, так как я встаю за пару часов до него. Умный будильник отправляет вибрации, которыеBuzz'ят руку. Это работает удивительно хорошо. Хотя есть водоизоляция, позволяющая носить устройство в душе или во время плавания, я ещё не пробовал/а это, но планирую. Я считаю это следствием наличия множества технологий в наши дни. Я рад/а, что выбрал/а 5 версию вместо 4 за встроенные функции GPS и водозащиты. source_doc: Very messy.  Needs a better applicator. This mascara went on really wet and clumpy.  I had to grab a cotton swab and use it multiple times to clean up around my lashes.  I feel like the applicator was partly to blame.  I couldn’t get good separation with this style of applicator.  The bristles weren’t very deep or thick.  Luckily, I had a spare applicator that I pulled out and used to clean up and separate my lashes.  Once I cleaned up the mess, my lashes were still a bit clumpy, but looked okay.  This mascara does add length to my lashes.Typically I need to reapply mascara at the end of my work day - and it smudges below my eyes.  With this mascara (if I applied it heavily), I had no smudging and I still had good coverage up to 12 hours after applying it.  If I apply the mascara lightly (in order to control the wet and clumping), it doesn’t make it through the day.  Heavier coverage lasts longer.  I did have flaking towards the end of the day.  It cleans up with soap and water well.

source_doc: Sleek flosser. I love this flosser.  Opening it up, it looks and feels like a quality piece.  What I love most about it, is its sleek and minimalist design. I'm a sucker for a good design, and It doesn't look like every other flosser you see out there.  It's well designed, and easy to hold and use.After I charged it up and cleaned all the necessary pieces, I tried it out for the first time.  Filling it is quick, with the reservoir at the top.  It's very easy to use, you can change the levels simply by pressing the power button. Mine was set at the strongest setting, and I quickly adjusted it to a lower setting.  Even at the lowest setting, It does a fantastic job at getting all the dirty bits out of my teeth, leaving my mouth feeling extra clean.  I've only felt the need to use the standard nozzle so far, but the others are there for when I need them.Verdict:  I'm so glad I got this. It's worth it's price in my opinion.  I love the design of it, I don't mind if it's sitting outside on the counter, and not put away. I would absolutely purchase this again if I ever needed to replace this one in a few years.

source_doc: Good inexpensive Shower Bench. This is not exactly what I wanted, but I needed a shower seat for the roommate immediately due to his recent leg surgery.  The roommate reported that it’s the perfect height for him, and that he likes it better than the adjustable bar stool he used previously.  (The stool began to rust.)  The shower bench is very sturdy with two bolts in major stress points, is easy to assemble and comes with an extra parts— an extra of everything except the hex wrench.  It even has an extra plastic no-slip cap for the leg bottom.  I was truly impressed by this foresight since one of the grommets didn’t allow the machine screw to go all the way in; I swapped it with the spare and presto— assembled.  The bench doesn’t wobble or shake; it’s a steal for the price I paid.  I have no idea about longevity, but I plan to replace with a stone bench if/when I find one since I was looking for a stone bench that would allow me to use a steamer ia the shower prior to this immediate need.  I almost purchased a bench 2-3x the price; I’m glad that I chose this one.  I will update this review in the future if my opinion changes over time due to longevity issues, but keep in mind it’s low price.  See the pictures for size and the box it arrives in.

I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

source_doc: Not really that bright. I got these for my 2002 F350 SuperDuty.  I installed them and was excited as I was replacing my old incandescent bulbs that seemed very dim and yellow. I actually waited to pull behind a car where I could see the reflection and saw they were indeed on.  Unfortunately it really doesn't make a different.  I'll leave them in for now though they really seem more like driving lights than fog lights to help see the road.  I won't buy these again.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Dream Flo sleep aid without melatonin supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other natural sleep supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I like the taste of the powder and I don’t have any trouble getting it to dissolve.  I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this sleep aid, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: It works best for my neck and shoulders. I ordered this bath cushion realizing that the reviews were polar extremes. My tub is pretty uncomfortable so I thought I would give it a shot anyway. I took into consideration the review that said suction cups were necessary, so I put those on first. They were not as difficult to insert as I had anticipated. You just have to use two hands and pull one of the honeycomb openings apart, then using the thumb and finger on one of your hands insert it into the opening. I had no trouble doing it, but my mother with arthritis could never manage it.I first tried this on my lower back and it was comfortable but a little bulky. I know that my issue taking a bath is a scrunched neck so I slid the pillow up on the tub to my upper shoulders and lower neck and that gave me the support that I wanted and needed. While it is still a little more bulky than I I would have preferred, it really helps my neck. I'm pleased and glad I chose it.

source_doc: I wonder about the quality. The connector should work ok for lighter duty applications.  I dont think I would use it on a car or truck.  The contact surface at the base of the black knob is nowhere near the contact surface of the battery post connector, although it is about the same as where you would connect the cable.  the connector is two parts with just a plastic bushing/insulator between the two parts.  I was able to move the two parts some, but did not try and seperate them, but I think I could if i used more pressure.  The square headed bolt is too small to self hold as it is designed to, or the ridge designed to hold the flat side of the bolt is to far away.  The square head will spin and not hold against the flat side as you can see in the pictures.  The unit does appear to be brass or at least a brass alloy.  I did file a small amout off one edge and got the same color underneath.  The cable connector end has a short area with threads but I tried the clamp bolt in there and it fit but was a really sloppy fit.  When I install the switch I will most likely drill out those threads and just clamp the battery cable eyelet with a bolt and nut.

source_doc: Who owns a Karaoke machine? This guy! (Woohoo's with glee!) I have always thought that I would never have any reason to own my own karaoke machine, but now that I do, I can tell you that I can find a reason to own one almost every week. It is a party machine. I would say that is the biggest valid reason to own your own karaoke machine. If you sing, and love to sing in front a crowd, but you still don't have a recording contract, then this machine allows you to increase your odds of landing a contract by increasing the volume of your voice. I mean, it can't hurt, can it? Sing loudly and sing proudly. This machine is well made and has not had a single problem since I received it 6 months ago. It has been to the beach and back it did well. It sounds good, it gets loud, and the two microphones that it comes with are a cinch to use. They are up and running in less than a minute after I power up the speaker. It comes with a smartphone holder so that you can display a song's lyrics as you sing. The speaker rolls on two wheels, and it has a pull-out handle like a rolling suitcase. I have had a lot of fun using this machine and I have had zero problems with it. If you are looking for a karaoke machine, this is a good choice.
hypos: У кого есть караоке-машина? У этого парня/девушки! (Ура с радостью!) Я всегда думал/думала, что у меня никогда не будет причин иметь собственную караоке-машину, но теперь, когда она у меня есть, могу сказать, что почти каждую неделю нахожу причину завести одну. Это машина для вечеринок. Я бы сказал/сказала, что это самая главная причина для того, чтобы иметь свою собственную караоке-машину. Если вы поете и любите петь на публике, но у вас все еще нет контракта на запись, то эта машина позволяет увеличить ваши шансы на получение контракта, увеличивая громкость вашего голоса. Я имею в виду, это не может повредить, правда? Пойте громко и с гордостью. Эта машина хорошо сделана и у меня не было ни одной проблемы с тех пор, как я получила/получил её 6 месяцев назад. Она была на пляже и прекрасно себя показала. Звучит хорошо, громко, и два микрофона, которые идут в комплекте, очень просты в использовании. Они включаются за менее чем минуту после того, как я включаю динамик. Она идет с подставкой для смартфона, чтобы вы могли отображать текст песни, пока поете. Динамик катится на двух колесах и имеет выдвижную ручку, как у чемодана на колесиках. Мне было очень весело использовать эту машину, и у меня не было с ней никаких проблем. Если вы ищете караоке-машину, это хороший выбор.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! source_doc: Nice! Recommended. This product was not the brand I thought I ordered but it is the same style and string number and I like it very well. Looks like the above picture of Byla 27-string lyre harp with accessories. I could not tune the strings as noted above the tuning pegs because they got too tight toward the high end, but I added an F# after every F and that has worked out very nicely for me. I play hymns and have used the F# strings for several hymns that I would not otherwise be able to play. With the F#s added, it has been very easy to tune. It is a lovely instrument and has good sound. I used sharpie markers to color code my tuning pegs and strings. I tried several other lyre harps before this one, but this is the one I really like. Glad I bought it. Shipping took a bit longer, but the seller contacted me about that through Amazon and I was willing to wait for it.

source_doc: Handiest thing you never knew you needed! Absolutely loved these clips! I bought them originally because those hanging toys made for the car seats always slipped everywhere on the baby’s car seat handle. Drove me nuts! I looked for these and they did not disappoint! I use them for everything! I probably could have gotten a smaller pack but it’s fine because I keep a set in everything: car, stroller, car seat, house….. my favorite thing to use this for is as a shade for my baby while he’s in the stroller. His car seat clicks onto the stroller but the shade doesn’t help much most of the time. I would try and maneuver my head to block the sun but now I can just clip his Muslim blanket on the car seats handle and clip the other on the stroller handle and there you have it a shade that’s breathable and I’m the exactly place you need it. Can hand it off the side. Helps keep the blanket hooked over the car seat if it’s windy/dusty and it won’t move. Holds toys in place that can hang. I love these so many possibilities and I highly recommend to any parent! I can even use them for myself to block the sun in the car. I’ve used them before to clip a Muslim blanket to my shirt so I can nurse when I’ve forgotten my cover. So many things! They are durable and I have yet to break any.

source_doc: I just wanted it to tell time with a red display. The first one I got was defective. It would not power on when plugged in. I returned it without issue and was sent a replacement. Second one was just fine. Simple to set time, I like that it has a red display. It isn’t too large but still able to see it from across the room. I purchased it so I could tell what the time was in the middle of the night without having to turn on a light or expose myself to blue light. I have a very difficult time sleeping and any other color display would be too stimulating and keep me from sleeping. I have to take medication at particular times during the night. I don’t use the alarm function but I do like that if I needed to, it has the ability to have a softer or louder alarm option. It also has a battery backup option. Simple, effective at telling time without being too bright or stimulating in the middle of the night. Bonus, my husband can see the time without looking at his phone and lighting up our bedroom. So nice not to have that happening anymore. Hopefully it lasts a long time.

source_doc: It seems to do the job well... I have an existing pedal board powered by Zuma Strymon; I am using this Strich to power the pedals I have in my studio (that are not on the pedal board.)  I am not an electrical engineer, yet I do know the differences between 110v and 220v - how can this pedal supply automatically differentiate the two?  There are no switches to for this setting.  Additionally, I do have one 24v pedal for this power supplier; I must plug in the 24v's transformer into the polarized outlets on the top of this unit.  So far, so good, but...This unit is very light in weight, yet every output had an independent kill-switch to prevent overload.  The outlets on top can power up to a 600v demand. How???As I ease into using this, I am acutely aware - sniffing the air for that burning electrical appliance smell, keeping a headphone partially on one ear so I can hear transformer buzzing (within the unit or through the monitors), and even touching it every so often to feel if it is overheating.  Again, so far, so good, for about 30 hours of use.Regardless of the mysteries, I am impressed thus far.  If it blows up, I will let you know!
hypos: Кажется, это хорошо выполняет свою работу... У меня есть педальная доска, питаемая от Zuma Strymon; я использую эту Strich для питания педалей, которые есть в моем студии (которые не находятся на педальной доске). Я не электрик, но я знаю разницу между 110в и 220в - как этот педальный блок может автоматически различать оба? Здесь нет переключателей для этой настройки. Кроме того, у меня есть один 24в педаль для этого источника питания; я должен подключить трансформатор 24в в поляризованные розетки на верху этого устройства. Пока все идет хорошо, но... Кроме того, у меня есть одна 24в педаль для этого источника питания; я должен подключить трансформатор 24в в поляризованные розетки на верхней части этого устройства. Пока все идет хорошо, но... Это устройство очень легкое, однако каждый выход имеет независимый выключатель для предотвращения перегрева. Розетки сверху могут обеспечивать мощность до 600в. Как??? Погружаясь в использование этого устройства, я хорошо осознаю - нюхаю воздух на предмет запаха перегрева электрических приборов, держу наушник частично на одном ухе, чтобы слышать гудение трансформатора (внутри устройства или через мониторы), и даже иногда трогаю его, чтобы проверить, не перегревается ли он. В целом, пока все хорошо, уже около 30 часов использования. Несмотря на все загадки, я впечатлен до сих пор. Если вдруг оно взорвется, я дам знать!

source_doc: I use it every day. I'm not a great photographer, and it's not like I can capture the "soul" of a water bottle because it's simply a water bottle. However, I am not exaggerating when I say that for the first two days that I had it, practically everyone at work questioned me about it. I'm not sure if it's because I had it full of ice water and everyone was thirsty and saw that my bottle was full of ice cold water and it just made it more desirable or what. I do, however, know that this water bottle has not yet leaked on me. I like how the ml of water is labeled on the side. Oh, and I'm reminded of how puzzled I was when I first tried to open this thing, but now I think it's one of the best aspects. So, when you go to drink, you press a little button in the front, and it flings your lid off. It is both quick and convenient. However, at first glance, it appears to be something that slides up and down. One of my friends told me they tried to drink from it, but they couldn't open it. (Fortunately, I didn't want their lips on my drink in the first place.)So, Basically I LOVE IT

source_doc: Nice!! This is my first experience with a pet water fountain. At first I was unsure where the cord went because it didn't really show it with part in the water. But I figured it out. It's very sleek and looks perfect where I have if. Luckily there was an outlet where the animals eat anyhow. It's quiet and the little fountain goes along keeping the water fresh. I haven't caught our cats drinking it but my dog really drank! I did have to find a spare bathroom rug and I put the cat food bowl, dog food, and the fountain on it. I found my dog dripped water more than usually drinking from this fountain. One more thing, I used half cold water from our fridge dispenser and half from the faucet. I was very surprised that, about 5 hours later, the water still seemed pretty chilled, which is nice. It isn't stainless steel or anything so I am not sure how it maintained its temp but I am glad.I looked at several water fountains and landed on this especially because it had a viewing area to see the level of the water. Again, I am very impressed with this little machine!

source_doc: This little tool is fantastic! True confession: I have horrible calluses and cracked heels. They don't bother me during the summer but as soon as winter hints, I start hobbling around, wondering why I never deal with it. The reason that I haven't dealt with them is that using a pumice stone has always made it worse.I got this kit because I thought it might help. I was so afraid that it would do more harm than good, that I avoided even hoping the box. I just found my courage.It's a wonder tool! First of all, it weighs next to nothing. There are two separate roller heads. I think that the rougher one would be too much for my feet in the current state but the smoothe one is perfect. I used it gently and felt the skin before and after and it was so much smoother. I think that if I don't over do it but use it consistently, I might be able to get my feet in summer shape. I'll consider it my New Years' Resolution.

Do what your doctor says but I personally think that this is worth a try if you can afford it. It doesn't have to be this brand. source_doc: Skeptical at first, but I will not play without them again! I had just seen these grips on social media when a friend who had a set  recommended I give them a try. I was skeptical at first, but after my first three-hour gaming session, I will never play without them again.I play Fortnite almost every night, often for a few hours at a time. Usually my hands get sweaty after about an hour or so, but that did not happen with c2 Gripz, even after three hours. I bought the mediums, and my hands fit perfectly around the contoured grooves. This helped separate my fingers and naturally placed my hand over the controller. The ridge at the bottom gave my fingers support and being above the controller also gave me better control.I have also noticed less strain on my hands after long gaming sessions. I have carpal tunnel, so sometimes I get flare ups during longer sessions, but I have noticed a big improvement with less strain on my hands and forearms since using C2 Gripz.I have been using them for almost two months, and I will never play without C2 Gripz again. Oh yeah! As a bonus, I like how the controller can stand on its own because of the base of the gripz. This is a perfect added feature for people who like to use their controller as a tv remote. I highly recommend this product 10/10.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!

source_doc: Love the Zero Water concept; Filter Quality Control Is A Problem. Normally I try to be positive with my reviews of products, however with these replacement Zero Water filters it is a struggle. Love the 23 cup Zero Water I purchased. The  original Filter that came with the dispenser worked perfect. Came time to replace the filter, I purchased the 6 pack, (I was committed). First filter I tried I let set overnight to give it "a chance". Next morning, no filtered water, surprise, surprise. Opened a second filter and installed it. Fourteen hours later I had 8 cups of water. 2 for 2 bad. Too late smart, I looked on the web for other people having a similar experience. I found I was not alone, in fact I was one of many, many people experiencing quality issues with the Zero Water filters. Since I purchased them as a 6 box set, I have to return them as a set. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am with this whole experience. And by the way, they were original equipment manufacturer with the name proudly emblazoned on the side. Love/hate, you have to be ready for a measure of both with this product.

source_doc: I would buy it again if needed. I couldn’t find the spring isolators for a decent price so I bought this kit. I figured if the springs were junk like everyone said I would still be money ahead buying this kit and a set of springs. Great news, the kit was great. Springs are a good ride height and everything went in easy. I don’t know why this product had such mixed reviews. Install took about 2 hours with good tools. Extending the axle enough to put the new spring in was expectedly tough because I couldn’t find my spring compressor but I was able to use a small bottle Jack to get the axle separation I needed. If I buy another sequoia I will buy this air spring delete instead of working on the air suspension every 6 months.

source_doc: Very useful and best of all, small and light. Talk about timing, this battery came just in time for when I was due in a VR meeting and I forgot to charge the headset.  The battery fastens very easily to the side of the headstrap, but I wonder how long the battery strap will last.  I pulled it tight to prevent sagging, and it seemed like I might stretch out the strap holes and eventually it might break apart.  Aside from that, the battery worked perfectly.  I was in VR for two hours using this battery, but I will say that I think it charged my HMD very slowly.  I didn't think to look at the battery status until it had 94%, and it seemed like it took forever to get to 100%.  Then again, I was using it at the same time so maybe that's normal.This battery is light and small, much unlike the 3rd party batteries that I used to have to wear for the Quest 1.  I would highly recommend this battery to anyone who needs one for their headset.

source_doc: What is going on with these keyboards? My daughter got one of these keyboards for Christmas. The 1st keyboard we had types randomly into text boxes on the screen. Just random characters. It was freaking them out so I contacted the mfgr. They said that I should update the software. I downloaded the tool to do so, but it's all in Chinese (I assume)? I don't know which button is update and which button is identify but I poke around and figure it out. The SUCCESS/FAIL text box is also not in English so I don't know the status and the window doesn't close. Either way, nothing fixes it. The company sends out a new keyboard and this one turns off randomly while in use. Since this is a gaming keyboard, you KNOW that can't happen, or GAME OVER. They suggested I update the software, but we had already plugged in the old keyboard in the meantime. I finally get the chance to do that and now the thing is dead. Like dead dead. I plug it into another computer, still won't light up. Uninstall/Reinstall/Repair/Update software, hardware (in DevMgr), restart over and over and over...and nothing. Now it's just a brick. Guess we're stuck with the ghost keyboard. Side note: Customer service was responsive in their attempt to help, but they couldn't solve the problem. Ended up offering a $20 credit, but I didn't purchase it, so that didn't make sense. I just want something that works!

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. She does a lot of window surfing and I wanted to be sure she couldn't slide it open and get out. I also wanted peace of mind to prevent me from leaving the enclosure open. It was very simple to install. My husband screwed it on for me while I held it in place. Probably don't even need two people to do it. I just wanted to make sure it was exactly where I wanted it placed. It comes when two keys. We just leave the keys in it at all times. We don't have children in the home so don't need to worry about that. The price is great. I had seen some locks that were cheaper, but went with this one because I read a review stating it was longer. I keep it all the way to the last locking point. So even if the enclosure gets opened, my Uro can't get out. I have made a routine so that once I finish spot cleaning or feeding, I put the lock back on ASAP. So no more being at work suddenly wondering did I close it all the way. I would get this again. If I get another Uromastyx I will get this lock.

source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I have a couple of wrenches - ratcheting ones - that I have used to hold nuts in place while screwing bolts down tight.  I mean, if you have ever bought "easy to assemble" furniture, you have probably cursed halfway through and wanted to throw the mess in the dumpster, right?  They give you this cheap-o "wrench" to hold the nut while you wrestle with a single "stick" Allen wrench to tighten the bolt.  That is WHY I have this set!  I throw out the "helpful" tools the manufacturer sends with their chair/table (whatever).  I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real!  The last set I put together was a gliding outdoor chair that I love, but had I used the included items, I know putting the glider chair together would have taken me at least 4 hours to complete.  I believe it took me just under 2 hours (reading, checking, then doing) to complete the chair and with this wrench set holding the nuts while the drill tightened the hex-head bolts, I finished with no cursing at all!  Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!
hypos: Если вы соберете много предметов, это отличное дополнение к вашему набору инструментов. У меня есть пара гаечных ключей - с трещоткой - которые я использовал/а, чтобы удерживать гайки на месте, пока завинчивал/а болты. Я имею в виду, если вы когда-либо покупали мебель "легкую в сборке", вы, вероятно, ругались/ась на полпути и хотели выбросить этот беспорядок в мусорку, верно? Вам дают этот дешевый "ключ", чтобы держать гайку, пока вы сражаетесь/ась с одним "палочным" ключом "Аллен" для затяжки болта. Вот почему у меня есть этот набор! Я выбрасываю "полезные" инструменты, которые производитель присылает вместе со своим стулом/столом (что угодно). У меня есть дрель с битами для шестигранников и этот набор гаечных ключей с трещоткой - это сокращает время сборки примерно вдвое, серьезно! Я думаю, что мне потребовалось чуть меньше 2 часов (чтение, проверка, а затем сборка), чтобы завершить стул, и с этим набором ключей, удерживающих гайки, пока дрель затягивала болты с шестигранной головкой, я закончил/а без ругани! source_doc: Bought for dog chew toy. I have a Australian Cattle Dog AKA "Blue Healer" puppy we got a couple months ago. He will shred through any dollar store toy you give him in a matter of days and I had read another person's review with the same kind of dog that he gave his dog a broken Diaphragm and the dog has been chewing it for over 10 years so for $8 bucks I think it was when I bought it, I said what the heck.Got the thing in the mail and the first thing I noticed was that it gets stuck because of the shape of it if lands with the round part up instead of landing like a dish shape with the edge accessible so I cut it in half and gave half of it to my Father In Law for his dog. So far they both love them and even after ripping and shredding at it, my healer hasn't even scratched it now after weeks of use and seems to really like it I assume because it's similar feeling to flesh. Anyway for the price and what I bought it for it's a great deal. source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.

Мне даже нравится ощущение пупырышков на моей попе! Ха-ха! Остается только выяснить, останется ли это пятно от красной глины со временем и не отмоется, но мне это не важно. Я единственный/ая, кто должен/жна на это смотреть. Обязательно следуйте инструкциям по разглаживанию и приклеиванию его. source_doc: Skunk odor shampoo. This product did not work. It was night of course when my dog got sprayed by a skunk. I did not have this shampoo,  so I did a quick Google search on how to remove the skunk smell. It was recommend to use peroxide,  baking soda and a drop of dish soap. I left my dog outside,  and grabbed a bucket. I quickly mixed solution in a bucket and grabbed a rag. I gave my dog a sponge bath outside with this solution. I left it on for about 15 minutes and  then brought her inside to shower to rinse off. I applied some conditioner,  then gave her another good rinse. It really worked well. I could barely smell any odor. I then ordered this shampoo. I received it 2 days later. I gave my dog a bath again using the shampoo straight from the bottle on dry coat, I then added water and began lathering it up well. I let it sit on for 10-15 minutes. She now smells like a skunk again,  I was very disappointed,  I am returning the shampoo,  waste of time and money.

source_doc: Not Worth Purchasing. I am a 52 year old hobby drummer and am not a rough player. I figured these would be cheap but thought that with my easy playing they would be good enough to last a year and save the $20-$25 for Vic Firth Rute's or Promark Hot Rods. I sent these back after playing with them 3x. The first time I used them I noticed after about 10 minutes that the rods started coming out. I would push them back down but then they were uneven. Play a little more and push them down. It only became worse with each time playing so I sent them back.The rods themselves seemed just as durable as the more expensive ones but I will never know for sure since I returned them. All they have to do is put some glue in the end piece before putting it on and the rods would stay in place. I have had a pair of VF Rute 606's for over a year and they are still going strong. The rods have never moved and they show only a little wear. The ends are spreading out some but it just makes them quieter. I guess there is a reason they cost more and I will not mess with the cheap one's in the future. Save your time and money, unless you want to mess around fixing these yourself.

source_doc: Perfect For Our Dim Evening Light In Bedroom. I have a beautiful light which I love in our bedroom.
